waged.t: v. 发动、进行（战争、运动）

e.en: She {waged} a long battle against the unfair tax law.
e.zh: 她为了反对那条不公平的税法进行了长期斗争。

e.en: The two countries {waged} war for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 这两个国家打了将近十年的仗。

wager.t:
v. 打赌
n. 赌注

e.en: I'd {wager} fifty dollars he'll be late again tomorrow.
e.zh: 我敢赌五十块他明天又会迟到。

e.en: He lost a small {wager} on the football match.
e.zh: 他在那场足球比赛上输了一笔小赌注。

wagering.t: v. 打赌、下注（wager 的进行式）

e.en: Online {wagering} on sports has grown rapidly in recent years.
e.zh: 近几年体育在线投注发展迅速。

e.en: He's {wagering} his entire savings on a single startup.
e.zh: 他把全部积蓄都押在一家初创公司上。

e.en: Factory {wages} have barely kept up with rising rent.
e.zh: 工厂工资几乎赶不上不断上涨的房租。

e.en: The company pays its drivers fair {wages} and full benefits.
e.zh: 公司给司机支付公平的工资和全部福利。

e.en: The puppy ran over, tail {wagging} excitedly.
e.zh: 小狗跑过来，尾巴兴奋地摇个不停。

e.en: She kept {wagging} her finger at the misbehaving child.
e.zh: 她不停地朝那个调皮的孩子摇手指。

waggish.t: adj. 诙谐的、爱开玩笑的

e.en: His {waggish} comments kept the whole table laughing.
e.zh: 他诙谐的话让整桌人都笑个不停。

e.en: The professor had a {waggish} sense of humor in lectures.
e.zh: 那位教授讲课时带着一种诙谐的幽默感。

e.en: Bees {waggle} their bodies to show others where flowers are.
e.zh: 蜜蜂摆动身体告诉同伴花朵的位置。

e.en: He likes to {waggle} his eyebrows to make the kids laugh.
e.zh: 他喜欢挑动眉毛来逗孩子们笑。

waggon.t: n. 四轮运货马车（wagon 的英式拼写）

e.en: An old wooden {waggon} sat rusting beside the barn.
e.zh: 一辆旧木马车锈迹斑斑地停在谷仓旁。

e.en: Farmers loaded hay onto the {waggon} before sunset.
e.zh: 农夫们在日落前把干草装上了马车。

wagnerian.t: adj. 瓦格纳风格的（宏大、戏剧性）

e.en: The opera featured a four-hour {Wagnerian} production with full orchestra.
e.zh: 那部歌剧上演了一场四小时的瓦格纳式全乐队演出。

e.en: Critics described the film score as grand and {Wagnerian}.
e.zh: 影评人形容这部电影配乐宏大，颇具瓦格纳风格。

e.en: The kids pulled their toys around in a red {wagon}.
e.zh: 孩子们用一辆红色小拉车拉着玩具到处跑。

e.en: He fell off the {wagon} and started drinking again.
e.zh: 他破戒了，又开始喝酒了。

e.en: They delivered a {wagonload} of pumpkins to the market.
e.zh: 他们运了一大车南瓜到市场上。

e.en: A whole {wagonload} of supplies arrived for the festival.
e.zh: 整整一车物资送到了节日现场。

e.en: The pioneers loaded their {wagons} with food and supplies.
e.zh: 拓荒者把食物和物资装上马车。

e.en: Kids pulled red {wagons} full of toys down the street.
e.zh: 孩子们拉着装满玩具的红色小推车走过街道。

e.en: A {wagtail} bobbed along the riverbank looking for insects.
e.zh: 一只鹡鸰在河岸上一蹦一跳地找虫子。

e.en: The {wagtail} flicked its long tail as it walked.
e.zh: 那只鹡鸰一边走一边摆动着长尾巴。

wah.t: n. 哇音（吉他效果器音色）

wahabi.t: n. 瓦哈比派（伊斯兰教派）

e.en: The scholar wrote about {Wahabi} reform movements in Arabia.
e.zh: 这位学者撰文论述阿拉伯地区的瓦哈比改革运动。

e.en: Some clerics opposed the strict {Wahabi} interpretation of Islam.
e.zh: 一些教士反对严格的瓦哈比派伊斯兰教义解读。

wahhabi.t: n. 瓦哈比派（伊斯兰教派）

e.en: The mosque follows {Wahhabi} teachings on religious practice.
e.zh: 这座清真寺遵循瓦哈比派的宗教实践教义。

e.en: Historians debate the influence of {Wahhabi} ideology in the region.
e.zh: 历史学家对瓦哈比意识形态在该地区的影响争论不休。

wahoo.t:
n. 刺鲅（一种海鱼）
int. 哇呼（欢呼声）

e.en: He caught a huge {wahoo} off the coast of Florida.
e.zh: 他在佛罗里达沿海钓到了一条巨大的刺鲅鱼。

e.en: "{Wahoo}!" she shouted as she crossed the finish line.
e.zh: 她冲过终点线时高喊"耶呼!"

waif.t: n. 无家可归的孩子、流浪儿

e.en: The orphaned {waif} wandered through the city streets alone.
e.zh: 那个孤苦无依的孩子独自在城市街头流浪。

e.en: She has the slim figure of a fashion {waif}.
e.zh: 她有着时尚弱柳扶风般的纤细身材。

waiflike.t: adj. 像流浪儿般瘦弱的

e.en: The model had a pale, {waiflike} appearance on the runway.
e.zh: 那位模特在T台上呈现出苍白纤弱的形象。

e.en: Her {waiflike} frame made the oversized coat look enormous.
e.zh: 她那纤瘦的身形让那件宽大的外套显得格外硕大。

wail.t:
v. 哀号、恸哭
n. 哀鸣声

e.en: The baby began to {wail} when the lights went out.
e.zh: 灯一灭,婴儿就开始嚎啕大哭。

e.en: You could hear the {wail} of sirens in the distance.
e.zh: 远处可以听到警笛的呜咽声。

e.en: Mourners were {wailing} loudly at the funeral procession.
e.zh: 哀悼者在送葬队伍中放声恸哭。

e.en: The {wailing} wind kept everyone awake all night.
e.zh: 呼啸的风声让所有人整夜难以入眠。

wain.t: n. 大车、运货马车（古旧用法）

e.en: The farmer drove his {wain} loaded with hay back home.
e.zh: 农夫驾着装满干草的大车回家。

e.en: Constable's painting "The Hay {Wain}" hangs in the National Gallery.
e.zh: 康斯特勃的画作《干草车》挂在国家美术馆。

e.en: They installed oak {wainscot} along the dining room walls.
e.zh: 他们沿着餐厅的墙壁安装了橡木护墙板。

e.en: The old {wainscot} gave the library a classic feel.
e.zh: 那古旧的护墙板让书房有了一种古典的韵味。

e.en: The hallway features beautiful white {wainscoting} below the wallpaper.
e.zh: 走廊墙纸下方装有漂亮的白色护墙板。

e.en: Restoring the original {wainscoting} took several weeks of careful work.
e.zh: 修复原有的护墙板花了好几周的细致功夫。

e.en: The village {wainwright} repaired carts for local farmers.
e.zh: 村里的造车匠为当地农民修理货车。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a skilled {wainwright} in the 1800s.
e.zh: 他祖父在十九世纪是一位技艺精湛的造车匠。

e.en: The dress fits perfectly around her {waist}.
e.zh: 这条裙子在她的腰部位置非常合身。

e.en: He tied a belt around his {waist} before heading out.
e.zh: 他出门前在腰间系上了一条腰带。

e.en: The elastic {waistband} on these jeans is really comfortable.
e.zh: 这条牛仔裤的松紧腰带非常舒适。

e.en: He tucked his shirt into the {waistband} of his trousers.
e.zh: 他把衬衫掖进了裤子的腰带里。

e.en: He wore a tweed {waistcoat} under his suit jacket.
e.zh: 他在西装外套里穿了一件粗花呢马甲。

e.en: The groom's silk {waistcoat} matched his bow tie perfectly.
e.zh: 新郎的丝质马甲与他的领结搭配得恰到好处。

e.en: The shop sells custom-tailored {waistcoats} for formal occasions.
e.zh: 这家店出售用于正式场合的定制马甲。

e.en: Victorian gentlemen often wore brightly colored {waistcoats}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的绅士常穿色彩鲜艳的马甲。

e.en: Cutting out sugar really helped trim his {waistline}.
e.zh: 戒糖确实帮他瘦了腰围。

e.en: The dress has a high {waistline} that flatters most figures.
e.zh: 这条裙子是高腰款,能修饰大多数身材。

e.en: These pants come in a variety of {waists} and lengths.
e.zh: 这些裤子有多种腰围和裤长可选。

e.en: The dancers wore sashes tied around their {waists}.
e.zh: 舞者们腰间系着彩带。

wait.t:
v. 等待
n. 等待时间

e.en: Please {wait} here while I check on your order.
e.zh: 请在这里稍候,我去查一下您的订单。

e.en: The {wait} for a table was over an hour.
e.zh: 等位时间超过了一个小时。

e.en: She {waited} patiently for the bus in the rain.
e.zh: 她在雨中耐心地等公交车。

e.en: We {waited} two hours before the doctor finally saw us.
e.zh: 我们等了两个小时医生才见到我们。

e.en: The {waiter} brought us the menu and some water.
e.zh: 服务员给我们拿来了菜单和水。

e.en: She tipped the {waiter} generously after the excellent service.
e.zh: 在享受了优质服务后,她给了服务员丰厚的小费。

e.en: The {waiters} wore matching black aprons at the new bistro.
e.zh: 新开的小餐馆里,服务员都系着同款的黑色围裙。

e.en: Good {waiters} can read a table without saying a word.
e.zh: 优秀的服务员不用开口就能读懂客人的需求。

waiting.t:
v. 等待中
n. 等候

e.en: I've been {waiting} in line for over an hour.
e.zh: 我已经在队伍里等了一个多小时。

e.en: The package has been {waiting} at the post office since Monday.
e.zh: 包裹从周一起就一直放在邮局里没人取。

e.en: The {waitress} recommended the chef's special soup.
e.zh: 女服务员推荐了主厨的特色汤。

e.en: She worked as a {waitress} to pay for college.
e.zh: 她当女服务员来支付大学学费。

e.en: The diner's {waitresses} all knew the regulars by name.
e.zh: 这家小餐馆的女服务员都能叫出常客的名字。

e.en: Two {waitresses} hurried between tables during the lunch rush.
e.zh: 午餐高峰时,两位女服务员在餐桌间忙碌穿梭。

waitressing.t: n. 做女服务员的工作

e.en: She paid her rent by {waitressing} on weekends.
e.zh: 她靠周末做服务员的工作来付房租。

e.en: {Waitressing} taught him patience and people skills.
e.zh: 做服务员的经历教会了他耐心和与人打交道的技巧。

waitrose.t: n. 维特罗斯（英国高端超市）

e.en: They picked up some fresh salmon at {Waitrose} this morning.
e.zh: 他们今早在Waitrose超市买了些新鲜三文鱼。

e.en: {Waitrose} is known for its higher-end groceries in Britain.
e.zh: Waitrose在英国以中高端食品超市闻名。

waits.t: v. 等待（第三人称单数）

e.en: He patiently {waits} for the bus every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上都耐心地等公交车。

e.en: The dog {waits} by the door whenever she leaves.
e.zh: 每次她出门,狗都会在门边等着。

waitstaff.t: n. 餐厅服务人员（统称）

e.en: The restaurant's {waitstaff} were friendly and attentive.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的服务员既友好又周到。

e.en: Tips are shared among the entire {waitstaff} each night.
e.zh: 小费每晚由全体服务员共同分配。

e.en: The bank agreed to {waive} the late payment fee.
e.zh: 银行同意免除滞纳金。

e.en: You can {waive} your right to a lawyer, but shouldn't.
e.zh: 你可以放弃聘请律师的权利,但最好不要这么做。

e.en: All participants must sign a liability {waiver} before the hike.
e.zh: 所有参与者在徒步前必须签署一份免责声明。

e.en: The school granted her a tuition {waiver} for outstanding grades.
e.zh: 学校因她成绩优异给予了学费减免。

wake.t:
v. 醒来、唤醒
n. 尾迹；守灵

e.en: I usually {wake} up around six on weekdays.
e.zh: 工作日我通常六点左右醒来。

e.en: The boat left a foamy {wake} behind it.
e.zh: 小船在身后留下一道泡沫状的尾流。

wakeboard.t:
n. 尾波滑水板
v. 玩尾波滑水

e.en: He learned to {wakeboard} during summer camp last year.
e.zh: 他去年夏令营时学会了滑尾波。

e.en: She bought a new {wakeboard} for the lake trip.
e.zh: 她为湖边旅行买了一块新的尾波板。

wakefield.t: n. 韦克菲尔德（英国城市/姓氏）

e.en: They moved to {Wakefield} for cheaper housing and quieter streets.
e.zh: 他们搬到了韦克菲尔德,因为那里房子便宜、街道更安静。

e.en: {Wakefield} is a historic city in West Yorkshire, England.
e.zh: 韦克菲尔德是英格兰西约克郡的一座历史名城。

e.en: After too much coffee, she lay {wakeful} until dawn.
e.zh: 喝了太多咖啡后,她一直睡不着,直到天亮。

e.en: The baby was unusually {wakeful} all through the night.
e.zh: 宝宝整晚都异常清醒,毫无睡意。

e.en: Caffeine promotes {wakefulness} by blocking adenosine receptors.
e.zh: 咖啡因通过阻断腺苷受体来保持人的清醒。

e.en: Long-haul pilots fight {wakefulness} loss with strict sleep schedules.
e.zh: 长途飞行员通过严格的作息来对抗清醒度下降。

e.en: Try not to {waken} the baby when you come in.
e.zh: 你进来的时候尽量别吵醒宝宝。

e.en: A loud thunderclap can {waken} even the deepest sleeper.
e.zh: 一声响雷能把睡得最沉的人都惊醒。

wakes.t:
v. 醒来（wake 的第三人称单数）
n. 守灵

e.en: She always {wakes} before her alarm goes off.
e.zh: 她总是在闹钟响之前就醒了。

e.en: Irish {wakes} are gatherings to celebrate a person's life.
e.zh: 爱尔兰守灵是聚在一起缅怀逝者一生的活动。

waking.t:
adj. 清醒的
v. 醒来（wake 的现在分词）

e.en: He spends every {waking} hour working on his startup.
e.zh: 他把醒着的每一个小时都用来打理自己的创业项目。

e.en: {Waking} up to sunshine always puts her in a good mood.
e.zh: 在阳光中醒来总让她心情很好。

e.en: Thoreau wrote {Walden} during his time at the pond.
e.zh: 梭罗在湖边居住期间写下了《瓦尔登湖》。

e.en: Many readers visit {Walden} Pond as a literary pilgrimage.
e.zh: 许多读者将造访瓦尔登湖视作一次文学朝圣。

e.en: My kids spent hours trying to find {Waldo} in the book.
e.zh: 我家孩子花了好几个小时在书里找沃尔多。

e.en: It was like searching for {Waldo} in the crowded stadium.
e.zh: 那感觉就像在拥挤的体育场里找沃尔多一样难。

waldorf.t: n. 华尔道夫（酒店名/教育法）

e.en: They sent their daughter to a {Waldorf} school for its arts focus.
e.zh: 他们把女儿送到华德福学校,看中其对艺术的重视。

e.en: She ordered a classic {Waldorf} salad with apples and walnuts.
e.zh: 她点了一份经典的华尔道夫沙拉,加苹果和核桃。

e.en: We hiked through the rolling green hills of {Wales} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们徒步穿越了威尔士起伏的青翠山丘。

e.en: {Wales} has its own language alongside English.
e.zh: 威尔士除了英语之外还拥有自己的语言。

walk.t:
v. 走，步行
n. 散步

e.en: Let's {walk} to the coffee shop on the corner.
e.zh: 咱们走路去街角那家咖啡店吧。

e.en: My morning {walk} clears my head before work.
e.zh: 每天早上散步能让我在上班前理清思路。

walkable.t: adj. 可步行的；宜步行的

e.en: The neighborhood is highly {walkable}, with shops just minutes away.
e.zh: 这个街区非常适合步行,商店几分钟就能走到。

e.en: Buyers increasingly prefer {walkable} cities over car-dependent suburbs.
e.zh: 买家越来越青睐适合步行的城市,而非依赖汽车的郊区。

walkabout.t: n. 徒步漫游；随意走动

e.en: The prime minister went on a {walkabout} to greet voters.
e.zh: 首相走出来与选民们见面交流。

e.en: He took a long {walkabout} through the Outback to clear his mind.
e.zh: 他在澳大利亚内陆漫游了很久,好让自己的头脑清醒。

e.en: The royals are famous for their friendly {walkabouts} among crowds.
e.zh: 王室成员以亲切地走入人群与民众互动而闻名。

e.en: Her solo {walkabouts} in the bush taught her self-reliance.
e.zh: 她独自在丛林中漫游的经历让她学会了自立。

e.en: I {walked} home through the park after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后我穿过公园走回家。

e.en: She {walked} out of the meeting without saying a word.
e.zh: 她一句话没说就走出了会议室。

e.en: Grandma uses a {walker} to get around the apartment.
e.zh: 奶奶在公寓里靠助行器走动。

e.en: He's a fast {walker} and always arrives early.
e.zh: 他走路很快,总是早早到达。

e.en: The trail is popular with weekend {walkers} and dog owners.
e.zh: 这条小径很受周末散步者和遛狗人的欢迎。

e.en: Hospitals provide {walkers} to patients recovering from surgery.
e.zh: 医院为术后康复的病人提供助行器。

walking.t:
n. 步行，走路
adj. 行走的

e.en: {Walking} thirty minutes a day improves your overall health.
e.zh: 每天步行三十分钟能改善整体健康状况。

e.en: I saw her {walking} her dog along the river.
e.zh: 我看到她正沿着河边遛狗。

e.en: His daily {walkings} around the lake became a beloved ritual.
e.zh: 他每天绕湖散步,成了他钟爱的日常仪式。

e.en: The diary recorded all her morning {walkings} through the village.
e.zh: 日记记录了她每天清晨在村子里的漫步。

walkman.t: n. 随身听（便携磁带/音乐播放器）

e.en: He still keeps his old Sony {Walkman} as a memento.
e.zh: 他至今还留着那台旧索尼随身听作为纪念。

e.en: In the 80s, every teenager wanted a {Walkman}.
e.zh: 在八十年代,每个青少年都想拥有一台随身听。

e.en: Workers staged a {walkout} to protest the new contract terms.
e.zh: 工人们举行罢工,以抗议新的合同条款。

e.en: The senator's {walkout} disrupted the entire vote.
e.zh: 那位参议员的退场打乱了整场投票。

walkover.t: n. 轻易取胜；不战而胜

e.en: The final match was a {walkover} for the champion.
e.zh: 决赛对冠军来说是一场轻松取胜的比赛。

e.en: Everyone expected a tough game, not a {walkover}.
e.zh: 大家都以为会是场硬仗，没想到这么轻松。

walks.t:
v. 走（第三人称单数）
n. 散步（复数）

e.en: She {walks} her dog every morning before work.
e.zh: 她每天上班前都会遛狗。

e.en: The park welcomes people from all {walks} of life.
e.zh: 这个公园欢迎各行各业的人。

walkthrough.t: n. 演练；逐步讲解；图文攻略

e.en: The video offers a clear {walkthrough} of the new app.
e.zh: 这段视频清晰演示了新应用的操作流程。

e.en: I followed a {walkthrough} to beat the final boss.
e.zh: 我按照攻略打败了最终boss。

e.en: A glass {walkway} connects the two office towers.
e.zh: 一条玻璃通道连接着两座办公楼。

e.en: Please don't block the {walkway} with your bike.
e.zh: 请不要把自行车停在通道上挡路。

wall.t:
n. 墙，墙壁
v. 用墙围住

e.en: She hung a giant poster on the bedroom {wall}.
e.zh: 她在卧室墙上挂了一张巨大的海报。

e.en: The startup hit a {wall} after losing key funding.
e.zh: 那家初创公司失去关键融资后陷入了瓶颈。

e.en: The sound editor added crowd {walla} to the cafe scene.
e.zh: 音效师为咖啡馆场景添加了人群嘈杂声。

e.en: Background {walla} makes the restaurant scene feel real.
e.zh: 背景嘈杂声让餐厅场景显得真实。

e.en: A small {wallaby} hopped across the dirt path.
e.zh: 一只小袋鼠跳过了泥路。

e.en: The zoo just welcomed a baby {wallaby} this spring.
e.zh: 动物园这个春天刚迎来了一只小袋鼠。

e.en: My neighbor {Wallace} runs a small bakery downtown.
e.zh: 我邻居华莱士在市中心经营一家小面包店。

e.en: The film tells the story of William {Wallace}.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了威廉·华莱士的故事。

e.en: My grandparents grew up in {Wallasey}, near Liverpool.
e.zh: 我祖父母在利物浦附近的沃拉西长大。

e.en: The ferry from Liverpool stops in {Wallasey}.
e.zh: 从利物浦出发的渡轮在沃拉西停靠。

e.en: The contractor installed {wallboard} throughout the basement.
e.zh: 承包商在整个地下室都安装了石膏板。

e.en: Cut the {wallboard} carefully to fit around the window.
e.zh: 小心切割石膏板，以便贴合窗户。

e.en: We ordered twenty {wallboards} for the renovation project.
e.zh: 我们为装修项目订购了二十块石膏板。

e.en: The {wallboards} arrived damaged, so we sent them back.
e.zh: 石膏板到货时已损坏，我们退了回去。

wallcovering.t: n. 墙面装饰材料；墙纸

e.en: She chose a textured {wallcovering} for the dining room.
e.zh: 她为餐厅选了一款带纹理的墙纸。

e.en: Vinyl {wallcovering} is easier to clean than paint.
e.zh: 乙烯基壁布比油漆更容易清洁。

walled.t:
adj. 有围墙的
v. 用墙围住（过去式）

e.en: The old town is still {walled} on three sides.
e.zh: 这座古城三面仍有城墙环绕。

e.en: Tech giants build {walled} gardens around their platforms.
e.zh: 科技巨头在自己的平台周围构筑封闭生态。

e.en: Fats {Waller} was a legendary jazz pianist and singer.
e.zh: 法茨·沃勒是一位传奇的爵士钢琴家兼歌手。

e.en: My coworker {Waller} just got promoted to manager.
e.zh: 我的同事沃勒刚刚升职为经理。

wallet.t: n. 钱包；（加密货币）钱包

e.en: I think I left my {wallet} on the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 我好像把钱包落在厨房台面上了。

e.en: Connect your crypto {wallet} to start trading on the platform.
e.zh: 连接你的加密钱包即可在平台上开始交易。

e.en: Most digital {wallets} now support contactless payments.
e.zh: 大多数电子钱包现在都支持非接触支付。

e.en: Rising prices are squeezing consumers' {wallets} this year.
e.zh: 今年物价上涨让消费者的钱包压力很大。

e.en: He caught a huge {walleye} on the lake yesterday.
e.zh: 他昨天在湖里钓到一条大梭鲈。

e.en: Grilled {walleye} is a summer favorite up north.
e.zh: 烤梭鲈是北方夏天最受欢迎的菜。

wallflower.t: n. 壁花（舞会无人邀请者）；桂竹香

e.en: She used to be a {wallflower} at high school dances.
e.zh: 她以前在中学舞会上总是个角落里的腼腆者。

e.en: Don't be a {wallflower} — come join the conversation.
e.zh: 别躲在角落里，过来一起聊聊吧。

e.en: The team is {walling} off the new construction zone.
e.zh: 团队正在用围墙圈出新的施工区域。

e.en: He's been {walling} himself off from his friends lately.
e.zh: 他最近一直在把自己与朋友隔绝开来。

e.en: My cousin moved to {Wallingford} for a teaching job.
e.zh: 我表弟为了一份教师工作搬到了沃林福德。

e.en: {Wallingford} has some of the best coffee shops in Seattle.
e.zh: 沃林福德拥有西雅图一些最棒的咖啡店。

e.en: The train to {Wallington} runs every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 开往沃灵顿的火车每十五分钟一班。

e.en: She grew up in a quiet suburb of {Wallington}.
e.zh: 她在沃灵顿一个安静的郊区长大。

e.en: {Wallis} Simpson became famous for her romance with the king.
e.zh: 沃利斯·辛普森因与国王的恋情而出名。

e.en: My friend {Wallis} just published her first novel.
e.zh: 我的朋友沃利斯刚出版了她的第一本小说。

walloon.t:
n. 瓦隆人；瓦隆语
adj. 瓦隆的

e.en: He speaks French with a strong {Walloon} accent.
e.zh: 他说法语带有浓重的瓦隆口音。

e.en: The {Walloon} region is in southern Belgium.
e.zh: 瓦隆地区位于比利时南部。

wallop.t:
v. 猛击；痛打
n. 重击

e.en: The boxer landed a hard {wallop} on his opponent's jaw.
e.zh: 拳手对着对手下巴狠狠击出一记重拳。

e.en: This new chili sauce really packs a {wallop}.
e.zh: 这款新辣酱劲道十足。

walloping.t:
adj. 巨大的
n. 痛打，惨败

e.en: Our team took a {walloping} in last night's game.
e.zh: 我们队在昨晚的比赛中惨败。

e.en: He gave the rug a {walloping} to shake out the dust.
e.zh: 他狠狠拍打地毯，把灰尘抖出来。

wallow.t:
v. 打滚；沉溺于
n. 打滚

e.en: Don't just {wallow} in self-pity — do something about it.
e.zh: 别只顾着自怨自艾，去做点什么吧。

e.en: Pigs love to {wallow} in cool mud on hot days.
e.zh: 猪在炎热天气里喜欢在凉泥里打滚。

waaf.t: n. 英国女子辅助空军

e.en: Her grandmother served in the {WAAF} during World War II.
e.zh: 她祖母在二战期间曾在英国皇家空军妇女辅助队服役。

e.en: The museum displayed uniforms once worn by {WAAF} members.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了曾由皇家空军妇女辅助队成员穿过的制服。

wacc.t: n. 加权平均资本成本

e.en: Analysts use {WACC} to evaluate whether a project creates value.
e.zh: 分析师用加权平均资本成本来评估项目是否创造价值。

e.en: The company's {WACC} dropped after refinancing its debt.
e.zh: 公司在债务再融资后,加权平均资本成本下降了。

wack.t: adj. 差劲的、糟糕的（俚语）

e.en: That movie ending was totally {wack}.
e.zh: 那部电影的结局简直烂透了。

e.en: He thought the new app design was kind of {wack}.
e.zh: 他觉得新版应用的设计有点糟糕。

e.en: The show is loved for its charm and pure {wackiness}.
e.zh: 这部剧因其魅力和纯粹的搞怪风格而备受喜爱。

e.en: Her {wackiness} always lightened the mood at meetings.
e.zh: 她的古灵精怪总能让会议气氛轻松起来。

wacko.t:
n. 疯子、怪人
adj. 神经兮兮的

e.en: Some {wacko} on the internet keeps sending him strange messages.
e.zh: 网上某个怪人不停给他发奇怪的消息。

e.en: His ideas sounded {wacko} but actually worked brilliantly.
e.zh: 他的想法听起来很疯狂,但实际效果非常好。

e.en: He came up with a {wacky} idea for the science fair.
e.zh: 他为科学展想出了一个古怪的点子。

e.en: The kids love that show's {wacky} cartoon characters.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢那部剧里古怪滑稽的卡通角色。

waco.t: n. 韦科（美国得州城市）

e.en: {Waco} is a city in central Texas, USA.
e.zh: 韦科是美国得克萨斯州中部的一座城市。

e.en: The 1993 {Waco} siege remains a controversial historical event.
e.zh: 1993年的韦科围困事件至今仍是有争议的历史事件。

wad.t:
n. 一沓（钞票）、一团
v. 揉成团

e.en: She {wadded} up the rejection letter and tossed it away.
e.zh: 她把那封拒信揉成一团扔掉了。

e.en: He {wadded} paper into the hole to block the draft.
e.zh: 他把纸团塞进洞里挡住穿堂风。

e.en: The jacket is filled with soft cotton {wadding} for warmth.
e.zh: 这件夹克里填了柔软的棉絮以保暖。

e.en: Quilters use polyester {wadding} between the fabric layers.
e.zh: 做被子的人会在布料夹层中放涤纶填充棉。

waddle.t:
v. 摇摇摆摆地走
n. 蹒跚步态

e.en: Penguins {waddle} across the ice in single file.
e.zh: 企鹅排成一列摇摇摆摆地走过冰面。

e.en: The toddler began to {waddle} toward her mother.
e.zh: 那个小孩开始摇摇晃晃地朝妈妈走去。

e.en: We had to {wade} through knee-deep water to reach shore.
e.zh: 我们不得不蹚过齐膝深的水才到岸边。

e.en: I still need to {wade} through hundreds of unread emails.
e.zh: 我还得费力处理几百封没读的邮件。

wader.t:
n. 涉水者、涉禽
n. 高筒防水靴

e.en: The fisherman pulled on his rubber {wader} and stepped in.
e.zh: 渔夫穿上橡胶涉水裤走进了水里。

e.en: A long-legged {wader} stalked fish in the shallow marsh.
e.zh: 一只长腿涉禽在浅沼泽中捕食小鱼。

wadi.t: n. 干河床（中东、北非地区）

e.en: Flash floods can fill a dry {wadi} within minutes.
e.zh: 山洪能在几分钟内灌满一条干涸的旱谷。

e.en: Bedouin guides led us through a narrow desert {wadi}.
e.zh: 贝都因向导带我们穿过一条狭窄的沙漠旱谷。

e.en: Children were {wading} happily in the shallow stream.
e.zh: 孩子们在浅溪里开心地蹚水玩。

e.en: I'm {wading} through tax paperwork all weekend.
e.zh: 我整个周末都在费力处理报税材料。

wafer.t:
n. 晶圆（半导体）
n. 薄饼、威化饼

e.en: She served ice cream with a thin chocolate {wafer}.
e.zh: 她端上冰淇淋，配了一片薄薄的巧克力威化。

e.en: Each silicon {wafer} can yield hundreds of computer chips.
e.zh: 每片硅晶圆可以产出数百个电脑芯片。

waffle.t:
n. 华夫饼
v. 含糊其辞

e.en: I had a Belgian {waffle} with strawberries for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐吃了一份配草莓的比利时华夫饼。

e.en: Stop the {waffle} and just answer the question directly.
e.zh: 别再含糊其辞了，直接回答问题。

waffling.t: v. 含糊其辞、犹豫不决

e.en: The senator keeps {waffling} on his climate policy stance.
e.zh: 那位参议员在气候政策立场上一直摇摆不定。

e.en: Stop {waffling} and tell me which option you prefer.
e.zh: 别再含糊其辞，告诉我你更喜欢哪个选项。

waft.t:
v. 飘荡、飘送
n. 一阵（香气等）

e.en: The smell of fresh bread began to {waft} from the kitchen.
e.zh: 新鲜面包的香味开始从厨房飘出来。

e.en: A gentle breeze made the curtains {waft} into the room.
e.zh: 微风让窗帘轻轻飘进了房间。

wag.t:
v. (尾巴) 摇摆
n. 摇动

wage.t:
n. 工资、报酬
v. 发动（战争）

e.en: The minimum {wage} in the city went up last month.
e.zh: 该市的最低工资上个月上调了。

e.en: Activists continue to {wage} a campaign against plastic waste.
e.zh: 活动人士持续发起反对塑料垃圾的运动。

wallowed.t: v. 沉溺；打滚（wallow 的过去式）

e.en: He {wallowed} in nostalgia after watching old home videos.
e.zh: 看完老家庭录像后，他沉浸在怀旧情绪中。

e.en: The hippos {wallowed} happily in the muddy riverbank.
e.zh: 河马们在泥泞的河岸上开心地打滚。

wallowing.t: v. 沉溺于；打滚（wallow 的现在分词）

e.en: Stop {wallowing} in regret and focus on what's next.
e.zh: 别再沉溺于懊悔，专注于接下来的事吧。

e.en: The buffalo were {wallowing} in the shallow pond.
e.zh: 水牛们正在浅水塘里打滚。

wallows.t: v. 沉溺；打滚（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {wallows} in misery whenever his team loses.
e.zh: 每当他支持的球队输球，他就深陷痛苦中。

e.en: The novel {wallows} a bit too much in melodrama.
e.zh: 这本小说在煽情上有点过头。

wallpaper.t:
n. 壁纸；桌面背景
v. 贴壁纸

e.en: I changed the {wallpaper} on my phone this morning.
e.zh: 我今天早上换了手机的壁纸。

e.en: The old {wallpaper} in the hallway is starting to peel.
e.zh: 走廊里的旧墙纸开始脱落了。

e.en: Thin {walls} mean I can hear my neighbors clearly.
e.zh: 墙壁太薄，我能清楚听到邻居的声音。

e.en: Social media {walls} are flooded with vacation photos lately.
e.zh: 最近社交媒体的墙上充斥着度假照片。

wallsend.t: n. 沃尔森德（英国地名）

e.en: {Wallsend} sits at the eastern end of Hadrian's Wall.
e.zh: 沃尔森德位于哈德良长城的东端。

e.en: The shipyards in {Wallsend} once employed thousands.
e.zh: 沃尔森德的造船厂曾雇用了数千人。

e.en: Don't be a {wally} — read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别犯傻，先看看说明书。

e.en: My uncle {Wally} tells the funniest stories at dinner.
e.zh: 我的沃利叔叔在晚餐时讲的故事最逗。

e.en: She added chopped {walnut} to the brownie batter.
e.zh: 她在布朗尼面糊里加了切碎的核桃。

e.en: The desk is made of beautiful dark {walnut} wood.
e.zh: 这张书桌是用漂亮的深色胡桃木做的。

e.en: I love sprinkling {walnuts} on my morning oatmeal.
e.zh: 我喜欢在早晨的燕麦粥上撒些核桃。

e.en: California produces most of the world's {walnuts}.
e.zh: 加州生产了全世界大部分的核桃。

e.en: Robert {Walpole} is often called Britain's first prime minister.
e.zh: 罗伯特·沃波尔常被称为英国首位首相。

e.en: We spent a quiet weekend in {Walpole}, Massachusetts.
e.zh: 我们在马萨诸塞州沃波尔度过了一个安静的周末。

e.en: A massive {walrus} basked on the rocky beach.
e.zh: 一只巨大的海象在岩石海滩上晒太阳。

e.en: He grew a thick {walrus} mustache over the winter.
e.zh: 他在冬天留起了浓密的海象式胡子。

walsall.t: n. 沃尔索尔（英国城市）

e.en: My dad worked in a {Walsall} leather factory for years.
e.zh: 我爸爸在沃尔索尔的一家皮革厂工作了多年。

e.en: {Walsall} is a market town in the West Midlands.
e.zh: 沃尔索尔是西米德兰兹郡的一座集镇。

walsham.t: n. 沃尔沙姆（英国地名）

e.en: We rented a cottage in North {Walsham} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在北沃尔沙姆租了一间小屋。

e.en: The village of {Walsham} has a charming old church.
e.zh: 沃尔沙姆村有一座迷人的古老教堂。

walsingham.t: n. 沃尔辛厄姆（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: Pilgrims have visited {Walsingham} for nearly a thousand years.
e.zh: 朝圣者前往沃尔辛厄姆已有近千年历史。

e.en: Francis {Walsingham} ran Queen Elizabeth's spy network.
e.zh: 弗朗西斯·沃尔辛厄姆掌管着伊丽莎白女王的间谍网。

e.en: My sister teaches at a college in {Waltham}, Massachusetts.
e.zh: 我姐姐在马萨诸塞州沃尔瑟姆的一所大学任教。

e.en: {Waltham} was once famous for its watch factories.
e.zh: 沃尔瑟姆曾以其制表厂而闻名。

walthamstow.t: n. 沃尔瑟姆斯托（伦敦地名）

e.en: Rents in {Walthamstow} have risen sharply over recent years.
e.zh: 近年来沃尔瑟姆斯托的房租大幅上涨。

e.en: The Victoria line ends at {Walthamstow} Central station.
e.zh: 维多利亚线的终点站是沃尔瑟姆斯托中央站。

e.en: My friend {Walton} just opened a coffee shop downtown.
e.zh: 我的朋友沃尔顿刚在市中心开了一家咖啡店。

e.en: Sam {Walton} founded the retail giant Walmart in 1962.
e.zh: 萨姆·沃尔顿于1962年创立了零售巨头沃尔玛。

waltz.t:
n. 华尔兹
v. 跳华尔兹

e.en: They learned to {waltz} for their wedding dance.
e.zh: 他们为婚礼舞蹈学跳了华尔兹。

e.en: You can't just {waltz} into the meeting late.
e.zh: 你不能就这样大摇大摆地迟到走进会议。

walworth.t: n. 沃尔沃思（伦敦地名）

e.en: {Walworth} Road is known for its bustling street market.
e.zh: 沃尔沃斯路以其热闹的街头集市而闻名。

e.en: She grew up in a council flat in {Walworth}.
e.zh: 她在沃尔沃斯的一套公租房里长大。

wampum.t: n. 贝壳串珠（北美原住民用作货币）

e.en: Native tribes used {wampum} as both currency and record.
e.zh: 原住民部落把贝壳珠串既当作货币也当作记录工具。

e.en: The museum displays a beautifully crafted {wampum} belt.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一条做工精美的贝壳珠腰带。

e.en: Harry waved his {wand} and the lights flickered on.
e.zh: 哈利挥了挥魔杖，灯就闪烁着亮了起来。

e.en: The technician scanned the package with a barcode {wand}.
e.zh: 技术员用条码扫描棒扫了一下包裹。

e.en: I love to {wander} through the old town on weekends.
e.zh: 我喜欢周末在老城里随意闲逛。

e.en: My mind tends to {wander} during long meetings.
e.zh: 我在冗长的会议中常常会走神。

wandered.t: v. 漫步；徘徊（wander 的过去式）

e.en: We {wandered} around the night market for hours.
e.zh: 我们在夜市里逛了好几个小时。

e.en: His attention {wandered} as the lecture dragged on.
e.zh: 讲座越拖越长，他的注意力开始游离。

e.en: He's always been a {wanderer}, never staying anywhere long.
e.zh: 他一直是个漂泊者，从不在一个地方久留。

e.en: The lonely {wanderer} finally found a place to call home.
e.zh: 那位孤独的漂泊者终于找到了可以称为家的地方。

wandering.t:
v. 漫游；徘徊
adj. 流浪的

e.en: We spent the afternoon {wandering} through the old town.
e.zh: 我们整个下午在老城区闲逛。

e.en: His {wandering} mind made it hard to focus on lectures.
e.zh: 他思绪游离，很难专注于讲课。

e.en: She wrote a memoir about her {wanderings} across Asia.
e.zh: 她写了一本回忆录，记录她在亚洲的漫游经历。

e.en: The poet's {wanderings} inspired much of his later work.
e.zh: 诗人的漫游经历启发了他后来的许多作品。

wanderlust.t: n. 旅行癖；远游的渴望

e.en: Her {wanderlust} took her to over fifty countries.
e.zh: 她的旅行癖带她去过五十多个国家。

e.en: Reading travel blogs only fueled my {wanderlust}.
e.zh: 读旅行博客只会让我更想去远方。

wanders.t: v. 漫步；徘徊（第三人称单数）

e.en: My cat {wanders} around the garden every morning.
e.zh: 我的猫每天早上都在花园里闲逛。

e.en: His attention often {wanders} during long meetings.
e.zh: 他在长会议中常常走神。

wandsworth.t: n. 旺兹沃思（伦敦地区）

e.en: They moved to {Wandsworth} for the better schools.
e.zh: 他们为了更好的学校搬到了旺兹沃思区。

e.en: {Wandsworth} is a leafy borough in southwest London.
e.zh: 旺兹沃思是伦敦西南部一个绿树成荫的自治市。

wane.t:
v. 减弱；衰退
n. (月) 亏缺

e.en: Public interest in the show began to {wane} after season three.
e.zh: 第三季之后，观众对该剧的兴趣开始减退。

e.en: The moon is on the {wane} this week.
e.zh: 这周月亮正在亏缺。

waned.t: v. 减弱；衰退（wane 的过去式）

e.en: His enthusiasm for the project {waned} over time.
e.zh: 他对这个项目的热情随着时间逐渐减退。

e.en: The empire's power {waned} in the late nineteenth century.
e.zh: 该帝国的势力在十九世纪末日渐衰落。

wanes.t: v. 减弱；衰退（第三人称单数）

e.en: Interest in fad diets quickly {wanes} after a few months.
e.zh: 对潮流减肥法的兴趣几个月后就迅速消退。

e.en: As daylight {wanes}, the streetlights flicker on.
e.zh: 随着日光渐弱，路灯纷纷亮起。

e.en: Mr. {Wang} owns the noodle shop on the corner.
e.zh: 王先生开着街角那家面馆。

e.en: Professor {Wang} published a paper on quantum computing.
e.zh: 王教授发表了一篇关于量子计算的论文。

e.en: He managed to {wangle} a free upgrade to business class.
e.zh: 他设法弄到了一次免费升级到商务舱。

e.en: She tried to {wangle} an invitation to the gala.
e.zh: 她想方设法弄到一张晚会的请柬。

waning.t:
v. 减弱；衰退（现在分词）
adj. 渐亏的

e.en: Support for the policy is clearly {waning}.
e.zh: 对该政策的支持明显在减弱。

e.en: They sat outside under the {waning} moon.
e.zh: 他们坐在外面，月亮正在亏缺。

e.en: He dismissed the speech as a load of {wank}.
e.zh: 他把那场演讲贬为一堆废话。

e.en: The whole pitch sounded like marketing {wank} to me.
e.zh: 整个推销听起来就像是营销废话。

wanker.t: n. 蠢货；混蛋（英式粗俗俚语）

e.en: Stop being such a {wanker} and apologize already.
e.zh: 别再这么混蛋了，赶紧道歉吧。

e.en: The driver who cut us off was a total {wanker}.
e.zh: 那个加塞的司机简直是个混账。

e.en: She smiled {wanly} when asked how she felt.
e.zh: 被问到感觉如何时，她无力地笑了笑。

e.en: He waved {wanly} from the hospital bed.
e.zh: 他在病床上虚弱地挥了挥手。

wannabe.t: n. 想成名者；模仿追星族

e.en: The café was full of {wannabe} novelists tapping at laptops.
e.zh: 咖啡馆里满是敲着笔记本电脑的小说家梦想者。

e.en: He's just a {wannabe} influencer chasing followers.
e.zh: 他只是个追着粉丝跑的网红预备役。

want.t:
v. 想要；需要
n. 需要；缺乏

e.en: I {want} a coffee before the meeting starts.
e.zh: 我想在会议开始前来杯咖啡。

e.en: Do you {want} me to pick you up tonight?
e.zh: 今晚要我去接你吗？

e.en: {Wantage} is a small market town in Oxfordshire.
e.zh: 万蒂奇是牛津郡的一个小集镇。

e.en: King Alfred the Great was born in {Wantage}.
e.zh: 阿尔弗雷德大帝出生于万蒂奇。

wanted.t:
v. 想要（过去式）
adj. 被通缉的

e.en: She {wanted} to study abroad for a year.
e.zh: 她想要出国留学一年。

e.en: The suspect is {wanted} in three different states.
e.zh: 该嫌疑人在三个州被通缉。

wanting.t:
adj. 缺乏的；不足的
v. want 的现在分词

e.en: The new software was found {wanting} in several areas.
e.zh: 这款新软件在几个方面被认为不足。

e.en: I've been {wanting} to try that restaurant for months.
e.zh: 我好几个月都想去试试那家餐厅。

e.en: The report condemned the {wanton} destruction of the forest.
e.zh: 报告谴责了对森林的肆意破坏。

e.en: Such {wanton} cruelty shocked the entire community.
e.zh: 如此恣意的残忍震惊了整个社区。

e.en: The vandals {wantonly} smashed every window on the street.
e.zh: 那些破坏者肆意砸碎了街上每一扇窗户。

e.en: Resources were {wantonly} wasted during the project.
e.zh: 项目期间资源被肆意浪费。

e.en: The film depicts the {wantonness} of unchecked power.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了不受约束权力的恣意妄为。

e.en: There was a cruel {wantonness} in his actions.
e.zh: 他的行为中带着一种残忍的肆意。

wants.t:
v. 想要（want 的第三人称单数）
n. 需求

e.en: She {wants} to learn Mandarin before her trip.
e.zh: 她想在旅行前学好普通话。

e.en: Modern advertising creates new {wants} every day.
e.zh: 现代广告每天都在制造新的欲望。

e.en: A herd of {wapiti} grazed near the lake at dawn.
e.zh: 一群马鹿黎明时在湖边吃草。

e.en: The {wapiti} is the largest deer species in North America.
e.zh: 马鹿是北美洲最大的鹿科动物。

e.en: They opened a riverside pub in {Wapping}.
e.zh: 他们在沃平开了一家河边酒吧。

e.en: {Wapping} was once the heart of London's docklands.
e.zh: 沃平曾经是伦敦码头区的中心。

war.t:
n. 战争
v. 作战

e.en: The museum restored a vintage {warbird} from World War II.
e.zh: 博物馆修复了一架二战时期的老式军机。

e.en: Crowds gathered to watch the {warbird} fly past.
e.zh: 人群聚集观看那架老军机飞过。

warble.t:
v. (鸟) 婉转鸣叫
n. 颤音

e.en: You can hear the robins {warble} at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时你能听到知更鸟婉转鸣唱。

e.en: She tried to {warble} the high notes of the aria.
e.zh: 她试着用颤音唱出咏叹调的高音。

e.en: A tiny yellow {warbler} landed on the feeder.
e.zh: 一只小小的黄色鸣禽落在喂食器上。

e.en: Birdwatchers travel for miles to spot a rare {warbler}.
e.zh: 观鸟者会跑很远去寻找一种罕见的鸣禽。

warbling.t: v. 婉转鸣唱（warble 的现在分词）

e.en: The {warbling} of larks filled the meadow.
e.zh: 云雀的鸣啭充满了整片草地。

e.en: She kept {warbling} along to the radio in the car.
e.zh: 她在车里一直跟着收音机婉转地哼唱。

e.en: The {Warburg} Institute holds a famous library on cultural history.
e.zh: 瓦尔堡研究院藏有一座著名的文化史图书馆。

e.en: Otto {Warburg} won the Nobel Prize for his cancer research.
e.zh: 奥托·瓦尔堡因癌症研究获得诺贝尔奖。

e.en: {Warburton} is one of the largest bakeries in Britain.
e.zh: 沃伯顿是英国最大的面包店之一。

e.en: Mrs. {Warburton} taught chemistry at our high school.
e.zh: 沃伯顿太太在我们高中教化学。

ward.t:
n. 病房；选区
v. 避开

e.en: She was admitted to the children's {ward} last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚被收入了儿童病房。

e.en: The candidate won every {ward} in the city.
e.zh: 那位候选人在市里每个选区都获胜。

e.en: The park {warden} warned us about bears in the area.
e.zh: 公园管理员提醒我们这一带有熊出没。

e.en: The prison {warden} announced new visiting hours.
e.zh: 监狱长宣布了新的探视时间。

e.en: A uniformed {warder} unlocked the heavy iron gate.
e.zh: 一名身穿制服的狱警打开了沉重的铁门。

e.en: The Tower of London is guarded by ceremonial {warder}s.
e.zh: 伦敦塔由礼仪卫士守卫。

e.en: My winter {wardrobe} needs a serious update.
e.zh: 我的冬季衣橱需要彻底更新一下。

e.en: She hung the dress in the {wardrobe} by the door.
e.zh: 她把那件裙子挂进门边的衣柜里。

e.en: The bedroom has built-in {wardrobes} along one wall.
e.zh: 卧室一面墙做了嵌入式衣柜。

e.en: Celebrities often have stylists managing their {wardrobes}.
e.zh: 明星们通常有造型师打理他们的全部服装。

e.en: The officers gathered in the {wardroom} for dinner.
e.zh: 军官们聚在军官室共进晚餐。

e.en: A portrait of the captain hung in the {wardroom}.
e.zh: 舰长的肖像挂在军官室里。

wards.t:
n. 病房（复数）
v. 避开（第三人称单数）

e.en: The hospital expanded its pediatric {wards} last year.
e.zh: 医院去年扩建了儿科病房。

e.en: He {wards} off colds by taking vitamin C daily.
e.zh: 他每天服用维生素C来预防感冒。

e.en: The court granted {wardship} of the child to her aunt.
e.zh: 法院将该儿童的监护权判给了她姨妈。

e.en: Medieval lords often profited from {wardship} of young heirs.
e.zh: 中世纪领主常通过对年幼继承人的监护权获利。

e.en: The shop sells handmade ceramic {ware} from Japan.
e.zh: 这家店出售来自日本的手工陶器。

e.en: Street vendors displayed their {ware} along the promenade.
e.zh: 街头小贩沿着步道摆出他们的货品。

e.en: We stopped in {Wareham} on the way to the coast.
e.zh: 我们去海边的路上在韦勒姆停了一下。

e.en: {Wareham} is a historic town in Dorset, England.
e.zh: 韦勒姆是英国多塞特郡的一个历史小镇。

warehouse.t:
n. 仓库
v. 存入仓库

e.en: The Amazon {warehouse} runs twenty-four hours a day.
e.zh: 亚马逊的仓库二十四小时运转。

e.en: They converted the old {warehouse} into trendy lofts.
e.zh: 他们把旧仓库改造成了时尚公寓。

e.en: The {warehouseman} signed for the incoming shipment.
e.zh: 仓库管理员在进货单上签了字。

e.en: He worked as a {warehouseman} before joining the office.
e.zh: 进办公室工作前，他做过仓库工人。

e.en: The company operates {warehouses} in twelve countries.
e.zh: 该公司在十二个国家运营仓库。

e.en: Old {warehouses} along the river are now art galleries.
e.zh: 河边的旧仓库如今变成了艺术画廊。

e.en: Cloud {warehousing} has transformed how data is stored.
e.zh: 云数据仓储改变了数据存储的方式。

e.en: The startup offers fulfillment and {warehousing} services.
e.zh: 这家初创公司提供订单履行和仓储服务。

e.en: Artisans displayed their {wares} at the weekend market.
e.zh: 工匠们在周末集市上展示自己的商品。

e.en: He travels the country selling his pottery {wares}.
e.zh: 他周游全国销售他的陶器。

e.en: Cyber {warfare} has become a major national security concern.
e.zh: 网络战已成为国家安全的重要议题。

e.en: The novel explores the horrors of trench {warfare}.
e.zh: 这部小说揭示了堑壕战的恐怖。

e.en: The course examines different {warfares} throughout history.
e.zh: 这门课考察历史上各种不同的战争形态。

e.en: Modern conflicts often blend conventional and unconventional {warfares}.
e.zh: 现代冲突常常融合常规与非常规作战方式。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {warfarin} to prevent blood clots.
e.zh: 医生开了华法林以预防血栓。

e.en: Patients on {warfarin} need regular blood tests.
e.zh: 服用华法林的患者需要定期验血。

e.en: He spent the weekend painting his {Warhammer} miniatures.
e.zh: 他整个周末都在给战锤模型上色。

e.en: {Warhammer} tournaments draw thousands of fans every year.
e.zh: 战锤锦标赛每年吸引成千上万的爱好者。

e.en: The missile carries a nuclear {warhead} capable of massive destruction.
e.zh: 这枚导弹携带可造成巨大破坏的核弹头。

e.en: Inspectors counted every {warhead} stored at the facility.
e.zh: 检查员清点了设施内储存的每一枚弹头。

warhol.t: n. 沃霍尔（安迪·沃霍尔）

e.en: The museum displayed several {warhol} prints from the sixties.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几幅六十年代的沃霍尔版画。

e.en: Andy {warhol} turned soup cans into iconic art.
e.zh: 安迪·沃霍尔把汤罐头变成了标志性艺术作品。

e.en: The old senator is a political {warhorse} who never tires.
e.zh: 这位老参议员是位永不疲倦的政坛老将。

e.en: That symphony is a concert {warhorse} played every season.
e.zh: 那部交响曲是每个乐季必演的经典曲目。

e.en: She eyed the stranger {warily} before opening the door.
e.zh: 她警觉地打量着陌生人才打开门。

e.en: Investors are moving {warily} after last week's market crash.
e.zh: 上周股市暴跌后,投资者正谨慎行事。

e.en: His {wariness} of online scams kept his savings safe.
e.zh: 他对网络骗局的警惕守住了他的积蓄。

e.en: There's growing {wariness} about sharing personal data with apps.
e.zh: 人们对向应用分享个人数据越来越警惕。

e.en: The village of {wark} sits quietly along the river Tweed.
e.zh: 沃克村静静地坐落在特威德河畔。

e.en: Tourists often photograph the ruins of {wark} castle.
e.zh: 游客们常常拍摄沃克城堡的废墟。

e.en: The tribe had a fierce, {warlike} reputation among neighbors.
e.zh: 这个部落在邻邦中以好战凶猛著称。

e.en: His {warlike} tone in the meeting alarmed everyone present.
e.zh: 他在会议上好斗的语气让在场的人都很警觉。

e.en: In the game, the {warlock} summons demons to fight.
e.zh: 在游戏里,术士召唤恶魔参战。

e.en: The novel features a {warlock} who lost his powers.
e.zh: 小说讲述了一位失去法力的男巫师。

e.en: A local {warlord} controlled the trade routes for decades.
e.zh: 一位地方军阀控制贸易路线长达数十年。

e.en: The region collapsed into chaos under competing {warlord} factions.
e.zh: 该地区在各军阀派系争斗下陷入混乱。

warm.t:
adj. 温暖的
v. 加热；变暖

e.en: The kitchen feels {warm} and inviting on cold mornings.
e.zh: 寒冷的早晨,厨房显得温暖而舒适。

e.en: She gave him a {warm} smile across the room.
e.zh: 她隔着房间向他露出温暖的微笑。

warmed.t: v. 加热（warm 的过去式）

e.en: I {warmed} the leftover soup in the microwave.
e.zh: 我用微波炉把剩汤热了一下。

e.en: Her kindness {warmed} my heart on a difficult day.
e.zh: 在艰难的日子里,她的善意温暖了我的心。

warmer.t:
n. 加热器
adj. 更温暖的

e.en: Today is much {warmer} than yesterday's freezing weather.
e.zh: 今天比昨天的严寒天气暖和多了。

e.en: He plugged in the bottle {warmer} for the baby.
e.zh: 他给宝宝插上了奶瓶加热器。

warming.t:
n. 变暖；加热
v. warm 的现在分词

e.en: Global {warming} is reshaping coastlines around the world.
e.zh: 全球变暖正在重塑世界各地的海岸线。

e.en: A {warming} bowl of soup is perfect for winter evenings.
e.zh: 一碗暖身的汤最适合冬日的夜晚。

e.en: The bakery offers free {warmings} of pastries with coffee.
e.zh: 这家面包店提供免费加热糕点搭配咖啡。

e.en: Climate scientists track multiple {warmings} across different ocean layers.
e.zh: 气候科学家追踪不同海洋层的多次升温现象。

warminster.t: n. 沃明斯特（英国地名）

e.en: The army training base near {warminster} hosts regular exercises.
e.zh: 沃明斯特附近的陆军训练基地定期举行演习。

e.en: She drove through {warminster} on her way to Bath.
e.zh: 她在前往巴斯的路上经过沃明斯特。

e.en: The host greeted every guest {warmly} at the door.
e.zh: 主人在门口热情地迎接每一位客人。

e.en: Critics spoke {warmly} about the director's latest film.
e.zh: 评论家们对导演的最新影片赞誉有加。

e.en: Critics labeled the senator a dangerous {warmonger} after the speech.
e.zh: 演讲后,评论家把这位参议员斥为危险的战争贩子。

e.en: History remembers him as a {warmonger}, not a peacemaker.
e.zh: 历史记住他是个战争贩子,而非和平缔造者。

warms.t: v. warm 的第三人称单数，变暖、加热

e.en: Sunlight {warms} the wooden floor every afternoon.
e.zh: 每天下午阳光都会把木地板晒得暖暖的。

e.en: Her laughter always {warms} the whole room.
e.zh: 她的笑声总能温暖整个房间。

e.en: I missed the {warmth} of home while traveling abroad.
e.zh: 在国外旅行时,我很想念家的温暖。

e.en: The fireplace gave off a steady {warmth} all night.
e.zh: 壁炉整夜散发着稳定的暖意。

e.en: Doctors {warn} that too much sugar harms your health.
e.zh: 医生警告说,糖摄入过多会损害健康。

e.en: I should {warn} you that the path gets slippery.
e.zh: 我得提醒你,这条路会变得很滑。

warned.t: v. warn 的过去式，已警告

e.en: She {warned} me about the long lines at the airport.
e.zh: 她提醒过我机场会有长队。

e.en: Officials {warned} residents to evacuate before the hurricane arrived.
e.zh: 官员警告居民在飓风到来前撤离。

e.en: The film was produced by {warner} Bros. last summer.
e.zh: 这部电影由华纳兄弟去年夏天制作。

e.en: Mr. {warner} has taught math at this school for years.
e.zh: 沃纳先生在这所学校教数学很多年了。

warning.t:
n. 警告；警示
adj. 警示的

e.en: The app sent a {warning} about suspicious login activity.
e.zh: 应用程序发出了关于可疑登录活动的警告。

e.en: Without {warning}, the lights suddenly went out.
e.zh: 灯没有任何预兆地突然熄灭了。

e.en: She raised her finger {warningly} as the children grew loud.
e.zh: 孩子们吵闹起来时,她警告地举起手指。

e.en: The dog growled {warningly} at the approaching stranger.
e.zh: 狗向走近的陌生人警告地低吼着。

warnings.t: n. warning 的复数，警告、警示

e.en: Weather {warnings} flashed across every phone in the area.
e.zh: 该地区每部手机都闪现着天气警报。

e.en: He ignored repeated {warnings} from his doctor about smoking.
e.zh: 他无视医生反复就吸烟发出的警告。

warns.t: v. warn 的第三人称单数，警告

e.en: The label {warns} against using the product near open flames.
e.zh: 标签警告不要在明火附近使用该产品。

e.en: My mother always {warns} me to drive carefully at night.
e.zh: 妈妈总是叮嘱我夜里开车要小心。

warp.t:
v. 使扭曲；使变形
n. 经线；翘曲

e.en: Humidity can {warp} wooden doors over time.
e.zh: 潮湿天气久了会让木门变形。

e.en: Social media tends to {warp} our sense of reality.
e.zh: 社交媒体往往会扭曲我们对现实的感知。

warpaint.t: n. 战妆；出征前的涂彩

e.en: She put on her {warpaint} before the big presentation.
e.zh: 重要演讲前,她精心化了战斗妆。

e.en: The dancers wore traditional {warpaint} for the ceremony.
e.zh: 舞者们为仪式涂上传统的战纹彩绘。

warpath.t: n. 出征之路；备战状态

e.en: My boss is on the {warpath} after the missed deadline.
e.zh: 错过截止日期后,老板正在大发雷霆。

e.en: Activists went on the {warpath} against the new tax law.
e.zh: 活动人士对新税法发起了猛烈攻势。

e.en: The old vinyl record was badly {warped} and unplayable.
e.zh: 那张老黑胶唱片严重变形,无法播放。

e.en: He has a {warped} sense of humor that confuses people.
e.zh: 他有种扭曲的幽默感,让人摸不着头脑。

e.en: The heat is {warping} the plastic shelves in the garage.
e.zh: 高温正在使车库里的塑料架变形。

e.en: Algorithms keep {warping} how teenagers see themselves online.
e.zh: 算法不断扭曲青少年在网络上对自我的认知。

e.en: A vintage {warplane} flew over the parade route slowly.
e.zh: 一架老式战机缓缓飞过游行路线。

e.en: The museum's main hall displays a restored {warplane}.
e.zh: 博物馆主厅展出着一架修复过的战机。

warrant.t:
n. 授权令；搜查令
v. 保证；使有必要

e.en: Police need a {warrant} before searching your home.
e.zh: 警方搜查你家之前需要搜查令。

e.en: These minor issues don't {warrant} a full investigation.
e.zh: 这些小问题不足以引起全面调查。

warrantable.t: adj. 可保证的；有正当理由的

e.en: Defects discovered within a year are usually {warrantable} repairs.
e.zh: 一年内发现的缺陷通常属于保修范围。

e.en: His suspicions turned out to be entirely {warrantable}.
e.zh: 事实证明他的怀疑完全有正当理由。

e.en: Such a harsh response was hardly {warranted} by her comment.
e.zh: 她的评论根本不值得如此严厉的回应。

e.en: The laptop is {warranted} for two years against defects.
e.zh: 这台笔记本电脑享有两年的缺陷保修。

warranties.t: n. warranty 的复数，保修、保证

e.en: Most extended {warranties} aren't worth the extra cost.
e.zh: 大多数延长保修服务并不值那笔额外费用。

e.en: The store offers {warranties} on all major appliances.
e.zh: 这家店为所有大型家电提供保修服务。

warranting.t: v. warrant 的现在分词，担保；证明合理

e.en: Nothing in the report is serious enough, {warranting} immediate action.
e.zh: 报告中没有任何严重到需要立即采取行动的内容。

e.en: The contract includes a clause {warranting} the goods' quality.
e.zh: 合同包含一条担保货物质量的条款。

warrantless.t: adj. 无授权令的；未经批准的

e.en: The court ruled that {warrantless} searches violate privacy rights.
e.zh: 法院裁定无搜查令的搜查侵犯隐私权。

e.en: Critics oppose {warrantless} surveillance of ordinary citizens online.
e.zh: 批评者反对对普通公民进行无授权的网络监控。

warrants.t:
n. warrant 的复数，授权令
v. 保证

e.en: The judge issued arrest {warrants} for three suspects yesterday.
e.zh: 法官昨天对三名嫌疑人签发了逮捕令。

e.en: This bug {warrants} immediate attention from the development team.
e.zh: 这个漏洞需要开发团队立即关注。

e.en: My phone is still under {warranty}, so repairs are free.
e.zh: 我的手机还在保修期内,维修是免费的。

e.en: Always read the {warranty} terms before buying expensive electronics.
e.zh: 买贵重电子产品前一定要看保修条款。

warren.t: n. 兔子窝；拥挤的地方

e.en: Foxes raided the rabbit {warren} behind the old barn.
e.zh: 狐狸袭击了旧谷仓后面的兔窝。

e.en: The market is a confusing {warren} of narrow alleys.
e.zh: 这个市场是一片让人迷路的狭窄小巷迷宫。

e.en: The two {warring} factions finally agreed to a ceasefire.
e.zh: 两个交战的派系终于同意停火。

e.en: She felt {warring} emotions about leaving her job.
e.zh: 对于离职这件事,她内心感受复杂矛盾。

e.en: The train to {warrington} departs from platform six.
e.zh: 开往沃灵顿的列车从六号站台发车。

e.en: She grew up in {warrington} before moving to London.
e.zh: 她在搬到伦敦之前一直在沃灵顿长大。

e.en: The ancient {warrior} was buried with his sword and shield.
e.zh: 那位古代战士与他的剑和盾一同下葬。

e.en: She's a true {warrior} who never gives up on dreams.
e.zh: 她是真正的战士,从不放弃自己的梦想。

warriors.t: n. warrior 的复数，战士们

e.en: The Golden State {warriors} won the championship that year.
e.zh: 金州勇士队那年赢得了总冠军。

e.en: Ancient {warriors} trained from childhood for battle.
e.zh: 古代战士从孩童时期就开始为战斗训练。

e.en: History books document countless {wars} between rival kingdoms.
e.zh: 历史书记载了敌对王国之间无数的战争。

e.en: Streaming services are locked in fierce price {wars}.
e.zh: 流媒体服务正陷入激烈的价格战。

e.en: We spent three days exploring the old town of {warsaw}.
e.zh: 我们花了三天时间游览华沙老城。

e.en: {warsaw} was largely rebuilt after World War Two.
e.zh: 二战后华沙基本上是重建起来的。

e.en: A massive {warship} docked at the naval base last night.
e.zh: 一艘巨大的军舰昨晚停靠在海军基地。

e.en: The {warship} sailed through international waters without incident.
e.zh: 这艘军舰平安无事地驶过国际水域。

e.en: Several {warships} gathered for joint exercises in the Pacific.
e.zh: 数艘军舰聚集在太平洋进行联合演习。

e.en: Satellite images showed enemy {warships} approaching the coast.
e.zh: 卫星图像显示敌方军舰正逼近海岸。

e.en: The doctor froze the {wart} off her finger quickly.
e.zh: 医生很快用冷冻法去掉了她手指上的疣。

e.en: He has a small {wart} on the back of his hand.
e.zh: 他手背上有一个小疣。

e.en: A {warthog} crossed the dusty road in front of our jeep.
e.zh: 一只疣猪从我们吉普车前的尘土路上穿过。

e.en: The {warthog} kneels on its front legs to graze.
e.zh: 疣猪会跪在前腿上吃草。

wartime.t:
n. 战争时期
adj. 战时的

e.en: Her grandmother shared stories of {wartime} rationing in London.
e.zh: 她奶奶讲了战时伦敦食物配给的故事。

e.en: The museum displays photos from the {wartime} era.
e.zh: 博物馆展出战争时期的老照片。

wartimes.t: n. wartime 的复数，战争时期

e.en: The novel spans several {wartimes} across the twentieth century.
e.zh: 这部小说跨越了二十世纪的几个战争时期。

e.en: Historians compared the economies of different {wartimes}.
e.zh: 历史学家比较了不同战争时期的经济情况。

e.en: The toad's {warty} skin helps it blend into the leaves.
e.zh: 这只蟾蜍布满疙瘩的皮肤帮它融入落叶中。

e.en: He picked up a {warty} pumpkin at the farmers market.
e.zh: 他在农贸市场挑了一个表皮粗糙的南瓜。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring {Warwick} Castle in England.
e.zh: 我们周末去英格兰的沃里克城堡游玩。

e.en: {Warwick} University has a strong business school.
e.zh: 沃里克大学的商学院实力很强。

warwickshire.t: n. 沃里克郡（英国郡名）

e.en: Shakespeare was born in {Warwickshire} in 1564.
e.zh: 莎士比亚于1564年出生在沃里克郡。

e.en: The countryside of {Warwickshire} is dotted with old villages.
e.zh: 沃里克郡的乡村点缀着许多古老的村庄。

e.en: Investors are {wary} of the new cryptocurrency.
e.zh: 投资者对这种新加密货币持谨慎态度。

e.en: The cat looked {wary} when strangers approached.
e.zh: 陌生人靠近时,那只猫显得十分警觉。

was.t: v. be 的过去式（第一/三人称单数），是；曾是

e.en: He added too much {wasabi} and his eyes started watering.
e.zh: 他放了太多芥末,眼泪都被呛出来了。

e.en: This sushi comes with pickled ginger and fresh {wasabi}.
e.zh: 这份寿司配有腌姜和新鲜山葵。

wash.t:
v. 洗；清洗
n. 洗涤；洗的衣物

e.en: Please {wash} your hands before dinner.
e.zh: 吃晚饭前请把手洗干净。

e.en: I need to do a load of {wash} tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚得洗一桶衣服。

e.en: This jacket has a {washable} lining for easy care.
e.zh: 这件夹克的内衬可机洗,方便打理。

e.en: We use {washable} markers so the kids can't ruin clothes.
e.zh: 我们用可水洗的马克笔,孩子弄脏衣服也没事。

e.en: The bathroom has a marble {washbasin} and gold taps.
e.zh: 浴室里有一个大理石洗手盆和金色水龙头。

e.en: She filled the {washbasin} with warm water and soap.
e.zh: 她在洗脸盆里放满温水和肥皂。

e.en: His grandmother still scrubs sheets on a {washboard}.
e.zh: 他奶奶至今仍用搓衣板搓洗床单。

e.en: After months of training he had {washboard} abs.
e.zh: 经过几个月训练,他练出了搓衣板腹肌。

e.en: An antique porcelain {washbowl} sat on the dresser.
e.zh: 梳妆台上摆着一只古董瓷洗脸盆。

e.en: She rinsed the herbs in a small {washbowl}.
e.zh: 她在一个小洗脸盆里冲洗香草。

e.en: The hotel installed marble {washbowls} in every guest bathroom.
e.zh: 这家酒店在每间客房浴室都装了大理石洗手盆。

e.en: Antique porcelain {washbowls} sell for hundreds online.
e.zh: 古董瓷洗脸盆在网上能卖几百块。

e.en: Grab a clean {washcloth} from the cabinet for your face.
e.zh: 从柜子里拿条干净的毛巾擦脸。

e.en: The hotel folds each {washcloth} into a neat square.
e.zh: 酒店把每块洗脸巾都叠成整齐的方块。

washday.t: n. 洗衣日；家中洗衣服的日子

e.en: Saturday is always {washday} in our household.
e.zh: 周六一直是我们家的洗衣日。

e.en: She dreaded {washday} before they bought the dryer.
e.zh: 在买烘干机之前,她很怕洗衣日的到来。

washed.t:
adj. 洗过的
v. wash 的过去式

e.en: I just {washed} my hands before sitting down to eat.
e.zh: 我刚洗完手才坐下吃饭。

e.en: The old jeans look great after being stone-{washed}.
e.zh: 这条旧牛仔裤经过石洗后看起来很棒。

washer.t:
n. 洗衣机
n. 垫圈；垫片

e.en: Our new {washer} is much quieter than the old one.
e.zh: 我们的新洗衣机比旧的安静多了。

e.en: Add a rubber {washer} to stop the faucet from leaking.
e.zh: 加个橡胶垫圈就能让水龙头不漏水。

e.en: The village {washerman} collects laundry from every house weekly.
e.zh: 村里的洗衣工每周到各家收衣服。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {washerman} in Mumbai.
e.zh: 他爷爷曾在孟买做洗衣工。

e.en: The {washerwoman} hung sheets along the riverbank to dry.
e.zh: 洗衣妇把床单挂在河岸边晾干。

e.en: Her great-grandmother supported the family as a {washerwoman}.
e.zh: 她的曾祖母靠当洗衣妇养活全家。

washes.t:
v. 洗（wash 的第三人称单数）
n. 清洗

e.en: He {washes} his car every Sunday without fail.
e.zh: 他每个星期天都雷打不动地洗车。

e.en: The tide {washes} debris onto the beach overnight.
e.zh: 潮水一夜之间把碎屑冲上海滩。

washing.t:
n. 洗涤；要洗的衣物
v. 洗（wash 的现在分词）

e.en: I'm {washing} the dishes — can you dry them?
e.zh: 我正在洗碗,你能帮忙擦干吗?

e.en: Hang the {washing} outside while the sun is shining.
e.zh: 趁着出太阳把洗好的衣服晾到外面。

washing-up.t: n. 洗餐具；待洗的餐具

e.en: Whoever cooks doesn't have to do the {washing-up}.
e.zh: 做饭的人就不用洗碗了。

e.en: The {washing-up} liquid is under the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 洗洁精在厨房水槽下面。

washing-ups.t: n. 洗餐具（washing-up 的复数）

e.en: After three big {washing-ups}, my hands felt completely raw.
e.zh: 洗了三大堆碗之后,我的手都磨破皮了。

e.en: Holiday meals always end with massive {washing-ups}.
e.zh: 过节聚餐总是以堆积如山的碗筷收尾。

washings.t: n. 洗过的衣物；洗涤液

e.en: Hang the morning's {washings} on the line before lunch.
e.zh: 午饭前把早上洗好的衣物挂到晾衣绳上。

e.en: Several {washings} are needed to remove the dye stain.
e.zh: 要洗好几遍才能去掉染料污渍。

washington.t: n. 华盛顿（美国首都/州/人名）

e.en: We're flying to {Washington} for a conference next week.
e.zh: 我们下周要飞华盛顿参加会议。

e.en: George {Washington} became the first U.S. president in 1789.
e.zh: 乔治·华盛顿于1789年成为美国第一任总统。

washingtonian.t:
n. 华盛顿人
adj. 华盛顿的

e.en: As a lifelong {Washingtonian}, she knows every metro stop.
e.zh: 作为土生土长的华盛顿人,她熟悉每个地铁站。

e.en: The magazine surveys {Washingtonian} dining trends each year.
e.zh: 该杂志每年都调查华盛顿人的餐饮潮流。

washout.t: n. 彻底失败；被冲垮的路段

e.en: The outdoor concert was a complete {washout} due to storms.
e.zh: 那场户外音乐会因暴风雨彻底泡汤了。

e.en: Heavy rain caused a major {washout} on the mountain road.
e.zh: 大雨在山路上造成了严重的塌方冲毁。

e.en: Use a damp {washrag} to wipe the baby's face gently.
e.zh: 用湿洗脸巾轻轻擦宝宝的脸。

e.en: My grandma always kept a {washrag} by the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 奶奶总在厨房水槽边放一块小毛巾。

e.en: Excuse me, where is the nearest {washroom}?
e.zh: 请问最近的洗手间在哪里?

e.en: The {washroom} on the second floor is being renovated.
e.zh: 二楼的洗手间正在装修。

e.en: The antique {washstand} has a marble top and brass fittings.
e.zh: 那个古董盥洗架配有大理石面和黄铜配件。

e.en: A porcelain pitcher sat on the bedroom {washstand}.
e.zh: 卧室盥洗台上摆着一个瓷罐。

e.en: Grandma scrubbed clothes in a metal {washtub} as a child.
e.zh: 奶奶小时候在金属洗衣盆里搓衣服。

e.en: The kids splashed around in an old {washtub} all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们在旧澡盆里玩水玩了一下午。

washtubs.t: n. 洗衣盆（washtub 的复数）

e.en: Old {washtubs} now serve as planters in her garden.
e.zh: 旧澡盆如今在她的花园里当花盆用。

e.en: The laundromat replaced its ancient {washtubs} with modern machines.
e.zh: 那家自助洗衣店把古老的洗衣盆换成了现代洗衣机。

e.en: A {wasp} flew through the window and ruined our picnic.
e.zh: 一只黄蜂从窗户飞进来,毁了我们的野餐。

e.en: Be careful — there's a {wasp} nest under the eaves.
e.zh: 小心点——屋檐下有个黄蜂窝。

e.en: Her {waspish} reply made everyone in the meeting uncomfortable.
e.zh: 她尖刻的回答让会上每个人都很不自在。

e.en: He gets {waspish} when he hasn't had enough sleep.
e.zh: 他没睡够的时候就会变得脾气暴躁。

e.en: She {waspishly} corrected every minor mistake in the report.
e.zh: 她尖酸刻薄地指出报告里每一个小错误。

e.en: He {waspishly} muttered that the meeting was a waste of time.
e.zh: 他没好气地嘀咕说这场会议是浪费时间。

e.en: A swarm of {wasps} chased us away from the soda can.
e.zh: 一群黄蜂追得我们不敢靠近那罐汽水。

e.en: Unlike bees, {wasps} can sting multiple times.
e.zh: 与蜜蜂不同,黄蜂能反复蜇人。

e.en: His tone turned {waspy} whenever the topic of money came up.
e.zh: 一谈到钱,他的语气就变得尖刻起来。

e.en: She gave a {waspy} smile and walked out of the room.
e.zh: 她冷冷一笑,然后走出了房间。

wast.t: v. 古英语 are 的过去式（罕用）

e.en: The poem reads, "Thou {wast} my fairest friend of all."
e.zh: 诗中写道:"汝曾是我最美好的挚友。"

e.en: In old English, "thou {wast}" simply means "you were".
e.zh: 在古英语中,"thou wast"就是"你曾是"的意思。

e.en: The factory cut food {wastage} by twenty percent last quarter.
e.zh: 上季度工厂将食物浪费减少了百分之二十。

e.en: Energy {wastage} adds up quickly with old appliances.
e.zh: 旧家电的能源浪费会迅速累积。

waste.t:
v. 浪费
n. 废物；垃圾

e.en: Don't {waste} your time arguing with strangers online.
e.zh: 别浪费时间和网上的陌生人争论。

e.en: The city is improving how it handles plastic {waste}.
e.zh: 这座城市正在改进塑料垃圾的处理方式。

e.en: Toss the empty bottles into the {wastebasket} by the desk.
e.zh: 把空瓶子扔进桌边的废纸篓里。

e.en: The office {wastebasket} fills up with paper coffee cups.
e.zh: 办公室的废纸篓里堆满了纸咖啡杯。

wasted.t:
adj. 被浪费的；白费的
v. waste 的过去式

e.en: I {wasted} the whole afternoon scrolling through TikTok.
e.zh: 我浪费了一整个下午刷抖音。

e.en: All that careful planning was completely {wasted}.
e.zh: 所有精心的规划都彻底白费了。

e.en: Leaving the lights on all day is incredibly {wasteful}.
e.zh: 整天开着灯实在太浪费了。

e.en: The new packaging design is far less {wasteful} than before.
e.zh: 新的包装设计比以前少浪费得多。

e.en: He spent the inheritance {wastefully} within just two years.
e.zh: 他在短短两年内就把遗产挥霍一空。

e.en: The office heats empty rooms quite {wastefully} all winter.
e.zh: 整个冬天办公室都很浪费地给空房间供暖。

e.en: The audit revealed shocking {wastefulness} in government spending.
e.zh: 审计揭露了政府开支中惊人的浪费现象。

e.en: His {wastefulness} with food drives his roommate crazy.
e.zh: 他对食物的浪费让室友抓狂。

e.en: After the fire, the forest became a charred {wasteland}.
e.zh: 大火过后,森林变成了一片焦黑的荒地。

e.en: He called late-night TV a cultural {wasteland}.
e.zh: 他把深夜电视节目称为文化荒漠。

e.en: Please drop your {wastepaper} into the recycling bin, not the trash.
e.zh: 请把废纸丢进回收桶,而不是垃圾桶。

e.en: A {wastepaper} basket sits beside every desk in the office.
e.zh: 办公室每张桌子旁都放着一个废纸篓。

e.en: That mobile game is a real time {waster}.
e.zh: 那款手机游戏真是个浪费时间的东西。

e.en: His father called him a lazy {waster} who never finished anything.
e.zh: 他父亲骂他是个一事无成的懒鬼。

wastes.t:
n. 废物（waste 的复数）
v. 浪费

e.en: The company {wastes} tons of paper printing useless reports.
e.zh: 这家公司打印没用的报告浪费了大量纸张。

e.en: Industrial {wastes} pollute the river downstream of the plant.
e.zh: 工业废料污染了工厂下游的河流。

e.en: The plant treats {wastewater} before releasing it into the river.
e.zh: 工厂在将废水排入河流前会进行处理。

e.en: New filters reduce toxic chemicals in industrial {wastewater}.
e.zh: 新型过滤器能减少工业废水中的有毒化学物质。

wasting.t:
adj. 消耗性的；使衰弱的
v. 浪费

e.en: Stop {wasting} time scrolling and finish your homework.
e.zh: 别再浪费时间刷手机了，快把作业做完。

e.en: The disease causes severe muscle {wasting} in older patients.
e.zh: 这种疾病会导致老年患者严重的肌肉萎缩。

e.en: His grandfather called him a {wastrel} for quitting yet another job.
e.zh: 他爷爷因他又一次辞职而骂他是个败家子。

e.en: The novel's hero is a charming {wastrel} who never grows up.
e.zh: 小说的主角是个迷人却永远长不大的浪荡子。

watch.t:
v. 观看；注视
n. 手表

e.en: Let's {watch} the new episode together tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们一起看新一集吧。

e.en: She received a silver {watch} for her tenth anniversary.
e.zh: 她在十周年纪念日收到了一块银表。

e.en: The sequel isn't great, but it's still {watchable}.
e.zh: 续集不算精彩，但还算值得一看。

e.en: Honest reviews help me find genuinely {watchable} shows.
e.zh: 诚实的评价帮我找到真正值得看的剧。

e.en: My leather {watchband} broke after just six months.
e.zh: 我的皮表带才用了半年就断了。

e.en: You can swap the {watchband} to match your outfit.
e.zh: 你可以更换表带来搭配衣服。

e.en: A consumer {watchdog} group exposed the misleading ads.
e.zh: 一个消费者监督组织揭露了那些误导性广告。

e.en: Their old {watchdog} barks at every passing stranger.
e.zh: 他们家的老看门狗见到陌生人就叫。

watched.t:
v. watch 的过去式
adj. 被注视的

e.en: I {watched} three movies on the long flight home.
e.zh: 我在回家的长途航班上看了三部电影。

e.en: The cat {watched} the birds through the window.
e.zh: 那只猫透过窗户盯着小鸟看。

e.en: She's a keen bird {watcher} who travels for rare sightings.
e.zh: 她是个热衷的观鸟者，会专程去看稀有鸟类。

e.en: Industry {watcher}s expect a major announcement next week.
e.zh: 业内观察人士预计下周会有重大公告。

watches.t:
n. watch 的复数
v. 观看（第三人称单数）

e.en: He collects vintage Swiss {watches} as a hobby.
e.zh: 他的爱好是收藏古董瑞士手表。

e.en: My dad {watches} the news every morning at seven.
e.zh: 我爸每天早上七点都会看新闻。

e.en: The lifeguard kept a {watchful} eye on the children swimming.
e.zh: 救生员密切注视着游泳的孩子们。

e.en: Under her {watchful} gaze, no one dared misbehave.
e.zh: 在她警觉的目光下，没人敢胡来。

e.en: The mother bear paced {watchfully} around her cubs.
e.zh: 母熊警惕地在幼崽周围来回走动。

e.en: He scanned the crowd {watchfully} for any sign of trouble.
e.zh: 他警觉地扫视人群，寻找任何不对劲的迹象。

e.en: The lifeguard's constant {watchfulness} kept swimmers safe.
e.zh: 救生员持续的警觉守护着泳客的安全。

e.en: Border guards are trained for round-the-clock {watchfulness}.
e.zh: 边防士兵被训练保持全天候的警戒。

watching.t: v. 观看；注视（现在分词）

e.en: I'm {watching} a documentary about deep-sea creatures.
e.zh: 我正在看一部关于深海生物的纪录片。

e.en: The cat sat on the sill {watching} birds in the yard.
e.zh: 猫坐在窗台上看院子里的鸟。

e.en: A skilled {watchmaker} can repair vintage Swiss movements.
e.zh: 熟练的钟表匠能修复古董瑞士机芯。

e.en: His father trained as a {watchmaker} in Geneva.
e.zh: 他父亲在日内瓦学过制表手艺。

e.en: The night {watchman} patrols the warehouse every hour.
e.zh: 夜间看守每小时巡视一次仓库。

e.en: An old {watchman} unlocked the gates at dawn.
e.zh: 一位年长的看门人在拂晓时打开大门。

e.en: Soldiers scanned the desert from a tall {watchtower}.
e.zh: 士兵们从高高的瞭望塔上扫视沙漠。

e.en: The medieval {watchtower} still stands above the village.
e.zh: 那座中世纪的瞭望塔至今仍矗立在村庄上方。

e.en: Safety has become the {watchword} of our entire team.
e.zh: 安全已成为我们整个团队的口号。

e.en: Patience was the {watchword} during the long negotiations.
e.zh: 耐心是这场漫长谈判中的座右铭。

e.en: Remember to drink enough {water} during the hike.
e.zh: 徒步时记得多喝水。

e.en: Please {water} the plants while I'm away.
e.zh: 我不在的时候请帮忙浇花。

e.en: Ancient Greeks measured speeches with a {water-clock}.
e.zh: 古希腊人用水钟来计量演讲时间。

e.en: The museum displays a working Chinese {water-clock}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一座仍能运行的中国水钟。

water-proof.t:
adj. 防水的
v. 做防水处理

e.en: My new hiking boots are completely {water-proof}.
e.zh: 我的新登山靴完全防水。

e.en: She bought a {water-proof} case for her phone.
e.zh: 她给手机买了一个防水套。

e.en: We went {water-skiing} on the lake last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在湖上玩了滑水。

e.en: {Water-skiing} requires good balance and strong arms.
e.zh: 滑水运动需要良好的平衡感和强壮的手臂。

e.en: He slept poorly on the wobbly {waterbed} at the motel.
e.zh: 汽车旅馆那张晃动的水床让他睡得很差。

e.en: {Waterbeds} were a popular bedroom feature in the 1980s.
e.zh: 水床在1980年代曾是流行的卧室装饰。

e.en: The reserve protects every native {waterbird} in the wetlands.
e.zh: 该保护区保护湿地中所有本地水鸟。

e.en: A graceful {waterbird} waded through the shallow pond.
e.zh: 一只优雅的水鸟在浅塘里涉水而行。

e.en: Cholera is a serious {waterborne} disease in flooded areas.
e.zh: 霍乱是洪灾地区一种严重的水传疾病。

e.en: The supplies arrived by {waterborne} cargo ferry.
e.zh: 物资由水上货运渡轮运抵。

e.en: She painted a soft {watercolor} of the morning harbor.
e.zh: 她画了一幅清晨港口的柔美水彩画。

e.en: He bought a beginner {watercolor} set online.
e.zh: 他在网上买了一套入门水彩颜料。

e.en: The {watercolorist} captures coastal light beautifully.
e.zh: 这位水彩画家把海岸的光线描绘得很美。

e.en: Winslow Homer is a famous American {watercolorist}.
e.zh: 温斯洛·霍默是著名的美国水彩画家。

e.en: The gallery sells original {watercolour} landscapes.
e.zh: 这家画廊出售原创水彩风景画。

e.en: He sketched the cottage in delicate {watercolour}.
e.zh: 他用细腻的水彩画下了那间小屋。

watercolourist.t: n. 水彩画家（英式拼写）

e.en: Turner remains Britain's most celebrated {watercolourist}.
e.zh: 透纳仍是英国最负盛名的水彩画家。

e.en: As a {watercolourist}, she favors loose, wet brushwork.
e.zh: 作为水彩画家,她偏爱奔放的湿画法。

e.en: They gossip every morning by the office {watercooler}.
e.zh: 他们每天早上在办公室饮水机旁闲聊。

e.en: The finale became instant {watercooler} talk on Monday.
e.zh: 那部大结局周一立刻成了办公室热议话题。

e.en: A small {watercourse} winds through the meadow.
e.zh: 一条小水道蜿蜒穿过草地。

e.en: The map shows every {watercourse} flowing into the bay.
e.zh: 地图标出了每一条流入海湾的水道。

watercraft.t: n. 船只；水上交通工具

e.en: You need a license to operate a personal {watercraft} here.
e.zh: 在这里驾驶个人水上摩托需要执照。

e.en: The marina rents kayaks and other small {watercraft}.
e.zh: 码头出租皮划艇等各种小型水上工具。

e.en: She added fresh {watercress} to the chicken sandwich.
e.zh: 她在鸡肉三明治里加了新鲜的西洋菜。

e.en: This soup is made with potatoes and peppery {watercress}.
e.zh: 这道汤用土豆和带辣味的西洋菜煮成。

watered.t:
v. 浇水（过去式）
adj. 掺水的

e.en: He {watered} the tomatoes before the heat wave.
e.zh: 高温来临前他给番茄浇了水。

e.en: The bartender {watered} down the whiskey to stretch it.
e.zh: 酒保把威士忌兑了水以便多卖几杯。

e.en: We hiked two hours to reach the hidden {waterfall}.
e.zh: 我们徒步两小时才到达那座隐秘的瀑布。

e.en: A small {waterfall} feeds the koi pond in the garden.
e.zh: 一道小瀑布给花园里的锦鲤池注水。

e.en: Iceland is famous for its dramatic {waterfalls}.
e.zh: 冰岛以其壮观的瀑布而闻名。

e.en: After the rain, temporary {waterfalls} appeared on the cliffs.
e.zh: 雨后,悬崖上出现了一些临时瀑布。

waterford.t: n. 沃特福德（爱尔兰地名）

e.en: My aunt collects {Waterford} crystal glasses.
e.zh: 我姑妈收藏沃特福德水晶杯。

e.en: {Waterford} is the oldest city in Ireland.
e.zh: 沃特福德是爱尔兰最古老的城市。

e.en: Hunters need a permit to shoot {waterfowl} in this state.
e.zh: 在该州猎杀水禽需要持有许可证。

e.en: The lake attracts thousands of migrating {waterfowl}.
e.zh: 这片湖泊吸引了成千上万的迁徙水禽。

e.en: An experienced {waterfowler} knows how to read wind patterns.
e.zh: 经验丰富的水禽猎人懂得辨识风向变化。

e.en: The {waterfowler} waited patiently in the marsh blind.
e.zh: 那位水禽猎人在沼泽掩体里耐心等候。

e.en: The new restaurant has a beautiful {waterfront} view.
e.zh: 这家新餐厅有一片漂亮的海滨景观。

e.en: They bought a {waterfront} cottage in Maine.
e.zh: 他们在缅因州买了一栋临水的小屋。

e.en: Many cities are redeveloping their old industrial {waterfronts}.
e.zh: 许多城市正在改造其老旧的工业滨水区。

e.en: Sydney and Cape Town have spectacular {waterfronts}.
e.zh: 悉尼和开普敦都有壮丽的滨水区。

e.en: The {Watergate} scandal forced Nixon to resign in 1974.
e.zh: 水门事件迫使尼克松于1974年辞职。

e.en: Journalists still study {Watergate} as a case in reporting.
e.zh: 记者们至今仍把水门事件作为新闻报道的案例研究。

e.en: Elephants gathered at the {waterhole} just before sunset.
e.zh: 日落前大象们聚集在水坑旁。

e.en: In the dry season every {waterhole} attracts wildlife.
e.zh: 旱季时每个水坑都吸引着野生动物。

e.en: {Waterhouse} painted dreamy scenes from Greek mythology.
e.zh: 沃特豪斯绘制了梦幻般的希腊神话场景。

e.en: The Lady of Shalott by {Waterhouse} hangs in the Tate.
e.zh: 沃特豪斯的《夏洛特夫人》收藏在泰特美术馆。

watering.t:
n. 浇水；灌溉
v. 浇水（现在分词）

e.en: The smell of fresh bread had me {watering} at the mouth.
e.zh: 刚出炉的面包香让我直流口水。

e.en: He spends Sunday morning {watering} the vegetable beds.
e.zh: 他周日上午都在给菜畦浇水。

e.en: This new car wash uses a {waterless} cleaning product.
e.zh: 这家新洗车店使用一种免水清洁剂。

e.en: They drove for hours through the {waterless} desert.
e.zh: 他们在无水的沙漠中开了好几个小时。

e.en: A pink {waterlily} bloomed at the center of the pond.
e.zh: 池塘中央开着一朵粉色的睡莲。

e.en: Monet painted countless studies of the {waterlily}.
e.zh: 莫奈画过无数关于睡莲的习作。

e.en: The flood marked a dark {waterline} on the brick wall.
e.zh: 洪水在砖墙上留下一条深色的水位线。

e.en: Barnacles grew below the boat's {waterline}.
e.zh: 船的吃水线以下长满了藤壶。

e.en: Heavy rain can {waterlog} the playing field overnight.
e.zh: 一夜大雨就能让球场积水成灾。

e.en: Don't overwater the seedlings or you'll {waterlog} the roots.
e.zh: 别给幼苗浇太多水,否则会让根部泡烂。

e.en: The {waterlogged} field made it impossible to play the match.
e.zh: 那块被水浸透的球场让比赛无法进行。

e.en: My phone fell in the pool and is completely {waterlogged}.
e.zh: 我的手机掉进泳池里,全进水了。

e.en: The startup finally met its {waterloo} after the funding dried up.
e.zh: 那家初创公司在资金断裂后终于一败涂地。

e.en: Napoleon's defeat at {Waterloo} ended his rule in 1815.
e.zh: 拿破仑在滑铁卢战败,于1815年结束了统治。

e.en: The old {waterman} ferried passengers across the Thames for decades.
e.zh: 那位老船夫在泰晤士河上摆渡了几十年。

e.en: Every {waterman} on the bay knows where the best oysters grow.
e.zh: 湾里每个船夫都知道哪里的牡蛎最好。

watermark.t:
n. 水印
v. 加水印

e.en: The PDF has a faint {watermark} across every page.
e.zh: 这份PDF每一页都印着淡淡的水印。

e.en: You can see the {watermark} when you hold the bill up to light.
e.zh: 把钞票对着光就能看到水印。

e.en: Nothing beats cold {watermelon} on a hot summer afternoon.
e.zh: 炎热的夏日午后,没什么比冰镇西瓜更爽。

e.en: She spit {watermelon} seeds across the picnic blanket.
e.zh: 她把西瓜籽吐得野餐垫上到处都是。

e.en: The old {watermill} still grinds flour for the village bakery.
e.zh: 那座老水磨坊仍在为村里的面包房磨面粉。

e.en: Tourists love photographing the {watermill} beside the stream.
e.zh: 游客们都喜欢拍小溪旁的水磨坊。

waterproof.t:
adj. 防水的
v. 使防水

e.en: This jacket is fully {waterproof} and great for hiking.
e.zh: 这件外套完全防水,非常适合徒步。

e.en: Make sure your phone case is {waterproof} before swimming.
e.zh: 游泳前确认你的手机壳是防水的。

waterproofing.t: n. 防水处理；防水材料

e.en: We hired a contractor for basement {waterproofing} last month.
e.zh: 上个月我们请了承包商做地下室防水。

e.en: The {waterproofing} on these boots wears off after a year.
e.zh: 这双靴子的防水层用一年就会失效。

e.en: Reviewers praised the watch for its impressive {waterproofness}.
e.zh: 评测人员称赞这款手表防水性能出色。

e.en: The fabric loses its {waterproofness} after repeated washing.
e.zh: 这种面料反复洗涤后会失去防水性。

e.en: The fishing boat strayed into foreign {waters} by accident.
e.zh: 那艘渔船不小心驶入了外国海域。

e.en: She {waters} the plants every morning before work.
e.zh: 她每天上班前都给植物浇水。

e.en: The iPhone launch was a {watershed} moment for mobile computing.
e.zh: iPhone的发布是移动计算的分水岭时刻。

e.en: Pollution upstream threatens the entire {watershed}.
e.zh: 上游的污染威胁着整个流域。

e.en: We had dinner at a charming {waterside} restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在一家迷人的水边餐厅吃了晚饭。

e.en: Couples often stroll along the {waterside} at sunset.
e.zh: 情侣们常在日落时分沿着水边散步。

waterski.t:
v. 滑水
n. 滑水板

e.en: He learned to {waterski} during summer camp last year.
e.zh: 他去年夏令营时学会了滑水。

e.en: You need strong arms to {waterski} for very long.
e.zh: 要长时间滑水,需要强壮的手臂。

e.en: A huge {waterspout} formed over the bay yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天海湾上空形成了一个巨大的水龙卷。

e.en: Rain poured from the broken {waterspout} on the roof.
e.zh: 雨水从屋顶坏掉的排水管哗哗流下。

e.en: He sharpened the chisel on a Japanese {waterstone}.
e.zh: 他用日式磨刀石打磨凿子。

e.en: A fine {waterstone} gives knives a razor edge.
e.zh: 细磨刀石能让刀刃锋利如剃刀。

watertight.t: adj. 不漏水的；无懈可击的

e.en: The submarine hatch must be completely {watertight}.
e.zh: 潜艇的舱门必须完全防水密封。

e.en: The lawyer built a {watertight} case against the company.
e.zh: 律师对那家公司提起了无懈可击的诉讼。

e.en: Boats travel along the busy {waterway} all summer.
e.zh: 整个夏天都有船只在这条繁忙的水道上往来。

e.en: The canal is an important {waterway} for cargo ships.
e.zh: 这条运河是货轮的重要航道。

e.en: The old mill's {waterwheel} still turns slowly today.
e.zh: 那座古老磨坊的水车至今仍在缓缓转动。

e.en: A wooden {waterwheel} powered the flour mill for centuries.
e.zh: 一架木制水车为面粉厂供能数百年。

waterworks.t: n. 自来水厂；供水系统

e.en: The city {waterworks} supplies clean water to thousands.
e.zh: 该市的自来水厂为成千上万的居民供应清洁用水。

e.en: She turned on the {waterworks} when she heard the news.
e.zh: 听到那个消息时她立刻泪如雨下。

e.en: The soup was thin and {watery}, lacking real flavor.
e.zh: 这汤又稀又淡，没什么味道。

e.en: His eyes turned {watery} as he read the letter.
e.zh: 读着那封信时，他的眼眶湿润了。

watford.t: n. 沃特福德（英国地名）

e.en: {Watford} is a busy commuter town north of London.
e.zh: 沃特福德是伦敦北部一座繁忙的通勤城镇。

e.en: The team played {Watford} in the third round.
e.zh: 球队在第三轮比赛中对阵沃特福德。

e.en: {Watling} Street was a major Roman road in Britain.
e.zh: 瓦特林大道是英国一条重要的罗马古道。

e.en: Ancient travelers followed {Watling} Street across England.
e.zh: 古时旅人沿着瓦特林大道穿越英格兰。

e.en: Dr. {Watson} faithfully recorded Sherlock Holmes's adventures.
e.zh: 华生医生忠实地记录了夏洛克·福尔摩斯的冒险。

e.en: IBM's {Watson} can answer complex questions in seconds.
e.zh: IBM 的 Watson 能在几秒内回答复杂问题。

e.en: This bulb uses only one {watt} of electricity.
e.zh: 这个灯泡只用一瓦电。

e.en: James {Watt} improved the steam engine dramatically.
e.zh: 詹姆斯·瓦特对蒸汽机做了重大改良。

e.en: Check the {wattage} before plugging in the heater.
e.zh: 插上电暖器前先确认它的功率。

e.en: Higher {wattage} bulbs produce much brighter light.
e.zh: 瓦数更高的灯泡发出的光要亮得多。

wattle.t: n. 枝条编织物；金合欢

e.en: The cottage walls were made of {wattle} and daub.
e.zh: 小屋的墙是用枝条编泥糊成的。

e.en: The turkey's red {wattle} hung beneath its beak.
e.zh: 火鸡红色的肉垂垂在喙下。

e.en: The amplifier outputs two hundred {watts} per channel.
e.zh: 这台功放每声道输出两百瓦。

e.en: Solar panels can generate thousands of {watts} daily.
e.zh: 太阳能板每天可以发出数千瓦的电。

wave.t:
n. 波浪；波
v. 挥手；挥动

e.en: A huge {wave} crashed against the rocky shore.
e.zh: 一个巨浪猛烈地拍打着礁石海岸。

e.en: She gave a friendly {wave} from across the street.
e.zh: 她从街对面友好地挥了挥手。

e.en: Tune the radio to the shortwave {waveband} for news.
e.zh: 把收音机调到短波频段收听新闻。

e.en: This receiver covers every commercial {waveband} available.
e.zh: 这台接收机能收到所有商用频段。

waved.t: v. 挥动；起伏（wave 的过去式）

e.en: She {waved} goodbye as the train pulled away.
e.zh: 火车开走时她挥手告别。

e.en: The flag {waved} gently in the morning breeze.
e.zh: 国旗在晨风中轻轻飘扬。

e.en: The oscilloscope displayed a clean sine {waveform}.
e.zh: 示波器上显示出一个干净的正弦波形。

e.en: Audio engineers analyze the {waveform} to detect distortion.
e.zh: 音频工程师通过分析波形来检测失真。

e.en: The shock {wavefront} expanded rapidly from the explosion.
e.zh: 冲击波阵面从爆炸中心迅速扩展。

e.en: Telescopes correct distortions in the incoming {wavefront}.
e.zh: 望远镜会校正入射波前的畸变。

e.en: The {wavefunction} describes a quantum particle's probable state.
e.zh: 波函数描述了量子粒子的可能状态。

e.en: Measurement causes the {wavefunction} to collapse instantly.
e.zh: 测量会使波函数瞬间坍缩。

e.en: Microwaves travel efficiently through a hollow metal {waveguide}.
e.zh: 微波在中空的金属波导中传输非常高效。

e.en: Engineers tested the new optical {waveguide} in the lab.
e.zh: 工程师在实验室测试了新的光波导。

e.en: Red light has a longer {wavelength} than blue light.
e.zh: 红光的波长比蓝光更长。

e.en: My sister and I are on the same {wavelength}.
e.zh: 我和姐姐总是想到一块儿去。

e.en: Tiny {wavelet} patterns rippled across the calm pond.
e.zh: 平静的池塘上泛起一圈圈细小的涟漪。

e.en: Engineers use {wavelet} analysis to compress digital images.
e.zh: 工程师用小波分析来压缩数字图像。

waveney.t: n. 韦弗尼（英国河流/地名）

e.en: The River {Waveney} forms part of the Suffolk border.
e.zh: 瓦弗尼河构成了萨福克郡边界的一部分。

e.en: We rented a boat on the {Waveney} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在瓦弗尼河上租了条船。

e.en: Her voice began to {waver} during the speech.
e.zh: 演讲过程中她的声音开始颤抖起来。

e.en: Don't {waver} when you know the right answer.
e.zh: 知道正确答案时就别犹豫不决。

e.en: The party tried to win over every undecided {waverer}.
e.zh: 政党努力争取每一位摇摆不定的选民。

e.en: He's a chronic {waverer} when it comes to commitments.
e.zh: 在做承诺这件事上，他总是优柔寡断。

e.en: His {wavering} confidence showed in every answer.
e.zh: 他每个回答都透着摇摆不定的信心。

e.en: The candle's {wavering} flame cast shadows on the wall.
e.zh: 烛火摇曳，把影子投在墙上。

e.en: Edinburgh {Waverley} is one of Britain's busiest stations.
e.zh: 爱丁堡韦弗利车站是英国最繁忙的车站之一。

e.en: Scott's novel {Waverley} launched the historical fiction genre.
e.zh: 司各特的小说《威弗利》开创了历史小说体裁。

e.en: She drew a {wavery} line across the page.
e.zh: 她在纸上画了一条歪歪扭扭的线。

e.en: His {wavery} voice betrayed how nervous he felt.
e.zh: 他颤抖的嗓音暴露了他有多紧张。

waves.t:
n. 波浪（复数）
v. 挥动（第三人称单数）

e.en: Powerful {waves} pounded the beach during the storm.
e.zh: 风暴中汹涌的海浪拍打着海滩。

e.en: The new policy is making {waves} across the industry.
e.zh: 这项新政策在整个行业引起了轰动。

waving.t: v. 挥动；飘扬（wave 的现在分词）

e.en: Children stood {waving} flags along the parade route.
e.zh: 孩子们站在游行路线两旁挥舞着旗帜。

e.en: She kept {waving} until the bus disappeared.
e.zh: 她一直挥手，直到公交车消失不见。

e.en: She has long, {wavy} brown hair down her back.
e.zh: 她有一头垂到背部的棕色长波浪卷发。

e.en: The artist painted {wavy} lines across the canvas.
e.zh: 画家在画布上画了一道道波浪线。

wax.t:
n. 蜡
v. 打蜡；增长

waxed.t: v. 上过蜡的；增长（wax 的过去式）

e.en: He {waxed} the car until it gleamed.
e.zh: 他把车打蜡擦得锃亮。

e.en: The skier {waxed} her skis before the race.
e.zh: 滑雪运动员在比赛前给雪板打了蜡。

e.en: The patient's {waxen} face worried the nurses.
e.zh: 病人那张苍白如蜡的脸让护士们很担心。

e.en: Candles dripped {waxen} tears onto the table.
e.zh: 蜡烛在桌上滴落一颗颗蜡泪。

waxes.t:
n. 蜡（复数）
v. 打蜡（第三人称单数）

e.en: The moon {waxes} for two weeks before becoming full.
e.zh: 月亮在变圆之前会渐盈两周。

e.en: This shop sells natural {waxes} for furniture polishing.
e.zh: 这家店出售用于家具抛光的天然蜡。

waxing.t:
n. 蜡疗脱毛
v. 打蜡；渐增

e.en: The {waxing} moon grew brighter every night.
e.zh: 渐盈的月亮一夜比一夜更亮。

e.en: She booked a leg {waxing} appointment for Friday.
e.zh: 她预约了周五做腿部脱毛。

e.en: A flock of {waxwing} birds stripped the berry tree.
e.zh: 一群太平鸟把那棵浆果树啄了个精光。

e.en: The {waxwing} has striking yellow tips on its tail.
e.zh: 太平鸟的尾尖有醒目的黄色斑纹。

e.en: The museum displayed a lifelike {waxwork} of the queen.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一尊栩栩如生的女王蜡像。

e.en: Tourists took photos beside every famous {waxwork} figure.
e.zh: 游客们在每尊名人蜡像旁拍照留念。

e.en: The leaves had a thick, {waxy} coating to retain water.
e.zh: 叶子表面有一层厚厚的蜡质，用来保水。

e.en: Her skin looked pale and {waxy} after the illness.
e.zh: 病后她的皮肤显得苍白蜡黄。

way.t:
n. 方式；道路
adv. 远远地

e.en: The driver signed the {waybill} before leaving the warehouse.
e.zh: 司机在离开仓库前签了运货单。

e.en: Each shipment must include a detailed {waybill}.
e.zh: 每批货物都必须附上详细的运单。

e.en: The lonely {wayfarer} sought shelter at the inn.
e.zh: 那位孤独的旅人在客栈寻求歇脚之处。

e.en: A weary {wayfarer} appeared at our door at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时分，一位疲惫的旅人出现在我们门前。

e.en: Bandits used to {waylay} travelers in this mountain pass.
e.zh: 过去强盗常在这处山口拦截过路人。

e.en: Reporters tried to {waylay} the senator outside the hotel.
e.zh: 记者们试图在酒店外拦住那位参议员。

e.en: The trail is clearly {waymarked} with bright yellow arrows.
e.zh: 这条小径用明亮的黄色箭头清晰地标出了路线。

e.en: We followed the {waymarked} route through the forest.
e.zh: 我们沿着标好的路线穿过森林。

e.en: Set a {waypoint} on the GPS before you start hiking.
e.zh: 开始徒步前在GPS上设一个航点。

e.en: The drone returned to its first {waypoint} automatically.
e.zh: 无人机自动返回了第一个航点。

e.en: There are several {ways} to solve this math problem.
e.zh: 解这道数学题有好几种方法。

e.en: Our {ways} of working have changed since the pandemic.
e.zh: 自疫情以来我们的工作方式发生了变化。

e.en: Many small shops fell by the {wayside} during the recession.
e.zh: 经济衰退期间许多小店相继倒闭。

e.en: Wildflowers grew along the {wayside} all summer.
e.zh: 整个夏天路边都开着野花。

e.en: Old stone crosses still stand at country {waysides}.
e.zh: 古老的石十字架仍立在乡间路旁。

e.en: The {waysides} were littered with fallen leaves.
e.zh: 路边散落着许多落叶。

wayward.t: adj. 任性的；难以预测的

e.en: Their {wayward} son finally came home after years away.
e.zh: 他们任性的儿子离家多年后终于回来了。

e.en: A {wayward} golf ball broke the kitchen window.
e.zh: 一个偏离方向的高尔夫球打碎了厨房的窗户。

e.en: His teenage {waywardness} worried his parents deeply.
e.zh: 他青春期的叛逆让父母十分担心。

e.en: The novel explores the {waywardness} of the human heart.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了人心的难以捉摸。

wba.t: n. 世界拳击协会（World Boxing Association）

wbo.t: n. 世界拳击组织（World Boxing Organization）

e.en: The Wi-Fi signal is too {weak} in the basement.
e.zh: 地下室的Wi-Fi信号太弱了。

e.en: She felt {weak} after skipping breakfast and lunch.
e.zh: 没吃早餐和午餐让她感到浑身无力。

e.en: Skipping workouts will quickly {weaken} your core muscles.
e.zh: 不锻炼会很快让你的核心肌群变弱。

e.en: The scandal could {weaken} the senator's chances of reelection.
e.zh: 这起丑闻可能削弱该参议员连任的机会。

weakened.t:
v. 削弱（过去式）
adj. 虚弱的

e.en: The hurricane {weakened} significantly before reaching the coast.
e.zh: 飓风在抵达海岸前已明显减弱。

e.en: Years of stress had {weakened} her immune system.
e.zh: 多年的压力削弱了她的免疫系统。

weakening.t:
v. 正在削弱
n. 衰弱

e.en: A {weakening} dollar makes imports more expensive.
e.zh: 美元走弱会使进口商品变得更贵。

e.en: Doctors noticed a {weakening} in his heartbeat overnight.
e.zh: 医生发现他的心跳一夜之间变弱了。

weakens.t: v. 削弱（第三人称单数）

e.en: Lack of sleep {weakens} your ability to focus.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会削弱你的专注力。

e.en: Each rejection slightly {weakens} his confidence.
e.zh: 每一次被拒都会让他的信心略受打击。

e.en: A chain is only as strong as its {weakest} link.
e.zh: 一条链子的强度取决于最薄弱的一环。

e.en: Math has always been my {weakest} subject in school.
e.zh: 数学一直是我在学校最弱的科目。

e.en: Anglers caught several {weakfish} off the New Jersey coast.
e.zh: 钓鱼者在新泽西海岸钓到了几条犬牙石首鱼。

e.en: Grilled {weakfish} is a popular dish in coastal restaurants.
e.zh: 烤犬牙石首鱼是沿海餐馆里很受欢迎的菜。

e.en: The other kids teased him as a {weakling} in gym class.
e.zh: 其他孩子在体育课上嘲笑他是个弱鸡。

e.en: He hit the gym determined to never be a {weakling} again.
e.zh: 他下决心去健身房，再也不当软脚虾。

weakly.t:
adv. 虚弱地
adj. 病弱的

e.en: She smiled {weakly} and asked for a glass of water.
e.zh: 她虚弱地笑了笑，要了一杯水。

e.en: He protested {weakly}, knowing the decision was already made.
e.zh: 他无力地抗议，心知决定已成定局。

e.en: Procrastination is my biggest {weakness} at work.
e.zh: 拖延症是我工作中最大的弱点。

e.en: She has a {weakness} for dark chocolate.
e.zh: 她对黑巧克力毫无抵抗力。

e.en: Good leaders acknowledge their own {weaknesses}.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者会正视自己的弱点。

e.en: The audit revealed several security {weaknesses} in the system.
e.zh: 审计发现了系统中几个安全漏洞。

e.en: Politicians claim to act for the common {weal}.
e.zh: 政客们声称是为了公众福祉而行动。

e.en: The slap left a red {weal} across his cheek.
e.zh: 那一巴掌在他脸颊上留下了一道红印。

e.en: They hiked through the rolling {weald} of southern England.
e.zh: 他们徒步穿越了英格兰南部连绵起伏的林地。

e.en: The {weald} was once covered in dense oak forest.
e.zh: 这片丘陵林地曾经覆盖着茂密的橡树林。

e.en: Geologists studied the {wealden} clay formations for fossils.
e.zh: 地质学家在威尔德黏土层中研究化石。

e.en: The {wealden} landscape is famous for its medieval villages.
e.zh: 威尔德地区以其中世纪村庄而闻名。

e.en: His family accumulated enormous {wealth} through real estate.
e.zh: 他的家族通过房地产积累了巨额财富。

e.en: The library offers a {wealth} of free online resources.
e.zh: 这家图书馆提供丰富的免费在线资源。

e.en: Only the most {wealthy} families could afford private tutors.
e.zh: 只有最富裕的家庭才请得起私人家教。

e.en: He retired {wealthy} after selling his startup.
e.zh: 卖掉创业公司后，他富有地退休了。

e.en: It took months to {wean} the baby off the bottle.
e.zh: 花了好几个月才让宝宝断掉奶瓶。

e.en: The app helps users {wean} themselves off social media.
e.zh: 这款应用帮助用户戒掉社交媒体。

e.en: The puppies are fully {weaned} and ready for new homes.
e.zh: 小狗们已经完全断奶，可以送去新家了。

e.en: She finally {weaned} herself off her morning coffee habit.
e.zh: 她终于戒掉了早晨喝咖啡的习惯。

weaning.t:
n. 断奶
v. 正在戒掉

e.en: {Weaning} a toddler can take patience and creative meals.
e.zh: 给幼儿断奶需要耐心和有创意的餐食。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {weaning} patients off painkillers.
e.zh: 该诊所专门帮助患者戒除止痛药。

e.en: Police recovered the {weapon} used in the robbery.
e.zh: 警方找回了抢劫案中使用的武器。

e.en: Humor can be a powerful {weapon} against bullies.
e.zh: 幽默可以是对付欺凌者的有力武器。

e.en: Experts warn about the {weaponization} of artificial intelligence.
e.zh: 专家警告人工智能被武器化的风险。

e.en: The {weaponization} of social media has shaped recent elections.
e.zh: 社交媒体的武器化已影响了近年的选举。

weaponized.t:
adj. 武器化的
v. 使成为武器

e.en: Hackers {weaponized} the software bug to steal user data.
e.zh: 黑客利用这个软件漏洞窃取用户数据。

e.en: Trolls {weaponized} the hashtag to harass the journalist.
e.zh: 喷子们把这个话题标签当作武器骚扰那位记者。

e.en: The {weaponless} guards relied on conversation to defuse conflicts.
e.zh: 这些不带武器的保安靠交谈化解冲突。

e.en: She faced the intruder {weaponless} but unafraid.
e.zh: 她手无寸铁却毫无惧色地面对入侵者。

e.en: The museum displays medieval {weaponry} from across Europe.
e.zh: 博物馆展出来自欧洲各地的中世纪武器。

e.en: Modern {weaponry} relies heavily on guidance software.
e.zh: 现代武器装备很大程度上依赖制导软件。

e.en: The treaty bans certain chemical {weapons} worldwide.
e.zh: 该条约在全球范围内禁止某些化学武器。

e.en: Players unlock new {weapons} as they level up.
e.zh: 玩家升级后可以解锁新武器。

wear.t:
v. 穿着；磨损
n. 衣物；磨损

e.en: What should I {wear} to the job interview tomorrow?
e.zh: 明天面试我该穿什么？

e.en: These hiking boots show heavy {wear} after one season.
e.zh: 这双登山靴用了一季就磨损得很严重。

wearable.t:
adj. 可穿戴的
n. 可穿戴设备

e.en: Smart {wearable} devices track your heart rate all day.
e.zh: 智能可穿戴设备能全天监测你的心率。

e.en: The dress is gorgeous but barely {wearable} for daily life.
e.zh: 这条裙子很漂亮，但日常几乎穿不出去。

e.en: This sleek helmet protects the {wearer} without limiting vision.
e.zh: 这款时尚的头盔在保护佩戴者的同时不影响视野。

e.en: The ring's inscription is visible only to its {wearer}.
e.zh: 戒指上的铭文只有佩戴者才能看到。

e.en: He dropped onto the couch {wearily} after a twelve-hour shift.
e.zh: 上完十二小时班后，他疲惫地瘫倒在沙发上。

e.en: She rubbed her eyes {wearily} and reread the email.
e.zh: 她疲倦地揉揉眼睛，又把那封邮件读了一遍。

e.en: A deep {weariness} settled over her after the long week.
e.zh: 漫长的一周过后，一股深深的疲惫笼罩着她。

e.en: You could hear the {weariness} in his voice on the call.
e.zh: 通话时能听出他声音里的倦意。

wearing.t:
v. 穿戴；佩戴
adj. 令人疲惫的

e.en: She's {wearing} a navy blazer and white sneakers today.
e.zh: 她今天穿着藏青色西装外套和白色运动鞋。

e.en: Constant deadlines can be mentally {wearing} over time.
e.zh: 长期不断的截止日期会让人精神疲惫。

wearisome.t: adj. 令人疲倦的；乏味的

e.en: Filling out the same forms every year is {wearisome}.
e.zh: 每年都要填同样的表格，真让人厌烦。

e.en: His {wearisome} complaints drove his coworkers away.
e.zh: 他烦人的抱怨让同事们都躲着他。

wears.t: v. 穿戴（wear 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {wears} sunglasses, even on cloudy days.
e.zh: 他总是戴着墨镜，连阴天也不例外。

e.en: This rope {wears} out quickly under heavy use.
e.zh: 这种绳子在重负使用下很快就会磨损。

e.en: The {weary} travelers collapsed onto the hotel beds.
e.zh: 疲惫的旅客们瘫倒在酒店的床上。

e.en: I'm growing {weary} of all these pointless meetings.
e.zh: 我对这些毫无意义的会议越来越厌倦了。

wearying.t: adj. 令人疲倦的；烦人的

e.en: The {wearying} commute made him consider working remotely.
e.zh: 令人疲惫的通勤让他考虑远程办公。

e.en: Negotiations dragged on, slowly {wearying} both sides.
e.zh: 谈判拖了很久，渐渐让双方都疲惫不堪。

weasel.t:
n. 鼬；黄鼠狼
v. 推脱逃避

e.en: Don't {weasel} out of your promise at the last minute.
e.zh: 别在最后关头耍滑头逃避你的承诺。

e.en: A small {weasel} darted across the snowy path.
e.zh: 一只小黄鼠狼飞快地窜过雪地小径。

weather.t:
n. 天气
v. 经受住（风雨、困难）

e.en: The {weather} forecast predicts heavy rain this weekend.
e.zh: 天气预报说这个周末会有大雨。

e.en: Small businesses must {weather} the economic downturn.
e.zh: 小企业必须挺过这次经济下滑。

weatherbeaten.t: adj. 饱经风霜的；风化的

e.en: The old sailor had a {weatherbeaten} face full of wrinkles.
e.zh: 那位老水手满脸皱纹，饱经风霜。

e.en: They restored the {weatherbeaten} cabin near the cliffs.
e.zh: 他们修复了悬崖边那座饱经风雨的小木屋。

weathercock.t: n. 风向标；见风使舵者

e.en: A rusty {weathercock} spun on top of the barn.
e.zh: 一只生锈的风信鸡在谷仓顶上旋转。

e.en: The church tower was crowned with a golden {weathercock}.
e.zh: 教堂塔顶上立着一只金色的风信鸡。

weathered.t: adj. 风化的；饱经风霜的

e.en: The {weathered} fence needed a fresh coat of paint.
e.zh: 那道饱经风雨的栅栏需要重新刷漆。

e.en: She has {weathered} many storms in her career.
e.zh: 她在事业中经历过许多风雨。

weathering.t:
n. 风化作用
v. 经受住

e.en: Rocks break down slowly through {weathering} and erosion.
