e.zh: 岩石通过风化和侵蚀慢慢分解。

e.en: The company is {weathering} a tough economic downturn.
e.zh: 公司正在挺过严峻的经济低迷期。

e.en: The {weatherman} predicted heavy rain for the weekend.
e.zh: 天气预报员预测周末有大雨。

e.en: Our local {weatherman} is rarely wrong about snowstorms.
e.zh: 我们当地的天气预报员对暴风雪的预测很少出错。

e.en: This jacket is fully {weatherproof} and lightweight.
e.zh: 这件夹克完全防风防雨，而且很轻便。

e.en: They sealed the windows to {weatherproof} the cabin.
e.zh: 他们密封了窗户，让小屋能够防风雨。

e.en: A copper {weathervane} pointed firmly toward the north.
e.zh: 一只铜制风向标稳稳地指向北方。

e.en: The {weathervane} on the roof creaked in the wind.
e.zh: 屋顶上的风向标在风中嘎吱作响。

weave.t:
v. 编织；穿梭前行
n. 织法

e.en: She learned to {weave} baskets from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她跟奶奶学会了编篮子。

e.en: Cyclists {weave} through traffic during rush hour.
e.zh: 骑车的人在高峰时段穿梭于车流中。

weaved.t: v. weave 的过去式（穿梭前行）

e.en: The cyclist {weaved} through heavy downtown traffic.
e.zh: 骑车人在市中心拥堵的车流中穿梭前行。

e.en: She {weaved} a colorful basket from dried reeds.
e.zh: 她用干芦苇编了一个彩色的篮子。

e.en: The {weaver} sells handmade rugs at the local market.
e.zh: 那位织工在当地市集卖手工地毯。

e.en: My grandmother was a skilled {weaver} of silk scarves.
e.zh: 我奶奶是位编织丝巾的能手。

e.en: The {weaverbird} built an intricate hanging nest.
e.zh: 织布鸟筑了一个精巧的悬挂式巢。

e.en: A male {weaverbird} attracts mates with its woven home.
e.zh: 雄性织布鸟用编织的巢吸引配偶。

weaves.t: v. 编织（weave 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The author skillfully {weaves} humor into every chapter.
e.zh: 作者巧妙地把幽默融入每一章中。

e.en: She {weaves} traditional patterns on a wooden loom.
e.zh: 她在木制织机上编织传统图案。

weaving.t:
n. 编织
v. 编织；穿行

e.en: Traffic was bad, with cars {weaving} between lanes.
e.zh: 路况很糟,车辆在车道之间穿梭变换。

e.en: She learned {weaving} from her grandmother as a child.
e.zh: 她小时候跟奶奶学的编织。

web.t:
n. 网络；万维网
n. 蛛网

e.en: Ducks have {webbed} feet that help them swim.
e.zh: 鸭子有蹼足,有助于游泳。

e.en: The frog's {webbed} toes propelled it through the pond.
e.zh: 青蛙的蹼趾推动它在池塘中前进。

e.en: The backpack straps are made of strong nylon {webbing}.
e.zh: 背包带是用结实的尼龙织带做的。

e.en: Replace the lawn chair's {webbing} before summer.
e.zh: 夏天到来前换一下躺椅的编织带。

e.en: The old attic was full of dusty, {webby} corners.
e.zh: 那间老阁楼到处是布满蛛网、积满灰尘的角落。

e.en: She brushed away the {webby} threads from the doorway.
e.zh: 她拂去门口蛛网般的细丝。

e.en: Please turn on your {webcam} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时请打开你的摄像头。

e.en: My {webcam} stopped working after the system update.
e.zh: 系统更新后我的摄像头就坏了。

e.en: Modern laptops come with built-in {webcams}.
e.zh: 现代笔记本电脑都自带摄像头。

e.en: Live {webcams} show the snow conditions on the mountain.
e.zh: 实时摄像头显示着山上的积雪情况。

webcast.t:
n. 网络直播
v. 进行网络直播

e.en: The conference will be available as a live {webcast}.
e.zh: 这场会议将通过网络直播向公众开放。

e.en: Thousands tuned in to the company's annual {webcast}.
e.zh: 数千人收看了公司一年一度的网络直播。

weber.t: n. 韦伯（磁通量单位；姓氏）

e.en: Magnetic flux is measured in units called the {weber}.
e.zh: 磁通量以韦伯为单位来计量。

e.en: One {weber} equals one volt-second of magnetic flux.
e.zh: 一韦伯等于一伏特秒的磁通量。

e.en: The professor took a {Weberian} approach to studying bureaucracy.
e.zh: 那位教授用韦伯式的方法研究官僚体制。

e.en: Her thesis applies {Weberian} theory to modern workplaces.
e.zh: 她的论文将韦伯理论应用于现代职场。

e.en: He started a travel {weblog} to share his adventures.
e.zh: 他开了个旅行博客来分享冒险经历。

e.en: Her cooking {weblog} attracted millions of readers.
e.zh: 她的美食博客吸引了数百万读者。

e.en: Email the {webmaster} if you find a broken link.
e.zh: 如果发现失效链接,请发邮件给网站管理员。

e.en: The {webmaster} updates the homepage every Monday.
e.zh: 网站管理员每周一更新主页。

e.en: This {webpage} loads slowly on mobile devices.
e.zh: 这个网页在手机上加载得很慢。

e.en: Bookmark the {webpage} so you can find it later.
e.zh: 把这个网页加入书签,方便以后查找。

e.en: Spider {webs} glistened with morning dew.
e.zh: 蜘蛛网在晨露中闪闪发光。

e.en: The detective uncovered tangled {webs} of corruption.
e.zh: 侦探揭开了错综复杂的腐败网络。

e.en: Check the company {website} for opening hours.
e.zh: 请到公司官网查询营业时间。

e.en: He built a personal {website} to showcase his portfolio.
e.zh: 他建了个人网站来展示作品集。

e.en: Most news {websites} now require a subscription.
e.zh: 大多数新闻网站现在都需要订阅。

e.en: Compare prices across several {websites} before buying.
e.zh: 购买前先在几个网站上比较价格。

e.en: I looked up the word in {Webster}'s dictionary.
e.zh: 我在韦氏词典里查了这个词。

e.en: {Webster} compiled the first major American dictionary.
e.zh: 韦伯斯特编纂了第一部重要的美式词典。

e.en: The couple were happily {wedded} for fifty years.
e.zh: 这对夫妻幸福地结婚五十年。

e.en: He is {wedded} to outdated business strategies.
e.zh: 他死守着过时的商业策略不肯放手。

e.en: Their {wedding} took place in a small garden chapel.
e.zh: 他们的婚礼在一座花园小教堂举行。

e.en: I bought a new dress for my sister's {wedding}.
e.zh: 我为姐姐的婚礼买了一条新裙子。

e.en: Summer is the busiest season for {weddings}.
e.zh: 夏天是举办婚礼最忙的季节。

e.en: She photographs {weddings} every weekend in June.
e.zh: 六月的每个周末她都在拍婚礼。

wedge.t:
n. 楔子；楔形物
v. 楔入；挤入

e.en: Use a {wedge} to keep the door open.
e.zh: 用一个楔子把门顶开。

e.en: He cut himself a thick {wedge} of cheese.
e.zh: 他给自己切了一大块楔形的奶酪。

e.en: The bird has a distinctive {wedge-shaped} tail.
e.zh: 这种鸟有一条独特的楔形尾巴。

e.en: She arranged the sandwiches in {wedge-shaped} pieces.
e.zh: 她把三明治切成楔形摆好。

e.en: My phone got {wedged} between the sofa cushions.
e.zh: 我的手机卡在沙发垫子之间了。

e.en: He {wedged} the window open with a book.
e.zh: 他用一本书把窗户撑开。

wedgie.t: n. 内裤被夹进臀缝的恶作剧

e.en: The bullies gave him a {wedgie} during recess.
e.zh: 那群恶霸在课间把他的内裤往上拽。

e.en: Running in tight jeans gave her a {wedgie}.
e.zh: 穿紧身牛仔裤跑步让她的裤子卡进去了。

wedgwood.t: n. 玮致活（英国瓷器品牌）

e.en: Grandma displays her {Wedgwood} china in the cabinet.
e.zh: 奶奶把她的韦奇伍德瓷器陈列在柜子里。

e.en: The vase is genuine {Wedgwood} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 这个花瓶是十九世纪正品韦奇伍德瓷器。

e.en: The child was born out of {wedlock}.
e.zh: 这个孩子是非婚生子女。

e.en: They entered into {wedlock} after dating for years.
e.zh: 他们恋爱多年后步入婚姻。

e.en: The team meeting is every {Wednesday} at ten.
e.zh: 团队会议每周三上午十点举行。

e.en: I'll see the dentist next {Wednesday} afternoon.
e.zh: 我下周三下午要去看牙医。

wednesdays.t:
adv. 每逢周三
n. 星期三（复数）

e.en: The library closes early on {Wednesdays}.
e.zh: 图书馆每周三都提前关门。

e.en: We have yoga class on {Wednesdays} and Fridays.
e.zh: 我们每周三和周五有瑜伽课。

weds.t: v. wed 的第三人称单数；结婚

e.en: The prince {weds} his longtime girlfriend tomorrow.
e.zh: 王子明天将与交往多年的女友结婚。

e.en: She {weds} her childhood sweetheart this June.
e.zh: 她将在今年六月与青梅竹马结婚。

wee.t:
adj. 小小的；一点点的
n./v. 小便（口语）

weed.t:
n. 杂草
v. 除草

e.en: There's a stubborn {weed} growing through the cracks.
e.zh: 裂缝里长出了一株顽强的杂草。

e.en: I need to {weed} the vegetable garden this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末我得给菜园除草。

weeding.t:
n. 除草
v. 除草（weed 的现在分词）

e.en: She spent all morning {weeding} the flowerbeds.
e.zh: 她整个早上都在给花坛除草。

e.en: The manager is {weeding} out underperforming employees.
e.zh: 经理正在淘汰表现不佳的员工。

e.en: Spray {weedkiller} only on a dry, calm day.
e.zh: 只在干燥无风的日子里喷洒除草剂。

e.en: This {weedkiller} kills dandelions without harming grass.
e.zh: 这种除草剂能杀死蒲公英又不伤草坪。

e.en: A {weedless} lawn requires constant care and attention.
e.zh: 一片没有杂草的草坪需要不断的精心打理。

e.en: He uses a {weedless} fishing lure for bass.
e.zh: 他用一种防挂草的鱼饵钓鲈鱼。

e.en: The {weeds} in my garden grew back overnight.
e.zh: 我花园里的杂草一夜之间又长出来了。

e.en: Pull the {weeds} before they go to seed.
e.zh: 在杂草结籽之前把它们拔掉。

weedy.t: adj. 杂草丛生的；瘦弱的

e.en: The abandoned lot was overgrown and {weedy}.
e.zh: 那块废弃的空地上杂草丛生。

e.en: Frogs hide in the {weedy} edges of the pond.
e.zh: 青蛙藏在池塘边长满杂草的水域。

e.en: I have three meetings scheduled this {week}.
e.zh: 我这周安排了三个会议。

e.en: The package should arrive within a {week}.
e.zh: 包裹应该会在一周内送到。

e.en: The gym is less crowded during {weekday} mornings.
e.zh: 健身房在工作日早上人比较少。

e.en: I prefer to grocery shop on a {weekday}.
e.zh: 我喜欢在工作日去买菜。

weekdays.t:
n. 工作日（复数）
adv. 每逢工作日

e.en: The café opens at seven on {weekdays}.
e.zh: 咖啡馆工作日早上七点开门。

e.en: He commutes to the office on {weekdays} only.
e.zh: 他只在工作日通勤去办公室。

e.en: We're driving to the coast this {weekend}.
e.zh: 这个周末我们要开车去海边。

e.en: How was your {weekend} with the family?
e.zh: 你和家人一起的周末过得怎么样?

weekender.t: n. 度周末的人；周末旅行包

e.en: She packed a small {weekender} for the trip.
e.zh: 她为这趟旅行收拾了一个小周末旅行包。

e.en: The hotel offers a special rate for {weekender} guests.
e.zh: 酒店为周末短途游客提供特价。

weekends.t:
n. 周末（复数）
adv. 每逢周末

e.en: I usually sleep in on {weekends}.
e.zh: 周末我通常会睡懒觉。

e.en: The museum is free on the first {weekends} of each month.
e.zh: 博物馆每月第一个周末免费开放。

weekly.t:
adj./adv. 每周的；每周一次
n. 周刊

e.en: We hold a {weekly} team meeting every Monday morning.
e.zh: 我们每周一早上开一次团队会议。

e.en: The magazine is published {weekly} on Fridays.
e.zh: 这本杂志每周五出版。

e.en: I rarely cook on a {weeknight} after work.
e.zh: 工作日的晚上我很少做饭。

e.en: This recipe is perfect for a busy {weeknight} dinner.
e.zh: 这道菜很适合忙碌的工作日晚餐。

e.en: The package will arrive in two {weeks}.
e.zh: 包裹将在两周内到达。

e.en: She spent several {weeks} preparing for the exam.
e.zh: 她花了好几周准备考试。

e.en: Don't be such a {weenie} about the cold water.
e.zh: 别这么怕冷水嘛,真没胆。

e.en: He grilled a {weenie} for lunch at the cookout.
e.zh: 他在烧烤聚会上烤了根热狗当午餐。

e.en: She picked up the {weeny} kitten with both hands.
e.zh: 她用双手捧起那只小不点儿小猫。

e.en: There was a {weeny} crack in the glass.
e.zh: 玻璃上有一道极小的裂痕。

e.en: The little girl began to {weep} when her balloon popped.
e.zh: 小女孩的气球破了,开始啜泣。

e.en: Old wounds still {weep} fluid days after surgery.
e.zh: 旧伤口在手术后几天仍会渗液。

e.en: He's a quiet {weeper} during sad movies.
e.zh: 看悲伤电影时他会默默流泪。

e.en: The funeral hired a professional {weeper} as tradition.
e.zh: 按照传统,葬礼请了一位职业哭丧人。

weeping.t:
v. 哭泣（现在分词）
adj. 垂枝的（如垂柳）

e.en: She found him {weeping} alone in the garden.
e.zh: 她发现他独自一人在花园里哭泣。

e.en: A {weeping} willow stood beside the quiet pond.
e.zh: 一棵垂柳立在宁静的池塘边。

weeps.t: v. weep 的第三人称单数

e.en: The mother {weeps} every time she reads the letter.
e.zh: 母亲每次读那封信都会落泪。

e.en: The old roof {weeps} whenever it rains heavily.
e.zh: 每逢大雨,旧屋顶就会渗水。

e.en: I get {weepy} watching reunion videos online.
e.zh: 我看网上的重逢视频时容易哭。

e.en: She felt {weepy} and tired after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后她感到疲惫又想哭。

weetabix.t: n. 维他麦（英国麦片品牌）

e.en: He eats {weetabix} with warm milk every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上吃维他麦泡热牛奶。

e.en: A box of {weetabix} sat on the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 厨房台面上放着一盒维他麦麦片。

e.en: A {weevil} infestation ruined the stored grain.
e.zh: 象鼻虫害毁了储存的谷物。

e.en: Farmers spray crops to keep the {weevil} away.
e.zh: 农民给庄稼喷药以防象鼻虫。

e.en: The {weft} threads run across the loom horizontally.
e.zh: 纬线在织机上横向穿行。

e.en: This fabric uses silk for the {weft} and cotton warp.
e.zh: 这种布料用丝做纬线,棉做经线。

wehrmacht.t: n. 德国国防军（二战时期）

e.en: The documentary covered the {wehrmacht} retreat from Russia.
e.zh: 那部纪录片讲述了德国国防军从俄罗斯撤退的过程。

e.en: Historians still debate the {wehrmacht}'s role in wartime atrocities.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论德国国防军在战时暴行中的角色。

e.en: Please {weigh} the flour before adding it to the bowl.
e.zh: 请先称一下面粉再加入碗里。

e.en: You should {weigh} the pros and cons before deciding.
e.zh: 做决定前你应该权衡利弊。

e.en: The truck stopped at the {weighbridge} to record its load.
e.zh: 卡车在地磅站停下记录载重。

e.en: Every loaded lorry must cross the {weighbridge} before leaving.
e.zh: 每辆满载的货车离开前都要过地磅。

weighed.t: v. weigh 的过去式；称过重；权衡过

e.en: The nurse {weighed} the baby at the checkup.
e.zh: 护士在体检时给婴儿称了体重。

e.en: She {weighed} her options carefully before accepting the offer.
e.zh: 她仔细权衡后才接受了这个录用。

weighing.t:
v. 称重（现在分词）
n. 称重；衡量

e.en: He's {weighing} whether to take the new job.
e.zh: 他正在考虑是否接受这份新工作。

e.en: The cashier is {weighing} the apples right now.
e.zh: 收银员正在称苹果的重量。

weighs.t: v. weigh 的第三人称单数

e.en: This suitcase {weighs} more than the airline allows.
e.zh: 这个行李箱超过了航空公司允许的重量。

e.en: The decision {weighs} heavily on her mind.
e.zh: 这个决定让她心头沉重。

weight.t:
n. 重量；权重
v. 加权

e.en: He's been trying to lose {weight} for months.
e.zh: 他几个月来一直在努力减重。

e.en: Her opinion carries a lot of {weight} in the team.
e.zh: 她的意见在团队里很有分量。

e.en: The final grade is {weighted} toward the exam score.
e.zh: 最终成绩更侧重考试分数。

e.en: She slept under a {weighted} blanket to ease anxiety.
e.zh: 她盖着加重毯睡觉以缓解焦虑。

e.en: He spoke {weightily} about the company's future.
e.zh: 他郑重其事地谈论公司的未来。

e.en: The judge nodded {weightily} before announcing the verdict.
e.zh: 法官在宣判前郑重地点了点头。

e.en: The {weightiness} of the topic silenced the room.
e.zh: 话题的沉重让整个房间安静下来。

e.en: I admire the {weightiness} of her arguments in debates.
e.zh: 我欣赏她在辩论中论点的分量。

e.en: The algorithm uses a {weighting} system to rank results.
e.zh: 该算法使用加权系统对结果进行排名。

e.en: London staff receive a cost-of-living {weighting} in their salary.
e.zh: 伦敦员工的工资中包含生活费津贴。

e.en: Astronauts feel {weightless} as they orbit the Earth.
e.zh: 宇航员在绕地球飞行时感觉失重。

e.en: The new fabric feels almost {weightless} on the skin.
e.zh: 这种新面料贴在皮肤上几乎没有重量感。

e.en: Training prepares astronauts for the {weightlessness} of space.
e.zh: 训练让宇航员适应太空的失重环境。

e.en: She enjoyed the strange {weightlessness} of floating in the pool.
e.zh: 她享受在泳池里漂浮时奇妙的失重感。

e.en: The {weightlifter} broke the national record yesterday.
e.zh: 那位举重运动员昨天打破了全国纪录。

e.en: My brother trained as a competitive {weightlifter} in college.
e.zh: 我哥哥在大学时是一名职业举重运动员。

e.en: He lifts {weights} at the gym three times a week.
e.zh: 他每周去健身房举重三次。

e.en: The model assigns different {weights} to each input feature.
e.zh: 该模型为每个输入特征分配不同的权重。

e.en: The committee discussed several {weighty} matters this morning.
e.zh: 委员会今天上午讨论了几件重要的事。

e.en: He carried a {weighty} backpack up the steep trail.
e.zh: 他背着沉重的背包爬上陡峭的小径。

e.en: The {weimar} Republic collapsed under economic pressure in 1933.
e.zh: 魏玛共和国在 1933 年因经济压力而垮台。

e.en: Historians study {weimar} Germany to understand interwar politics.
e.zh: 历史学家研究魏玛德国以理解两战之间的政治。

e.en: Water cascaded loudly over the old stone {weir}.
e.zh: 水哗哗地从古老的石堰上倾泻而下。

e.en: Anglers gathered below the {weir} to catch trout.
e.zh: 垂钓者聚集在堰下捕捞鳟鱼。

e.en: That movie had a really {weird} ending.
e.zh: 那部电影的结局非常奇怪。

e.en: It's {weird} how often we run into each other.
e.zh: 我们这么常碰到对方,真有点奇怪。

e.en: The room was {weirdly} quiet after the announcement.
e.zh: 宣布消息后房间出奇地安静。

e.en: He smiled {weirdly} when asked about his weekend.
e.zh: 被问到周末时,他笑得很怪。

e.en: There's a charming {weirdness} to this little café.
e.zh: 这家小咖啡馆有种讨人喜欢的怪味。

e.en: I love the {weirdness} of Japanese variety shows.
e.zh: 我喜欢日本综艺节目的那种奇葩感。

e.en: Don't call your brother a {weirdo} just because he likes anime.
e.zh: 别因为弟弟喜欢动漫就叫他怪胎。

e.en: Some {weirdo} kept staring at me on the subway.
e.zh: 地铁上有个怪人一直盯着我看。

welch.t:
v. 赖账；食言
n. 韦尔奇（姓氏）

e.en: Don't {welch} on the bet you lost fair and square.
e.zh: 输了的赌注就别赖账。

e.en: He tried to {welch} on his promise to help us move.
e.zh: 他想赖掉帮我们搬家的承诺。

welcome.t:
v. 欢迎
adj. 受欢迎的

e.en: You're always {welcome} to stay at our place.
e.zh: 你随时都可以来我们家住。

e.en: The hotel staff gave us a warm {welcome} on arrival.
e.zh: 酒店员工在我们到达时给予了热情的欢迎。

welcomed.t:
v. 欢迎（过去式）
adj. 受欢迎的

e.en: Neighbors {welcomed} the new family with homemade cookies.
e.zh: 邻居们用自制饼干欢迎新搬来的家庭。

e.en: The team {welcomed} the fresh ideas from the intern.
e.zh: 团队对实习生的新想法表示欢迎。

welcomes.t: v. 欢迎（第三人称单数）

e.en: The library {welcomes} visitors of all ages.
e.zh: 图书馆欢迎各年龄段的访客。

e.en: She {welcomes} every guest with a smile and tea.
e.zh: 她以微笑和茶迎接每一位客人。

welcoming.t:
adj. 热情友好的
v. 欢迎（进行式）

e.en: The café has a warm and {welcoming} atmosphere.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆氛围温暖宜人。

e.en: They were busy {welcoming} guests at the front door.
e.zh: 他们正忙着在门口迎接客人。

weld.t:
v. 焊接
n. 焊缝

e.en: The mechanic will {weld} the broken pipe back together.
e.zh: 机械师会把断裂的管子焊接起来。

e.en: Shared hardship can {weld} a team into a family.
e.zh: 共同经历苦难能让团队凝聚成一家人。

welded.t:
v. 焊接（过去式）
adj. 焊接的

e.en: The frame is {welded} steel for extra strength.
e.zh: 车架是焊接钢制的,以增加强度。

e.en: Years of touring {welded} the band members into close friends.
e.zh: 多年的巡演让乐队成员成了亲密的朋友。

e.en: My uncle works as a {welder} at the shipyard.
e.zh: 我叔叔在船厂当焊工。

e.en: A skilled {welder} can earn a very good salary.
e.zh: 熟练的焊工能赚到很不错的薪水。

e.en: He's been {welding} car parts for over twenty years.
e.zh: 他焊接汽车零件已经超过二十年。

e.en: Always wear a mask when {welding} to protect your eyes.
e.zh: 焊接时一定要戴面罩保护眼睛。

e.en: The charity focuses on the {welfare} of stray animals.
e.zh: 该慈善机构专注于流浪动物的福利。

e.en: Many families rely on {welfare} during tough economic times.
e.zh: 许多家庭在经济困难时期依靠社会福利。

well.t:
adv. 好地；很
n. 井

e.en: She plays the guitar really {well} for a beginner.
e.zh: 作为初学者,她吉他弹得相当不错。

e.en: The villagers draw drinking water from a deep {well}.
e.zh: 村民们从一口深井里取饮用水。

e.en: A {well-balanced} diet includes vegetables, protein, and whole grains.
e.zh: 均衡饮食包括蔬菜、蛋白质和全谷物。

e.en: She's a calm and {well-balanced} person under pressure.
e.zh: 她是个在压力下依然冷静、性格稳健的人。

e.en: Regular exercise is essential for mental {well-being}.
e.zh: 定期锻炼对心理健康至关重要。

e.en: The company invests in employee {well-being} programs.
e.zh: 公司投资于员工的健康福祉项目。

well-beings.t: n. 健康；幸福（复数罕用）

e.en: Policies should consider the {well-beings} of all citizens.
e.zh: 政策应当考虑全体公民的福祉。

e.en: The report compares the {well-beings} of urban and rural children.
e.zh: 报告比较了城市和农村儿童的福祉状况。

well-built.t: adj. 体格健壮的；结构牢固的

e.en: This {well-built} cabin has survived a hundred winters.
e.zh: 这间结实的木屋已经熬过了上百个冬天。

e.en: The lifeguard was tall, tanned, and {well-built}.
e.zh: 那位救生员个子高,皮肤晒得黝黑,身材健壮。

e.en: A {well-dressed} man stepped out of the black limousine.
e.zh: 一位衣着考究的男士从黑色豪华轿车中走了出来。

e.en: You should look {well-dressed} for the job interview tomorrow.
e.zh: 你明天面试时穿着应该得体一些。

e.en: The {well-groomed} dog won first prize at the show.
e.zh: 那只毛发整洁的狗在比赛中获得了一等奖。

e.en: She is always {well-groomed}, even on weekends.
e.zh: 即使在周末,她也总是打理得干净利落。

well-known.t: adj. 著名的；众所周知的

e.en: He is a {well-known} chef in New York City.
e.zh: 他是纽约市一位知名的厨师。

e.en: It's a {well-known} fact that smoking damages your lungs.
e.zh: 吸烟损害肺部是众所周知的事实。

well-organised.t: adj. 组织良好的；有条理的

e.en: The conference was {well-organised} from start to finish.
e.zh: 这场会议从头到尾组织得井井有条。

e.en: She keeps a {well-organised} desk with everything labeled.
e.zh: 她的桌子整理得很有条理,所有东西都贴了标签。

well-organized.t: adj. 组织良好的；有条理的

e.en: A {well-organized} closet saves you time every morning.
e.zh: 整理得井井有条的衣柜能让你每天早晨节省时间。

e.en: The protest was peaceful and remarkably {well-organized}.
e.zh: 这次抗议活动和平进行,组织得非常出色。

e.en: Software engineers tend to be {well-paid} in this region.
e.zh: 在这个地区,软件工程师的薪水通常很高。

e.en: She left teaching for a more {well-paid} corporate job.
e.zh: 她辞去教职,转而从事一份薪水更高的公司工作。

e.en: My salon uses {Wella} hair color exclusively for clients.
e.zh: 我们的沙龙专门为顾客使用威娜染发产品。

e.en: She bought a {Wella} shampoo recommended by her stylist.
e.zh: 她买了一瓶造型师推荐的威娜洗发水。

e.en: The {Welland} Canal connects Lake Erie to Lake Ontario.
e.zh: 韦兰运河连接着伊利湖和安大略湖。

e.en: Ships pass through {Welland} to bypass Niagara Falls.
e.zh: 船只通过韦兰运河绕过尼亚加拉瀑布。

e.en: Daily exercise improves both physical and mental {wellbeing}.
e.zh: 每天锻炼能改善身心健康。

e.en: The company offers programs to support employee {wellbeing}.
e.zh: 公司提供多项关注员工身心健康的项目。

wellcome.t: n. 惠康（基金会/品牌名）

e.en: The {Wellcome} Trust funds biomedical research around the world.
e.zh: 惠康基金会资助全球的生物医学研究。

e.en: She visited the {Wellcome} Collection museum in London last weekend.
e.zh: 她上周末参观了伦敦的惠康博物馆。

e.en: Inspector {Weller} solved the case in three days.
e.zh: 韦勒探长在三天内破了案。

e.en: My grandmother's {Weller} pottery vase is over a century old.
e.zh: 我祖母那只韦勒陶器花瓶已有一百多年的历史。

wellesley.t: n. 韦尔斯利（地名/学院名）

e.en: She graduated from {Wellesley} College with honors last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天以优异成绩从韦尔斯利学院毕业。

e.en: {Wellesley} is known for educating influential women leaders.
e.zh: 韦尔斯利学院以培养有影响力的女性领袖而闻名。

e.en: Engineers inspected the {wellhead} for signs of pressure leaks.
e.zh: 工程师们检查井口是否有压力泄漏的迹象。

e.en: The {wellhead} sits on the ocean floor below the rig.
e.zh: 井口位于钻井平台下方的海底。

wellie.t: n. 雨靴（wellington 的口语缩写）

e.en: He pulled on a {wellie} before walking through the mud.
e.zh: 他穿上一只雨靴才走进泥地里。

e.en: My {wellie} got stuck in the deep garden mud.
e.zh: 我的雨靴陷在花园的深泥里拔不出来。

e.en: Tears were {welling} up in her eyes during the speech.
e.zh: 演讲时她眼里涌出了泪水。

e.en: A sense of pride was {welling} inside him slowly.
e.zh: 一股自豪感慢慢在他心中涌起。

wellingborough.t: n. 韦林伯勒（英国地名）

e.en: My cousin moved to {Wellingborough} for a new job.
e.zh: 我表弟为了一份新工作搬去了威灵伯勒。

e.en: The train from London to {Wellingborough} takes about an hour.
e.zh: 从伦敦到威灵伯勒的火车大约需要一个小时。

westernizer.t: n. 西化者；主张西方化的人

e.en: Peter the Great was a famous {westernizer} of Russia.
e.zh: 彼得大帝是著名的俄国西化派人物。

e.en: Critics labeled the reformer a {westernizer} of local culture.
e.zh: 批评者把这位改革者称作本土文化的西化者。

e.en: Attu is the {westernmost} island in the Aleutian chain.
e.zh: 阿图岛是阿留申群岛最西端的岛屿。

e.en: We drove to the {westernmost} point of the country.
e.zh: 我们开车到了这个国家的最西端。

westfield.t: n. 韦斯特菲尔德（地名）

e.en: I bought new sneakers at the {Westfield} mall yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天在 Westfield 购物中心买了新运动鞋。

e.en: The London {Westfield} is one of Europe's largest shopping centers.
e.zh: 伦敦 Westfield 是欧洲最大的购物中心之一。

westinghouse.t: n. 西屋公司（美国电气品牌）

e.en: Our kitchen still uses an old {Westinghouse} refrigerator.
e.zh: 我们厨房还在用一台旧的西屋牌冰箱。

e.en: {Westinghouse} competed fiercely with Edison over electrical standards.
e.zh: 西屋公司曾与爱迪生在电力标准上激烈竞争。

westlake.t: n. 韦斯特莱克（人名/地名）

e.en: She grew up in {Westlake}, a quiet suburb of Cleveland.
e.zh: 她在克利夫兰宁静的郊区韦斯特莱克长大。

e.en: The {Westlake} district has trendy cafes and boutiques.
e.zh: 韦斯特莱克区有潮流咖啡馆和精品店。

e.en: {Westland} helicopters were widely used by the British military.
e.zh: 韦斯特兰直升机曾被英军广泛使用。

e.en: We took a road trip through the {Westland} region.
e.zh: 我们开车穿越了韦斯特兰地区。

westminster.t: n. 威斯敏斯特（伦敦区，英国议会代称）

e.en: Parliament meets at the Palace of {Westminster} in London.
e.zh: 议会在伦敦的威斯敏斯特宫开会。

e.en: The {Westminster} dog show airs on TV every February.
e.zh: 威斯敏斯特犬展每年二月在电视上播出。

westmoreland.t: n. 韦斯特摩兰（人名/地名）

e.en: General {Westmoreland} commanded U.S. forces during the Vietnam War.
e.zh: 威斯特摩兰将军在越战期间指挥美军。

e.en: {Westmoreland} County lies in southwestern Pennsylvania.
e.zh: 威斯特摩兰县位于宾夕法尼亚州西南部。

westmorland.t: n. 威斯特摩兰（英国旧郡）

e.en: {Westmorland} was a historic county in northwest England.
e.zh: 威斯特摩兰是英格兰西北部的一个历史郡。

e.en: The old {Westmorland} estate now belongs to the National Trust.
e.zh: 那座古老的威斯特摩兰庄园现归国家信托所有。

e.en: We spent the weekend in {Weston}-super-Mare by the seaside.
e.zh: 我们在海边的滨海韦斯顿度过了周末。

e.en: Edward {Weston} is regarded as a master of photography.
e.zh: 爱德华·韦斯顿被视为摄影大师。

westphalia.t: n. 威斯特伐利亚（德国地区）

e.en: The Treaty of {Westphalia} ended the Thirty Years' War in 1648.
e.zh: 威斯特伐利亚条约于 1648 年结束了三十年战争。

e.en: My grandfather was born in a small village in {Westphalia}.
e.zh: 我祖父出生在威斯特伐利亚的一个小村庄。

westphalian.t:
adj. 威斯特伐利亚的
n. 威斯特伐利亚人

e.en: The {Westphalian} ham is famous across Germany.
e.zh: 威斯特伐利亚火腿在德国闻名。

e.en: Modern diplomacy still rests on {Westphalian} principles of sovereignty.
e.zh: 现代外交仍建立在威斯特伐利亚主权原则之上。

e.en: {Westport} is a charming coastal town in County Mayo.
e.zh: 韦斯特波特是梅奥郡一座迷人的海滨小镇。

e.en: Many wealthy families have summer homes in {Westport}, Connecticut.
e.zh: 许多富裕家庭在康州韦斯特波特拥有避暑别墅。

wests.t: n. west 的复数；西部地区

e.en: The {Wests} invited us over for Sunday dinner.
e.zh: 韦斯特一家邀请我们周日去吃饭。

e.en: The {Wests} have lived on this street for decades.
e.zh: 韦斯特一家在这条街上住了几十年。

westward.t:
adv. 向西
adj. 向西的

e.en: The wagon train moved {westward} across the prairie.
e.zh: 篷车队向西穿越大草原前进。

e.en: Pioneers traveled {westward} in search of gold and land.
e.zh: 拓荒者向西迁徙寻找黄金和土地。

e.en: The river flows {westwards} into the Atlantic Ocean.
e.zh: 这条河向西流入大西洋。

e.en: We sailed {westwards} for three days before sighting land.
e.zh: 我们向西航行了三天才看到陆地。

westwood.t: n. 韦斯特伍德（人名/地名）

e.en: UCLA is located in the {Westwood} neighborhood of Los Angeles.
e.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校位于洛杉矶的韦斯特伍德区。

e.en: Vivienne {Westwood} revolutionized British punk fashion.
e.zh: 薇薇安·韦斯特伍德革新了英国朋克时尚。

wet.t:
adj. 湿的；潮湿的
v. 弄湿

wetback.t: n. (贬) 偷渡入美的墨西哥人

e.en: The slur {wetback} is deeply offensive and should never be used.
e.zh: "wetback"是一个极具冒犯性的蔑称,绝不应使用。

e.en: The book examines how the term {wetback} reflects historical racism.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了"wetback"一词如何反映历史上的种族主义。

e.en: The farmer keeps a {wether} to lead the flock.
e.zh: 农夫养了一只阉公羊来带领羊群。

e.en: A {wether} is a castrated male sheep.
e.zh: wether 是指被阉割的公羊。

e.en: {Wetherby} is a small market town in West Yorkshire.
e.zh: 韦瑟比是西约克郡的一座小集镇。

e.en: The races at {Wetherby} attract crowds every winter.
e.zh: 韦瑟比赛马每年冬天都吸引大批观众。

e.en: The {wetland} provides habitat for migrating birds.
e.zh: 这片湿地为迁徙鸟类提供了栖息地。

e.en: Developers want to drain the {wetland} for housing.
e.zh: 开发商想排干这片湿地用于建房。

e.en: Coastal {wetlands} protect cities from hurricane storm surges.
e.zh: 沿海湿地能保护城市免受飓风风暴潮侵袭。

e.en: Many {wetlands} have been lost to agriculture and development.
e.zh: 许多湿地因农业和开发而消失。

e.en: His shoes squelched {wetly} on the marble floor.
e.zh: 他的鞋在大理石地板上湿漉漉地嘎吱作响。

e.en: The dog shook itself {wetly} after the bath.
e.zh: 狗洗完澡后湿淋淋地抖了抖身子。

e.en: I could feel the {wetness} of the grass through my socks.
e.zh: 我能透过袜子感觉到草地的湿润。

e.en: The towel absorbs {wetness} better than ordinary fabric.
e.zh: 这条毛巾比普通织物更能吸水。

e.en: She zipped up her {wetsuit} before paddling out.
e.zh: 她拉上潜水服的拉链才划水出海。

e.en: A thick {wetsuit} keeps surfers warm in cold water.
e.zh: 厚实的湿式潜水服能让冲浪者在冷水中保持温暖。

wetted.t: v. wet 的过去式；弄湿

e.en: She {wetted} the brush before applying the watercolor.
e.zh: 她在上水彩之前先把画笔蘸湿。

e.en: He {wetted} his lips nervously before speaking.
e.zh: 他紧张地舔湿嘴唇才开口说话。

wetting.t:
v. wet 的现在分词
n. 润湿

e.en: The toddler keeps {wetting} the bed at night.
e.zh: 这个幼儿晚上总是尿床。

e.en: Avoid {wetting} the electronics while cleaning the desk.
e.zh: 清理书桌时避免把电子设备弄湿。

wetware.t: n. 湿件（指人脑，相对软硬件）

e.en: Some hackers joke that human brains are unreliable {wetware}.
e.zh: 一些黑客开玩笑说人脑是不可靠的"湿件"。

e.en: Sci-fi novels often explore merging hardware with biological {wetware}.
e.zh: 科幻小说常探讨将硬件与生物湿件融合。

weu.t: n. 西欧联盟（Western European Union）

wexford.t: n. 韦克斯福德（爱尔兰地名）

e.en: {Wexford} is a charming harbor town in southeast Ireland.
e.zh: 韦克斯福德是爱尔兰东南部一座迷人的港口小镇。

e.en: The {Wexford} Opera Festival draws music lovers every autumn.
e.zh: 韦克斯福德歌剧节每年秋天吸引乐迷前来。

weybridge.t: n. 韦布里奇（英国地名）

e.en: {Weybridge} is an affluent town in Surrey, England.
e.zh: 韦布里奇是英格兰萨里郡一座富裕的小镇。

e.en: Several Premier League players live in {Weybridge}.
e.zh: 多名英超球员住在韦布里奇。

weymouth.t: n. 韦茅斯（英国港口城市）

e.en: We spent a sunny afternoon on {Weymouth} beach.
e.zh: 我们在韦茅斯海滩度过了一个阳光明媚的下午。

e.en: {Weymouth} hosted the sailing events of the 2012 Olympics.
e.zh: 韦茅斯举办了 2012 年奥运会的帆船赛事。

wfs.t: n. Web Feature Service（地理信息服务）

whack.t:
v. 重击；猛打
n. 重击声

e.en: Give the vending machine a good {whack} if it jams.
e.zh: 自动售货机卡住的话就用力拍它一下。

e.en: He took a {whack} at solving the puzzle.
e.zh: 他试着解了一下这个谜题。

whacked.t:
adj. 精疲力竭的
v. 猛击（过去式）

e.en: She {whacked} the ball clear over the fence.
e.zh: 她一棒把球打过了围栏。

e.en: I'm completely {whacked} after that twelve-hour flight.
e.zh: 坐了十二小时的飞机后我累得不行。

whacking.t:
adj. 极大的
n. 猛打

e.en: He charged a {whacking} great fee for the repair.
e.zh: 他为这次维修收取了一笔超高的费用。

e.en: Stop {whacking} the table with your spoon!
e.zh: 别再用勺子敲桌子了!

e.en: Some {whacko} on the subway started yelling at strangers.
e.zh: 地铁上有个怪人开始对陌生人大吼大叫。

e.en: His {whacko} theories about aliens entertain his friends.
e.zh: 他那些关于外星人的疯狂理论把朋友们逗乐了。

whacky.t: adj. 古怪的；疯疯癫癫的

e.en: She has a {whacky} sense of humor that everyone loves.
e.zh: 她有一种大家都喜欢的古怪幽默感。

e.en: The film is full of {whacky} characters and plot twists.
e.zh: 这部电影充满古怪的角色和情节转折。

whale.t:
n. 鲸鱼
v. 捕鲸

e.en: A blue {whale} can weigh up to 200 tons.
e.zh: 一头蓝鲸的体重可达 200 吨。

e.en: The casino treats every high-roller {whale} like royalty.
e.zh: 赌场把每个豪赌大客户都当王室般对待。

e.en: Victorian corsets were stiffened with strips of {whalebone}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的紧身胸衣用鲸须条加固。

e.en: The museum displays an intricately carved {whalebone} ornament.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一件精雕细琢的鲸骨饰品。

e.en: His grandfather was a {whaler} sailing out of Nantucket.
e.zh: 他祖父曾是从楠塔基特岛出海的捕鲸人。

e.en: The old {whaler} ship has been converted into a museum.
e.zh: 那艘旧捕鲸船已被改造成博物馆。

e.en: Tourists watch {whales} breaching off the coast each summer.
e.zh: 游客们每年夏天在海岸边观看鲸鱼跃出水面。

e.en: Humpback {whales} migrate thousands of miles every year.
e.zh: 座头鲸每年迁徙数千英里。

wellington.t:
n. 惠灵顿（新西兰首都）
n. 长筒靴

e.en: {Wellington} is the capital city of New Zealand.
e.zh: 惠灵顿是新西兰的首都。

e.en: He pulled on his {wellington} boots before going outside.
e.zh: 他穿上惠灵顿长筒靴才出门。

wellness.t: n. 健康；身心健康状态

e.en: Many companies now offer {wellness} programs for their employees.
e.zh: 如今许多公司都为员工提供健康养生项目。

e.en: She runs a {wellness} blog about meditation and yoga.
e.zh: 她经营一个关于冥想和瑜伽的健康养生博客。

e.en: Several {wells} in the village dried up last summer.
e.zh: 村里有几口井去年夏天干涸了。

e.en: H.G. {Wells} wrote The Time Machine in 1895.
e.zh: H·G·威尔斯于1895年写下了《时间机器》。

e.en: Her grandmother was a {wellspring} of family stories.
e.zh: 她的祖母是家族故事的源泉。

e.en: Curiosity is the {wellspring} of all great discoveries.
e.zh: 好奇心是一切伟大发现的源泉。

welly.t: n. 橡胶雨靴（英式口语）

e.en: Put some {welly} into it and push harder!
e.zh: 使点劲儿,再用力推一下!

e.en: She wore one pink {welly} and one blue.
e.zh: 她穿着一只粉色雨靴和一只蓝色雨靴。

welsh.t:
adj. 威尔士的
n. 威尔士语

e.en: Many street signs in Cardiff are written in {Welsh}.
e.zh: 加迪夫的许多路牌都用威尔士语书写。

e.en: He's learning to speak {Welsh} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他正在跟祖父学说威尔士语。

e.en: The {Welshman} sang a beautiful folk song at the pub.
e.zh: 那位威尔士人在酒馆里唱了一首优美的民歌。

e.en: My neighbor is a proud {Welshman} from Swansea.
e.zh: 我的邻居是一位来自斯旺西、引以为豪的威尔士人。

welt.t:
n. 鞭痕；伤痕
n. (鞋) 贴边

e.en: The mosquito bite left a red {welt} on her arm.
e.zh: 蚊子叮咬在她胳膊上留下了一个红色的肿包。

e.en: These shoes have a leather {welt} sewn around the sole.
e.zh: 这些鞋的鞋底周围缝着一圈皮革沿条。

e.en: His {weltanschauung} was shaped by years of travel abroad.
e.zh: 他的世界观是多年海外旅行塑造而成的。

e.en: The novel explores the {weltanschauung} of post-war Germany.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了战后德国的世界观。

welter.t:
n. 混乱；杂乱一堆
v. 翻滚

e.en: The report contained a {welter} of confusing statistics.
e.zh: 那份报告里充斥着一大堆令人困惑的统计数据。

e.en: She faced a {welter} of emotions after the news.
e.zh: 得知消息后,她百感交集,情绪翻涌。

e.en: He won the {welterweight} title in his first championship fight.
e.zh: 他在首场冠军赛中赢得了次中量级冠军头衔。

e.en: The {welterweight} division has produced many legendary boxers.
e.zh: 次中量级赛事中涌现了许多传奇拳击手。

wembley.t: n. 温布利（伦敦地名、球场）

e.en: The cup final will be held at {Wembley} Stadium.
e.zh: 杯赛决赛将在温布利体育场举行。

e.en: My dad watched England play at {Wembley} in 1966.
e.zh: 我父亲于1966年在温布利球场观看了英格兰队的比赛。

e.en: Good King {Wenceslas} is a popular Christmas carol.
e.zh: 《善良的温塞斯拉斯王》是一首流行的圣诞颂歌。

e.en: Saint {Wenceslas} is the patron saint of the Czech state.
e.zh: 圣温塞斯拉斯是捷克国家的主保圣人。

e.en: The tavern {wench} carried mugs of ale to the table.
e.zh: 酒馆女仆端着几杯麦芽酒走到桌前。

e.en: His novel features a clever {wench} who outsmarts the king.
e.zh: 他的小说里有一位机智的村姑,把国王耍得团团转。

e.en: We slowly {wend} our way home through the quiet streets.
e.zh: 我们沿着静谧的街道慢慢往家走去。

e.en: The river {wends} through several small villages.
e.zh: 那条河蜿蜒流经几个小村庄。

e.en: {Wenlock} was the official mascot of the 2012 London Olympics.
e.zh: 文洛克是2012年伦敦奥运会的官方吉祥物。

e.en: Much {Wenlock} is a charming market town in Shropshire.
e.zh: 马奇文洛克是什罗普郡一个迷人的集镇。

wensleydale.t: n. 温斯利代尔（奶酪/地名）

e.en: I love crumbly {Wensleydale} cheese with sweet apple pie.
e.zh: 我喜欢用松脆的温斯利戴尔奶酪搭配甜苹果派。

e.en: The {Wensleydale} dairy has produced cheese for centuries.
e.zh: 温斯利戴尔乳品厂已经制作奶酪数百年了。

e.en: She {went} to the gym after work yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天下班后去了健身房。

e.en: The kids {went} home as soon as it started raining.
e.zh: 孩子们一开始下雨就回家了。

wentworth.t: n. 温特沃斯（姓氏/地名）

e.en: The famous golf course at {Wentworth} hosts major tournaments.
e.zh: 温特沃斯著名的高尔夫球场举办过多项重要赛事。

e.en: Captain {Wentworth} is the romantic hero in Austen's Persuasion.
e.zh: 温特沃斯上校是奥斯汀《劝导》中的浪漫男主角。

were.t: v. be 的过去式（复数/第二人称）

e.en: They {were} excited about the surprise birthday party.
e.zh: 他们对那场惊喜生日派对感到非常兴奋。

e.en: If I {were} you, I'd take the morning flight.
e.zh: 如果我是你,我会选择搭乘早班飞机。

e.en: The {werewolf} transforms whenever the full moon rises.
e.zh: 每当满月升起,那狼人就会变身。

e.en: Her novel features a friendly {werewolf} living in Brooklyn.
e.zh: 她的小说讲述了一只住在布鲁克林的友善狼人。

wesleyan.t: adj. 卫斯理宗的；卫理公会的

e.en: She studies music at {Wesleyan} University in Connecticut.
e.zh: 她在康涅狄格州的卫斯理大学学习音乐。

e.en: The {Wesleyan} church on the corner was built in 1890.
e.zh: 街角那座卫理公会教堂建于1890年。

wessex.t: n. 韦塞克斯（英格兰古王国）

e.en: King Alfred ruled the kingdom of {Wessex} in the ninth century.
e.zh: 阿尔弗雷德国王于九世纪统治威塞克斯王国。

e.en: Thomas Hardy set many novels in fictional {Wessex}.
e.zh: 托马斯·哈代将许多小说设定在虚构的威塞克斯。

e.en: The Smith and {Wesson} revolver is a classic American firearm.
e.zh: 史密斯威森左轮手枪是美国经典枪械。

e.en: My grandfather always cooked with {Wesson} vegetable oil.
e.zh: 我祖父做饭时总是用威臣牌植物油。

west.t:
n. 西方
adj. 西方的

e.en: The sun sets in the {west} every evening.
e.zh: 太阳每天傍晚都从西方落下。

e.en: She moved out {west} to start a new career.
e.zh: 她搬到西部去开启新的事业。

e.en: The {westbound} train departs from platform three at noon.
e.zh: 西行列车将于中午从三号站台出发。

e.en: Heavy traffic is reported on the {westbound} highway today.
e.zh: 据报道今天西行高速公路交通拥堵严重。

westbrook.t: n. 韦斯特布鲁克（姓氏/地名）

e.en: Russell {Westbrook} averaged a triple-double for an entire NBA season.
e.zh: 拉塞尔·韦斯布鲁克曾在整个NBA赛季场均拿下三双。

e.en: We rented a cottage in {Westbrook} for the summer.
e.zh: 我们在韦斯特布鲁克租了一间小屋过夏天。

e.en: The white horse carved into {Westbury} hill is centuries old.
e.zh: 刻在韦斯特伯里山上的白马图案有几百年历史。

e.en: My aunt lives in a small village near {Westbury}.
e.zh: 我姑姑住在韦斯特伯里附近的一个小村庄里。

wester.t:
v. 向西移动
adj. 西部的

e.en: The ship sailed before a strong {wester} across the Atlantic.
e.zh: 那艘船借着强劲的西风横渡大西洋。

e.en: Old sailors feared the autumn {wester} along the coast.
e.zh: 老水手们害怕秋季沿岸的西风。

e.en: The {westering} sun cast long shadows across the field.
e.zh: 西沉的夕阳在田野上投下长长的影子。

e.en: Pioneers spent months {westering} across the great plains.
e.zh: 拓荒者们花了数月时间向西穿越大平原。

westerly.t:
adj. 向西的；来自西方的
n. 西风

e.en: A strong {westerly} wind blew the sailboat off course.
e.zh: 一阵强劲的西风把帆船吹离了航线。

e.en: The kitchen window faces a {westerly} direction toward the garden.
e.zh: 厨房窗户朝西,正对着花园。

western.t:
adj. 西方的；西部的
n. 西部片

e.en: Many {Western} countries adopted similar climate policies last year.
e.zh: 去年许多西方国家采取了相似的气候政策。

e.en: He grew up watching old {western} movies with his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从小和祖父一起看老西部片长大。

e.en: As a {westerner}, I struggled to adapt to Tokyo customs.
e.zh: 作为一个西方人,我难以适应东京的风俗习惯。

e.en: The villagers had rarely met a {westerner} before our visit.
e.zh: 在我们到访之前,村民们很少见到西方人。

e.en: Some critics argue that fast food helps to {westernize} local cuisines.
e.zh: 一些评论家认为快餐让本地饮食西化了。

e.en: The reforms aimed to {westernize} the country's education system.
e.zh: 这些改革旨在使该国的教育体系西方化。

e.en: Tokyo became heavily {westernized} after the Meiji Restoration.
e.zh: 明治维新后东京深度西化。

e.en: The menu offers {westernized} versions of classic Sichuan dishes.
e.zh: 菜单提供西化版本的经典川菜。

e.en: She returned to the village {whence} her family came.
e.zh: 她回到了她家族出身的那个村子。

e.en: No one knew {whence} the strange noise came.
e.zh: 没有人知道那奇怪的声音是从哪里来的。

e.en: Call me {whenever} you need help with the project.
e.zh: 项目上需要帮忙时随时给我打电话。

e.en: {Whenever} it rains, the road floods badly.
e.zh: 每当下雨时，那条路就会严重积水。

where.t:
adv. 在哪里
conj. 在…的地方

e.en: Do you know {where} the nearest pharmacy is?
e.zh: 你知道最近的药店在哪里吗？

e.en: This is the cafe {where} we first met.
e.zh: 这就是我们第一次见面的那家咖啡馆。

whereabouts.t:
n. 下落；行踪
adv. 在何处

e.en: Police are searching for the suspect's {whereabouts}.
e.zh: 警方正在搜寻嫌疑人的下落。

e.en: {Whereabouts} in Tokyo did you grow up?
e.zh: 你在东京的什么地方长大的？

e.en: He loves spicy food, {whereas} she prefers mild dishes.
e.zh: 他喜欢辣的食物，而她偏爱清淡的菜肴。

e.en: Cats are independent, {whereas} dogs crave attention.
e.zh: 猫很独立，而狗则渴望被关注。

e.en: They reached an agreement {whereby} both sides benefit.
e.zh: 他们达成了一项双方都能获益的协议。

e.en: The system {whereby} students earn credits is changing.
e.zh: 学生赚取学分所依据的制度正在改变。

e.en: Romeo, Romeo, {wherefore} art thou Romeo?
e.zh: 罗密欧啊罗密欧，你为何偏偏是罗密欧？

e.en: She explained the whys and {wherefores} of the decision.
e.zh: 她解释了这个决定的来龙去脉。

e.en: This is the chapter {wherein} the hero finally triumphs.
e.zh: 这就是主人公最终获胜的那一章。

e.en: He described a world {wherein} machines think for themselves.
e.zh: 他描绘了一个机器能独立思考的世界。

e.en: He spoke of matters {whereof} he had no real knowledge.
e.zh: 他谈论的是他并不真正了解的事情。

e.en: The book {whereof} I spoke is now out of print.
e.zh: 我提到的那本书现在已经绝版了。

e.en: This is the hill {whereon} the old castle once stood.
e.zh: 这就是那座古堡曾经矗立的山丘。

e.en: She showed him the table {whereon} the contract lay.
e.zh: 她指给他看那张放着合同的桌子。

e.en: He vowed to follow her {wheresoever} she might go.
e.zh: 他发誓无论她去到哪里他都会跟随。

e.en: {Wheresoever} two or more gather, ideas will spark.
e.zh: 无论何处只要两人或更多人聚集，思想就会碰撞。

e.en: She finished the speech, {whereupon} the crowd cheered.
e.zh: 她讲完话，于是人群欢呼起来。

e.en: He insulted the host, {whereupon} they were all asked to leave.
e.zh: 他侮辱了主人，结果所有人都被请了出去。

e.en: You can sit {wherever} you like at the table.
e.zh: 你可以在桌边随便挑个位置坐。

e.en: She brings her laptop {wherever} she travels.
e.zh: 她无论去哪里旅行都带着笔记本电脑。

e.en: He lacks the {wherewithal} to start his own business.
e.zh: 他没有自己创业所需的财力。

e.en: Few families have the {wherewithal} to pay full tuition.
e.zh: 很少有家庭有能力支付全额学费。

e.en: The trailer really {whet} my appetite for the movie.
e.zh: 预告片大大激起了我对这部电影的兴趣。

e.en: A small sample is enough to {whet} curiosity.
e.zh: 一个小样品就足以勾起人的好奇心。

e.en: I'm not sure {whether} to accept the job offer.
e.zh: 我不确定是否要接受这份工作邀请。

e.en: Call me {whether} or not you can make it.
e.zh: 无论你能不能来都给我打个电话。

e.en: He sharpened the knife on a wet {whetstone}.
e.zh: 他在湿磨刀石上磨那把刀。

e.en: A good {whetstone} can last for many years.
e.zh: 一块好的磨刀石可以用很多年。

whew.t: interj. 哎呀（表松口气或惊讶）

e.en: {Whew}, I just made it onto the last train.
e.zh: 呼,我刚好赶上了最后一班火车。

e.en: {Whew}, that exam was much harder than expected.
e.zh: 哎呀,那场考试比预想的难多了。

e.en: Many protein powders are made from milk {whey}.
e.zh: 许多蛋白粉都是用牛奶乳清制成的。

e.en: After making cheese, the leftover {whey} can feed pigs.
e.zh: 做完奶酪后,剩下的乳清可以喂猪。

which.t: pron. 哪一个；which 从句引导词

e.en: {Which} flavor of ice cream do you want?
e.zh: 你想要哪种口味的冰淇淋?

e.en: She bought a phone {which} has an excellent camera.
e.zh: 她买了一部相机非常出色的手机。

e.en: Take {whichever} seat is most comfortable for you.
e.zh: 挑你觉得最舒服的那个座位坐。

e.en: You can use {whichever} browser you prefer.
e.zh: 你可以用任何你喜欢的浏览器。

e.en: The horses softly {whicker} when they see their owner.
e.zh: 马儿见到主人时轻声嘶鸣。

e.en: I heard a pony {whicker} from the dark stable.
e.zh: 我听见小马驹在黑暗的马厩里轻嘶。

whiff.t: n. 一缕气味；一丝迹象

e.en: I caught a {whiff} of fresh coffee from the kitchen.
e.zh: 我从厨房闻到一阵新鲜咖啡的香味。

e.en: There was a {whiff} of scandal around the politician.
e.zh: 那位政客身上有一丝丑闻的气息。

whig.t: n. 辉格党人（英美历史政党）

e.en: His ancestor was a prominent {Whig} in Parliament.
e.zh: 他的祖先是议会里一位杰出的辉格党人。

e.en: The {Whig} party opposed royal absolute power.
e.zh: 辉格党反对君主的绝对权力。

whiggish.t: adj. 辉格党的；辉格派的

e.en: The textbook offers a {Whiggish} view of progress.
e.zh: 这本教科书呈现了一种辉格史观式的进步观。

e.en: Critics call his history overly {Whiggish} and simplistic.
e.zh: 批评者称他的史学过于辉格化且过分简化。

while.t:
conj. 当…时；虽然
n. 一段时间

e.en: I listen to podcasts {while} I cook dinner.
e.zh: 我做晚饭的时候喜欢听播客。

e.en: It took a {while} to load the page.
e.zh: 加载这个页面花了好一会儿。

e.en: She {whiles} away the afternoon reading novels.
e.zh: 她一下午都在悠闲地看小说消磨时光。

e.en: He {whiles} the long flight by watching movies.
e.zh: 他靠看电影打发漫长的飞行时间。

e.en: Please remain seated {whilst} the seatbelt sign is on.
e.zh: 安全带指示灯亮着时请保持就坐。

e.en: She studied medicine {whilst} working part-time.
e.zh: 她一边做兼职一边攻读医学。

whim.t: n. 一时兴起；心血来潮

e.en: On a {whim}, I booked a flight to Tokyo.
e.zh: 我一时兴起,订了一张去东京的机票。

e.en: The boss changes plans on every {whim}.
e.zh: 老板总是心血来潮就改变计划。

whimper.t:
v. 呜咽；抽泣
n. 呜咽声

e.en: The puppy began to {whimper} when left alone.
e.zh: 小狗被单独留下时开始呜咽起来。

e.en: She let out a soft {whimper} in her sleep.
e.zh: 她睡梦中发出一声轻轻的呜咽。

whimpering.t:
n. 呜咽声
adj. 啜泣的

e.en: The injured dog was {whimpering} under the porch.
e.zh: 那只受伤的狗在门廊下呜咽着。

e.en: I heard quiet {whimpering} coming from the next room.
e.zh: 我听到隔壁房间传来轻轻的啜泣声。

whimsical.t: adj. 异想天开的；古怪有趣的

e.en: The cafe has a {whimsical} fairy-tale interior design.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有着奇幻童话般的室内设计。

e.en: Her paintings are colorful and pleasantly {whimsical}.
e.zh: 她的画色彩鲜艳,充满了愉悦的奇思妙想。

whimsically.t: adv. 异想天开地；古怪地

e.en: The shop is {whimsically} decorated with paper umbrellas.
e.zh: 这家店别出心裁地用纸伞装饰着。

e.en: He {whimsically} named his cat after a Greek god.
e.zh: 他突发奇想用一位希腊神的名字给猫命名。

whimsy.t: n. 奇思妙想；古怪念头

e.en: The film is full of charm and gentle {whimsy}.
e.zh: 这部电影充满了魅力和温柔的奇思妙想。

e.en: Her designs combine practicality with playful {whimsy}.
e.zh: 她的设计将实用性与俏皮的奇思相结合。

e.en: Yellow {whin} bushes covered the rocky hillside.
e.zh: 黄色的荆豆灌木覆盖着多石的山坡。

e.en: Sheep grazed near the prickly {whin} along the path.
e.zh: 羊群在小路旁多刺的荆豆边吃草。

whine.t:
v. 发牢骚；哀鸣
n. 抱怨声

e.en: Stop {whine}-ing and finish your homework already.
e.zh: 别再抱怨了,赶紧把作业做完。

e.en: I could hear the {whine} of the old engine.
e.zh: 我能听到那台旧发动机的嗡嗡声。

e.en: Nobody likes a {whiner} on the team.
e.zh: 团队里没人喜欢爱抱怨的人。

e.en: He's such a {whiner} whenever things get hard.
e.zh: 一遇到困难他就特别爱抱怨。

e.en: The kid was tired and getting really {whiney}.
e.zh: 那孩子累了,变得特别爱哭闹。

e.en: I can't stand his {whiney} tone in meetings.
e.zh: 我受不了他在会上那种抱怨的语气。

e.en: Stop {whinge}-ing about the weather and grab a jacket.
e.zh: 别再抱怨天气了,去拿件外套吧。

e.en: My coworkers love to {whinge} about Monday mornings.
e.zh: 我的同事们特别爱抱怨周一早晨。

whingeing.t:
n. 抱怨
adj. 爱发牢骚的

e.en: He's always {whingeing} about how busy he is.
e.zh: 他总是抱怨自己有多忙。

e.en: I'm tired of her constant {whingeing} at work.
e.zh: 我受够了她在工作中没完没了的抱怨。

e.en: Don't be such a {whinger} every time it rains.
e.zh: 别每次下雨就这么爱抱怨。

e.en: The team has no patience for a constant {whinger}.
e.zh: 团队对一直爱抱怨的人毫无耐心。

whining.t:
n. 抱怨声
adj. 哀诉的

e.en: Stop {whining} and just get the work done.
e.zh: 别再抱怨了,把活儿干完就是。

e.en: The {whining} of the dog kept me awake.
e.zh: 狗的呜咽声让我无法入睡。

whinny.t:
v. (马) 嘶鸣
n. 马嘶声

e.en: The horse let out a happy {whinny} at feeding time.
e.zh: 马儿在喂食时发出欢快的嘶鸣声。

e.en: I heard a soft {whinny} from the nearby stable.
e.zh: 我听到附近马厩传来一声轻轻的嘶鸣。

e.en: The toddler became {whiny} after missing his nap.
e.zh: 那个小孩没睡午觉后变得很爱哭闹。

e.en: His {whiny} voice in voicemails really annoys me.
e.zh: 他语音留言里那种抱怨的声音真让我烦。

whip.t:
v. 鞭打；快速移动
n. 鞭子

e.en: Let me {whip} up some pasta for dinner.
e.zh: 我给你快手做点意面当晚饭吧。

e.en: The cowboy cracked his {whip} in the air.
e.zh: 牛仔在空中甩响了他的鞭子。

e.en: She suffered {whiplash} in the rear-end car accident.
e.zh: 她在追尾事故中得了颈椎挥鞭样损伤。

e.en: Policy {whiplash} makes long-term planning impossible.
e.zh: 政策的反复无常让长期规划变得不可能。

e.en: The plant has long, {whiplike} stems that sway easily.
e.zh: 这种植物有着像鞭子一样易于摆动的长茎。

e.en: He gave a {whiplike} crack of his wrist.
e.zh: 他像甩鞭子一样轻脆地抖了一下手腕。

whipped.t: adj. 被鞭打的；筋疲力尽的

e.en: She topped the hot chocolate with {whipped} cream.
e.zh: 她在热巧克力上加了一层鲜奶油。

e.en: The wind {whipped} the flags violently against the pole.
e.zh: 狂风把旗帜猛烈地抽打在旗杆上。

e.en: The egg {whipper} broke halfway through the recipe.
e.zh: 打蛋器在做菜做到一半时坏了。

e.en: He works as a cream {whipper} in the bakery.
e.zh: 他在面包店里负责打发奶油。

whippersnapper.t: n. 自以为是的年轻人；黄毛小子

e.en: That young {whippersnapper} thinks he knows everything.
e.zh: 那个自以为是的小毛头以为自己什么都懂。

e.en: Some {whippersnapper} just lectured me on technology.
e.zh: 刚才有个毛头小子给我上了一堂科技课。

whippet.t: n. 惠比特犬（一种赛犬）

e.en: Her {whippet} can sprint faster than any other dog nearby.
e.zh: 她的惠比特犬比附近任何狗跑得都快。

e.en: The {whippet} curled up quietly on the sofa.
e.zh: 那只惠比特犬安静地蜷在沙发上。

whipping.t:
n. 鞭打；抽打
v. whip 的现在分词

e.en: The wind was {whipping} the rain against the windows.
e.zh: 风把雨水猛烈地抽打在窗户上。

e.en: She's {whipping} the cream for the strawberry shortcake.
e.zh: 她正在打发奶油做草莓酥饼。

whippoorwill.t: n. 三声夜鹰（北美鸟类）

e.en: A {whippoorwill} called from the woods all night.
e.zh: 一只三声夜鹰整夜在林中啼叫。

e.en: We heard a lonely {whippoorwill} near the campsite.
e.zh: 我们听到营地附近一只孤独的三声夜鹰在叫。

e.en: The fishing rod is light and {whippy} in the hand.
e.zh: 这根钓竿拿在手里又轻又有弹性。

e.en: Young willow branches are flexible and quite {whippy}.
e.zh: 嫩柳枝既柔软又很有弹性。

whips.t:
n. 鞭子（复数）
v. 抽打；鞭策

e.en: He {whips} up amazing dinners in under thirty minutes.
e.zh: 他能在三十分钟内做出超棒的晚餐。

e.en: The wind {whips} through the canyon every afternoon.
e.zh: 每天下午风都呼啸着穿过这条峡谷。

whipsaw.t:
v. 两面夹击；双向打击
n. 框锯

e.en: Stock prices {whipsaw} traders during volatile sessions.
e.zh: 股价在剧烈波动中让交易员两面挨打。

e.en: Two loggers used a long {whipsaw} to cut the trunk.
e.zh: 两位伐木工用一把长锯子锯开树干。

e.en: I could hear the soft {whir} of the printer.
e.zh: 我能听见打印机轻轻的嗡嗡声。

e.en: The drone began to {whir} as it took off.
e.zh: 无人机起飞时开始嗡嗡作响。

whirl.t:
v. 旋转；回旋
n. 旋转；忙乱

e.en: Give the new app a {whirl} this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末试用一下这款新应用吧。

e.en: Dancers began to {whirl} across the polished floor.
e.zh: 舞者开始在光滑的地板上旋转起来。

e.en: The garden {whirligig} spins brightly in the breeze.
e.zh: 花园里的风车玩具在微风中明快地转动。

e.en: Life felt like a dizzying {whirligig} of meetings.
e.zh: 生活感觉就像一连串令人眩晕的会议。

whirling.t:
adj. 旋转的
v. whirl 的现在分词

e.en: Snowflakes were {whirling} outside the window.
e.zh: 雪花在窗外纷纷飞舞。

e.en: My head was {whirling} after the long lecture.
e.zh: 听完长长的讲座我头都晕了。

e.en: Swimmers should avoid the dangerous {whirlpool} downstream.
e.zh: 游泳者应避开下游危险的漩涡。

e.en: The hotel spa has a heated {whirlpool} bath.
e.zh: 酒店水疗中心有一个加热的按摩浴池。

whirlwind.t:
n. 旋风
adj. 旋风般的；快速的

e.en: They had a {whirlwind} romance and married within months.
e.zh: 他们经历了一段旋风般的恋情,几个月内就结婚了。

e.en: The CEO finished a {whirlwind} tour of five cities.
e.zh: 首席执行官完成了五座城市的旋风式访问。

e.en: The campaign was a series of {whirlwinds} across six states.
e.zh: 这场竞选是横跨六个州的一连串旋风行动。

e.en: Spring storms brought sudden {whirlwinds} sweeping across the plains.
e.zh: 春季风暴带来阵阵旋风席卷平原。

e.en: You can hear the soft {whirr} of the printer.
e.zh: 你能听到打印机轻柔的嗡嗡声。

e.en: The drone began to {whirr} as it lifted off.
e.zh: 无人机起飞时开始发出嗡嗡声。

whirred.t: v. 发出呼呼声（过去式）

e.en: The old fan {whirred} quietly in the corner.
e.zh: 那台旧风扇在角落里悄悄地嗡嗡转着。

e.en: Cameras {whirred} as the celebrity walked the carpet.
e.zh: 明星走红毯时相机咔嚓声不断。

whirring.t:
n. 嗡嗡声
adj. 呼呼作响的

e.en: The {whirring} of the hard drive kept me awake.
e.zh: 硬盘的嗡嗡声让我无法入睡。

e.en: I love the {whirring} sound of an espresso machine.
e.zh: 我喜欢咖啡机运转时的嗡嗡声。

whirs.t: v. 呼呼作响（第三人称单数）

e.en: The cooling fan {whirs} whenever the laptop heats up.
e.zh: 笔记本一发热,散热风扇就嗡嗡作响。

e.en: A drone {whirs} overhead during the outdoor concert.
e.zh: 户外演唱会时一架无人机在头顶嗡嗡盘旋。

whisk.t:
n. 打蛋器
v. 快速移走；搅打

e.en: Use a {whisk} to beat the eggs until fluffy.
e.zh: 用打蛋器把鸡蛋打到蓬松。

e.en: A taxi will {whisk} you to the airport quickly.
e.zh: 出租车会迅速把你送到机场。

e.en: The team won by a {whisker} in the final seconds.
e.zh: 球队在最后几秒以毫厘之差取胜。

e.en: A single {whisker} on the cat's nose twitched.
e.zh: 猫鼻子上的一根胡须抖动了一下。

e.en: A {whiskered} old fisherman waved from the dock.
e.zh: 码头上一位满脸胡须的老渔夫挥手致意。

e.en: The {whiskered} cat curled up by the fireplace.
e.zh: 那只长着胡须的猫蜷在壁炉旁。

whiskery.t: adj. 多胡须的；毛茸茸的

e.en: The {whiskery} grandfather smiled at his grandchildren.
e.zh: 满脸胡茬的爷爷对着孙辈们微笑。

e.en: He grew a {whiskery} beard during the long winter.
e.zh: 漫长的冬天里他留起了一脸胡须。

whiskey.t: n. 威士忌酒（美式/爱尔兰拼法）

e.en: He poured a glass of Irish {whiskey} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后他倒了一杯爱尔兰威士忌。

e.en: This bar specializes in rare American {whiskey}.
e.zh: 这家酒吧专门提供稀有的美国威士忌。

e.en: The shop carries dozens of single-malt {whiskies}.
e.zh: 这家店出售几十种单一麦芽威士忌。

e.en: We compared three Scottish {whiskies} side by side.
e.zh: 我们把三款苏格兰威士忌并排品鉴。

e.en: He likes his {whisky} with just a splash of water.
e.zh: 他喝威士忌只爱加一点点水。

e.en: Scottish {whisky} is exported to over a hundred countries.
e.zh: 苏格兰威士忌出口到一百多个国家。

whisper.t:
v. 低声说；耳语
n. 耳语；谣传

e.en: Please {whisper} so the baby doesn't wake up.
e.zh: 请小声说话,别把宝宝吵醒。

e.en: There's a {whisper} that the company will be acquired.
e.zh: 有传言说这家公司将被收购。

whispered.t:
v. 低语（过去式）
adj. 悄声的

e.en: She {whispered} the answer to her partner.
e.zh: 她小声把答案告诉了搭档。

e.en: He {whispered} an apology before leaving the room.
e.zh: 他离开房间前低声道了个歉。

whisperer.t: n. 耳语者；安抚者（如 dog whisperer）

e.en: He's known as the dog {whisperer} in our neighborhood.
e.zh: 他在我们小区是出了名的“狗语者”。

e.en: The startup hired a customer {whisperer} to handle complaints.
e.zh: 这家初创公司聘了位“客户低语者”专门处理投诉。

whispering.t:
n. 低语声
adj. 低声的

e.en: Stop {whispering} during the meeting, please.
e.zh: 请别在开会时窃窃私语。

e.en: The leaves were {whispering} in the evening breeze.
e.zh: 树叶在晚风中沙沙作响。

whispers.t:
n. 低语声
v. 耳语（第三人称单数）

e.en: There are {whispers} that the CEO will resign soon.
e.zh: 有传闻说首席执行官即将辞职。

e.en: She {whispers} a secret into her best friend's ear.
e.zh: 她对着闺蜜的耳朵低声说了个秘密。

whispery.t: adj. 如耳语般的；轻柔的

e.en: The singer has a soft, {whispery} voice on ballads.
e.zh: 这位歌手唱抒情歌时声音轻柔如耳语。

e.en: He spoke in a {whispery} tone late at night.
e.zh: 深夜里他用轻柔的耳语般的语调说话。

whist.t: n. 惠斯特（一种纸牌游戏）

e.en: My grandparents play {whist} every Friday evening.
e.zh: 我的祖父母每周五晚上都玩惠斯特牌。

e.en: The club hosts a {whist} tournament each spring.
e.zh: 俱乐部每年春天举办一次惠斯特牌比赛。

whistle.t:
n. 口哨；哨子
v. 吹口哨

e.en: The referee blew the {whistle} to end the match.
e.zh: 裁判吹响哨子结束了比赛。

e.en: He likes to {whistle} while doing the dishes.
e.zh: 他洗碗时喜欢吹口哨。

e.en: She {whistled} a cheerful tune on her way home.
e.zh: 她回家路上吹着一支欢快的曲子。

e.en: The kettle {whistled} loudly on the stove.
e.zh: 水壶在炉子上响亮地鸣笛了。

e.en: My uncle is a fantastic {whistler} at family parties.
e.zh: 我叔叔在家庭聚会上是个了不起的口哨高手。

e.en: The {whistler} on the platform played classical melodies.
e.zh: 站台上吹口哨的人吹奏着古典旋律。

whistles.t:
n. 哨子（复数）
v. 吹口哨（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new app comes with all the bells and {whistles}.
e.zh: 这款新应用功能一应俱全。

e.en: Train {whistles} echoed across the quiet valley.
e.zh: 火车汽笛声在寂静的山谷中回荡。

whistling.t:
n. 吹口哨；哨声
adj. 呼啸的

e.en: He kept {whistling} the same song all morning.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在吹同一首歌的口哨。

e.en: The wind was {whistling} through the cracked window.
e.zh: 风从破裂的窗缝里呼啸而过。

e.en: We took the train through {Whiston} on our way north.
e.zh: 我们北上途中坐火车经过惠斯顿。

e.en: {Whiston} is a small town in Merseyside, England.
e.zh: 惠斯顿是英格兰默西塞德郡的一个小镇。

whit.t: n. 一点点；丝毫（多用于否定）

e.en: He doesn't care a {whit} about office politics.
e.zh: 他对办公室政治毫不在意。

e.en: The new policy hasn't helped a {whit}.
e.zh: 新政策一点忙也没帮上。

whitbread.t: n. 惠特布雷德（英国品牌/姓氏）

e.en: {Whitbread} owns the popular Premier Inn hotel chain.
e.zh: 惠特布雷德公司拥有受欢迎的尚客优酒店连锁。

e.en: The novel won the prestigious {Whitbread} Book Award.
e.zh: 这本小说赢得了享有盛誉的惠特布雷德图书奖。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring the cliffs of {Whitby}.
e.zh: 我们周末去惠特比的悬崖游览。

e.en: {Whitby} is famous for its abbey and Dracula connections.
e.zh: 惠特比以其修道院和与《德古拉》的关联而闻名。

whitchurch.t: n. 惠特彻奇（英国地名）

e.en: {Whitchurch} has a charming high street with old shops.
e.zh: 惠特彻奇有一条满是老店铺的迷人主街。

e.en: The train stops briefly at {Whitchurch} station.
e.zh: 火车在惠特彻奇站短暂停靠。

white.t:
adj. 白色的
n. 白色；白人

e.en: She wore a simple {white} dress to the wedding.
e.zh: 她穿了一件简洁的白色连衣裙去参加婚礼。

e.en: Please use the {white} background for the slides.
e.zh: 幻灯片请使用白色背景。

whiteboard.t: n. 白板（书写用或协作软件）

e.en: The team brainstormed ideas on the office {whiteboard}.
e.zh: 团队在办公室白板上头脑风暴想点子。

e.en: He drew the system diagram on a digital {whiteboard}.
e.zh: 他在数字白板上画出了系统架构图。

e.en: A single {whitecap} crashed against the rocky shore.
e.zh: 一道白浪拍打在多石的海岸上。

e.en: The surfer rode a perfect {whitecap} to the beach.
e.zh: 冲浪者乘着一道完美的白浪冲向海滩。

e.en: {Whitecaps} covered the lake during the windy afternoon.
e.zh: 刮风的下午,湖面上布满了白浪。

e.en: Sailors avoided the bay because of dangerous {whitecaps}.
e.zh: 水手们因为白浪汹涌而避开这片海湾。

whitechapel.t: n. 白教堂（伦敦东区地名）

e.en: {Whitechapel} is a historic district in London's East End.
e.zh: 白教堂区是伦敦东区一个历史悠久的街区。

e.en: We visited an art gallery in {Whitechapel} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们去白教堂区参观了一家美术馆。

whitefield.t: n. 怀特菲尔德（人名/地名）

e.en: {Whitefield} has become a major tech hub in Bangalore.
e.zh: 白原区已成为班加罗尔重要的科技中心。

e.en: Her family has lived in {Whitefield} for generations.
e.zh: 她家族世代居住在白原区。

e.en: The chef grilled fresh {whitefish} with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 主厨用柠檬和香草烤了新鲜的白鱼。

e.en: Lake {Whitefish} is popular among local anglers.
e.zh: 湖白鱼在当地钓鱼爱好者中很受欢迎。

e.en: Commercial {whaling} has been banned by most nations.
e.zh: 大多数国家已禁止商业捕鲸。

e.en: Cybercriminals use {whaling} attacks to target company executives.
e.zh: 网络罪犯利用"鱼叉式"攻击来针对公司高管。

e.en: {Whalley} is a quaint village in the Ribble Valley.
e.zh: 沃利是里布尔河谷里一座古朴的村庄。

e.en: We toured the medieval ruins at {Whalley} Abbey.
e.zh: 我们参观了沃利修道院的中世纪遗迹。

wham.t:
int. 砰（撞击声）
v. 猛击

e.en: {Wham}! The door slammed shut behind him.
e.zh: 砰!门在他身后猛地关上了。

e.en: {Wham} topped the charts throughout the 1980s.
e.zh: 威猛乐队在整个八十年代都登上排行榜榜首。

e.en: Losing his job and his apartment was a double {whammy}.
e.zh: 失去工作又失去公寓对他是双重打击。

e.en: Rising rents and inflation hit families with a triple {whammy}.
e.zh: 房租上涨和通胀给家庭带来三重打击。

whap.t:
v. 啪地猛打
n. 重击声

e.en: She heard a loud {whap} when the branch hit the window.
e.zh: 树枝撞到窗户时她听到一声响亮的啪嗒。

e.en: He gave the mosquito a quick {whap} with his hand.
e.zh: 他用手快速啪地一下打死了蚊子。

e.en: Fishing boats unload their catch at the {wharf} every morning.
e.zh: 渔船每天早上在码头卸下渔获。

e.en: We grabbed seafood at a restaurant near the {wharf}.
e.zh: 我们在码头附近的一家餐厅吃了海鲜。

wharfedale.t: n. 沃夫代尔（英国地名/品牌）

e.en: {Wharfedale} is one of the most scenic Yorkshire Dales.
e.zh: 沃夫代尔是约克郡谷地中最美的地方之一。

e.en: My new bookshelf speakers are made by {Wharfedale}.
e.zh: 我新买的书架音箱是 Wharfedale 牌的。

wharton.t: n. 沃顿（姓氏；沃顿商学院）

e.en: She earned her MBA at {Wharton} last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天在沃顿商学院拿到了 MBA 学位。

e.en: Edith {Wharton} won the Pulitzer Prize for fiction in 1921.
e.zh: 伊迪丝·沃顿于 1921 年获得普利策小说奖。

what.t:
pron. 什么
adj. 多么

e.en: {What} are you planning to do this weekend?
e.zh: 你这个周末打算做什么?

e.en: I don't know {what} she meant by that comment.
e.zh: 我不知道她那句评论是什么意思。

whatever.t:
pron. 无论什么；随便
adj. 任何的

e.en: You can order {whatever} you like from the menu.
e.zh: 你想从菜单上点什么都可以。

e.en: He just shrugged and said {whatever} to her question.
e.zh: 他只是耸耸肩，对她的问题说了句随便。

e.en: The drawer was full of pens, clips, and {whatnot}.
e.zh: 抽屉里塞满了笔、夹子之类的杂物。

e.en: She bought snacks, drinks, and {whatnot} for the party.
e.zh: 她为派对买了零食、饮料等等。

whatsit.t: n. 那玩意儿（一时想不起名字的东西）

e.en: Hand me that {whatsit} on the top shelf, please.
e.zh: 请把架子顶上那个东西递给我。

e.en: I forgot the name of this {whatsit} in my toolbox.
e.zh: 我忘了工具箱里这玩意儿叫什么。

whatsoever.t: adv. 任何（用于加强否定语气）

e.en: She has no interest {whatsoever} in joining the meeting.
e.zh: 她对参加这次会议毫无兴趣。

e.en: There is no evidence {whatsoever} to support that claim.
e.zh: 没有任何证据可以支持那种说法。

e.en: A red {wheal} appeared on her arm after the sting.
e.zh: 被蜇之后她手臂上出现了一道红色风疹块。

e.en: The allergy test left a small {wheal} on his skin.
e.zh: 过敏测试在他皮肤上留下了一小块红肿。

e.en: Farmers harvest {wheat} in the fields every summer.
e.zh: 农民每年夏天在田里收割小麦。

e.en: This bread is made from whole {wheat} flour.
e.zh: 这种面包是用全麦面粉做的。

e.en: A small {wheatear} hopped along the stone wall.
e.zh: 一只小䳭沿着石墙跳跃。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a {wheatear} near the cliffs.
e.zh: 观鸟者在悬崖附近发现了一只䳭鸟。

e.en: She baked a warm loaf of {wheaten} bread.
e.zh: 她烤了一条温热的全麦面包。

e.en: The dog had a beautiful {wheaten} coat.
e.zh: 那只狗有一身漂亮的麦色被毛。

e.en: The golden {wheatfield} stretched to the horizon.
e.zh: 金色的麦田一直延伸到地平线。

e.en: Van Gogh painted a famous {wheatfield} with crows.
e.zh: 梵高画了一幅著名的有乌鸦的麦田。

e.en: She sprinkled {wheatgerm} on her morning yogurt.
e.zh: 她在早餐酸奶上撒了些小麦胚芽。

e.en: {Wheatgerm} is rich in vitamin E and protein.
e.zh: 小麦胚芽富含维生素E和蛋白质。

e.en: He drinks a shot of {wheatgrass} juice every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上喝一小杯小麦草汁。

e.en: The cafe added {wheatgrass} smoothies to its menu.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆在菜单上加了小麦草冰沙。

e.en: She grew up in {Wheaton}, a quiet suburb of Chicago.
e.zh: 她在芝加哥郊外宁静的惠顿镇长大。

e.en: The actor Wil {Wheaton} appears in many sci-fi shows.
e.zh: 演员威尔·惠顿出演过许多科幻剧。

e.en: {Whee}! The kids screamed as the slide sped down.
e.zh: 哇！孩子们随着滑梯飞速下滑而尖叫。

e.en: She shouted {whee} while riding the roller coaster.
e.zh: 她坐过山车时兴奋地大喊耶。

wheedle.t: v. 哄骗；甜言蜜语地劝诱

e.en: He tried to {wheedle} a raise out of his boss.
e.zh: 他试图哄骗老板给他加薪。

e.en: Don't {wheedle} the kids into eating more candy.
e.zh: 别哄孩子们吃更多糖果了。

wheedling.t:
adj. 甜言蜜语的
v. 哄骗（-ing 形式）

e.en: Her {wheedling} tone finally convinced him to help.
e.zh: 她那哄劝的语气最终说服了他帮忙。

e.en: He kept {wheedling} until his mom bought the toy.
e.zh: 他一直软磨硬泡，直到妈妈买下那个玩具。

wheel.t:
n. 轮子；方向盘
v. 推（有轮之物）

e.en: The front {wheel} of the bike came loose.
e.zh: 自行车的前轮松了。

e.en: She gripped the steering {wheel} tightly in traffic.
e.zh: 她在车流中紧紧握住方向盘。

e.en: He pushed a {wheelbarrow} full of bricks to the site.
e.zh: 他推着一辆装满砖的独轮车到工地。

e.en: The gardener loaded leaves into the {wheelbarrow}.
e.zh: 园丁把树叶装进独轮手推车里。

e.en: This SUV has a longer {wheelbase} for extra legroom.
e.zh: 这款SUV轴距更长，腿部空间更大。

e.en: A short {wheelbase} makes the car easier to park.
e.zh: 较短的轴距让这辆车更容易停泊。

e.en: The hotel room is fully {wheelchair} accessible.
e.zh: 这间酒店客房完全适合轮椅出入。

e.en: She uses a motorized {wheelchair} to get around campus.
e.zh: 她用电动轮椅在校园里出行。

e.en: The airport provides free {wheelchairs} at every gate.
e.zh: 机场在每个登机口都提供免费轮椅。

e.en: Modern {wheelchairs} are lighter and easier to fold.
e.zh: 现代轮椅更轻便，也更容易折叠。

wheeled.t:
adj. 带轮子的
v. 推行（过去式）

e.en: She {wheeled} her suitcase through the busy terminal.
e.zh: 她拖着行李箱穿过繁忙的航站楼。

e.en: The nurse {wheeled} the patient into the recovery room.
e.zh: 护士把病人推进了恢复室。

e.en: He rides a sleek three-{wheeler} around the city.
e.zh: 他骑着一辆时髦的三轮车在城里转。

e.en: The truck driver is a seasoned eighteen-{wheeler}.
e.zh: 那位卡车司机是开十八轮大货车的老手。

e.en: Designing user interfaces is right in her {wheelhouse}.
e.zh: 设计用户界面正是她的拿手好戏。

e.en: The captain stood in the {wheelhouse} steering the ship.
e.zh: 船长站在驾驶室里掌舵。

e.en: The teenager popped a {wheelie} on his new bike.
e.zh: 那个少年用新自行车翘起了前轮。

e.en: He learned to do a {wheelie} in the empty parking lot.
e.zh: 他在空旷的停车场学会了翘前轮特技。

wheeling.t: v. 推行；盘旋（-ing 形式）

e.en: She was {wheeling} a cart full of groceries home.
e.zh: 她正推着一辆装满食品的购物车回家。

e.en: Seagulls were {wheeling} above the harbor at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时分海鸥在港口上空盘旋。

wheels.t: n. 车轮（复数）；俚指汽车

e.en: My new car has alloy {wheels} and leather seats.
e.zh: 我的新车配有合金轮毂和真皮座椅。

e.en: The suitcase rolled smoothly on its four {wheels}.
e.zh: 行李箱靠四个轮子顺畅地滚动。

e.en: He upgraded his bike with a carbon {wheelset}.
e.zh: 他给自行车换装了一套碳纤维轮组。

e.en: A lighter {wheelset} can really improve climbing speed.
e.zh: 更轻的轮组能显著提升爬坡速度。

e.en: The village {wheelwright} repaired wagons for farmers.
e.zh: 村里的车轮匠为农夫修理马车。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {wheelwright} long ago.
e.zh: 他祖父很久以前是个造车轮的工匠。

wheely.t: n. 翘前轮特技（wheelie 异拼）

e.en: He rode his bike on one {wheely} down the street.
e.zh: 他翘起前轮单轮骑着自行车冲下街道。

e.en: The kid practiced doing a {wheely} for hours.
e.zh: 那孩子练了好几个小时翘前轮。

wheeze.t:
v. 喘息；发出呼哧声
n. 喘鸣声

e.en: His asthma made him {wheeze} after climbing the stairs.
e.zh: 他的哮喘让他爬完楼梯后呼吸喘鸣。

e.en: You could hear a faint {wheeze} in her chest.
e.zh: 可以听到她胸腔里有微弱的喘鸣声。

e.en: The old dog {wheezed} as it climbed onto the couch.
e.zh: 那只老狗爬上沙发时喘息着。

e.en: He {wheezed} heavily after running up the hill.
e.zh: 他跑上山后喘得很厉害。

wheezes.t:
v. 喘息（第三人称单数）
n. 喘鸣声（复数）

e.en: The doctor heard faint {wheezes} during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查时听到了微弱的喘鸣音。

e.en: Grandpa always {wheezes} a little when he laughs.
e.zh: 爷爷笑的时候总是会轻轻喘鸣。

wheezing.t:
n. 喘鸣
adj. 呼哧作响的

e.en: She started {wheezing} during her morning jog.
e.zh: 她晨跑时开始呼吸喘鸣起来。

e.en: The {wheezing} sound worried her parents at night.
e.zh: 那种喘鸣声让她父母在夜里很担心。

wheezy.t: adj. 气喘吁吁的；带喘鸣的

e.en: His voice sounded {wheezy} after the long cold.
e.zh: 长时间感冒后他的嗓音听起来气喘吁吁。

e.en: The {wheezy} old engine struggled up the hill.
e.zh: 那台喘息的老引擎艰难地爬上山坡。

whelk.t: n. 峨螺；一种食用海螺

e.en: She found a spiral {whelk} shell on the beach.
e.zh: 她在沙滩上捡到一个螺旋形的峨螺壳。

e.en: Locals serve boiled {whelk} as a seaside snack.
e.zh: 当地人把煮峨螺当作海边小吃。

whelm.t: v. 淹没；压倒（文学用法）

e.en: Huge waves seemed about to {whelm} the small boat.
e.zh: 巨浪似乎要吞没那艘小船。

e.en: Sudden grief threatened to {whelm} her completely.
e.zh: 突如其来的悲伤几乎要将她完全淹没。

whelp.t:
n. 幼崽（尤指小狗）
v. 产崽

e.en: The mother dog nursed her newborn {whelp} carefully.
e.zh: 母狗小心地哺育着新生的幼犬。

e.en: That cheeky {whelp} talked back to his teacher again.
e.zh: 那个无礼的小子又顶撞了老师。

when.t:
adv. 什么时候
conj. 当…时

e.en: Tell me {when} you are ready to leave.
e.zh: 等你准备好出发时告诉我。

e.en: {When} did you first move to this city?
e.zh: 你是什么时候第一次搬到这座城市的？

e.en: A {whitefly} infestation can quickly damage tomato plants.
e.zh: 白粉虱大量繁殖会迅速损害番茄植株。

e.en: Gardeners use yellow traps to catch the {whitefly}.
e.zh: 园丁们用黄色粘板来捕捉白粉虱。

whitehall.t: n. 白厅（英国政府机构代称）

e.en: The decision was made by senior officials in {Whitehall}.
e.zh: 这一决定是由白厅的高级官员做出的。

e.en: {Whitehall} is the heart of British government administration.
e.zh: 白厅是英国政府行政管理的核心。

whitehaven.t: n. 怀特黑文（英国地名）

e.en: {Whitehaven} is a coastal town in northwest England.
e.zh: 白港是英格兰西北部的一个沿海小镇。

e.en: We took a ferry from {Whitehaven} to the Isle of Man.
e.zh: 我们从白港坐渡轮去了马恩岛。

whitehead.t:
n. 白头粉刺
n. 怀特黑德（姓氏）

e.en: She gently squeezed a stubborn {whitehead} on her chin.
e.zh: 她轻轻挤掉下巴上一颗顽固的白头粉刺。

e.en: Philosopher Alfred {Whitehead} co-wrote Principia Mathematica.
e.zh: 哲学家阿尔弗雷德·怀特海合著了《数学原理》。

whitehill.t: n. 怀特希尔（地名/姓氏）

e.en: Our family used to picnic on {Whitehill} every summer.
e.zh: 我们一家以前每年夏天都在白山野餐。

e.en: {Whitehill} is a small village south of Edinburgh.
e.zh: 白山是爱丁堡南面的一个小村庄。

whitehouse.t:
n. 白宫
n. 怀特豪斯（姓氏）

e.en: Mary {Whitehouse} campaigned against violence on television.
e.zh: 玛丽·怀特豪斯发起反对电视暴力的运动。

e.en: Mr. {Whitehouse} has taught at the school for thirty years.
e.zh: 怀特豪斯先生在这所学校任教三十年了。

e.en: Snow lay {whitely} across the rooftops at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分白雪皑皑地覆盖着屋顶。

e.en: The moon shone {whitely} over the quiet harbor.
e.zh: 月光皎洁地洒在宁静的港湾上。

e.en: This toothpaste claims to {whiten} teeth in two weeks.
e.zh: 这款牙膏声称两周内就能美白牙齿。

e.en: Lemon juice can {whiten} stained kitchen surfaces.
e.zh: 柠檬汁可以让染污的厨房台面变白。

e.en: She {whitened} her sneakers with a special cleaner.
e.zh: 她用专用清洁剂把运动鞋洗白了。

e.en: His knuckles {whitened} as he gripped the steering wheel.
e.zh: 他紧握方向盘,指节都发白了。

e.en: Add a spoonful of coffee {whitener} to your cup.
e.zh: 在杯里加一勺咖啡伴侣。

e.en: This laundry {whitener} works on stubborn yellow stains.
e.zh: 这种衣物增白剂对顽固的黄渍很有效。

e.en: The blinding {whiteness} of the snow hurt our eyes.
e.zh: 雪地刺眼的白光让我们眼睛生疼。

e.en: He admired the perfect {whiteness} of the freshly painted walls.
e.zh: 他欣赏着新刷墙壁那洁白无瑕的颜色。

whitening.t:
n. 美白；增白
v. 使变白

e.en: Professional teeth {whitening} can be expensive but effective.
e.zh: 专业牙齿美白可能价格不菲,但效果显著。

e.en: Her hair was slowly {whitening} at the temples.
e.zh: 她两鬓的头发正在慢慢变白。

e.en: Wash your {whites} separately to keep them bright.
e.zh: 白色衣物要分开洗才能保持亮白。

e.en: Beat the egg {whites} until they form stiff peaks.
e.zh: 把蛋清打到能拉出尖角。

e.en: A {whitetail} deer wandered into our backyard at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时一只白尾鹿走进了我们的后院。

e.en: Hunters are heading north for {whitetail} season.
e.zh: 猎人们正北上参加白尾鹿狩猎季。

whitewash.t:
v. 粉饰；掩盖真相
n. 白涂料

e.en: The committee tried to {whitewash} the scandal in their report.
e.zh: 委员会试图在报告中粉饰这起丑闻。

e.en: We need to {whitewash} the garden fence this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末我们得给花园围栏刷上白漆。

e.en: The village houses were all {whitewashed} and gleamed in the sun.
e.zh: 村里的房子都刷成白色，在阳光下闪闪发光。

e.en: Critics say the documentary {whitewashed} the company's history.
e.zh: 批评者认为这部纪录片美化了公司的历史。

e.en: The book accuses the government of {whitewashing} the truth.
e.zh: 这本书指责政府粉饰真相。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {whitewashing} the old barn walls.
e.zh: 他花了一下午把旧谷仓的墙刷白。

e.en: The slang term {whitey} is considered offensive in most contexts.
e.zh: 俚语“白佬”在大多数语境中被视为冒犯性用语。

e.en: My cat {whitey} loves to nap on the windowsill.
e.zh: 我家猫小白喜欢在窗台上打盹。

e.en: {Whither} are we headed in this rapidly changing world?
e.zh: 在这瞬息万变的世界里，我们将走向何方？

e.en: The article asks {whither} democracy in the digital age.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨数字时代民主将何去何从。

e.en: He ordered fried {whiting} with chips at the seaside restaurant.
e.zh: 他在海边餐厅点了炸牙鳕配薯条。

e.en: Fresh {whiting} is sold cheaply at the harbor market.
e.zh: 港口市场上新鲜的牙鳕卖得很便宜。

e.en: The mushroom has a {whitish} cap with brown spots.
e.zh: 这种蘑菇的菌盖呈白色，带有褐色斑点。

e.en: A {whitish} fog rolled in from the harbor at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分一片淡白色的雾从港口飘来。

e.en: We always visit grandmother during the {Whitsun} holiday.
e.zh: 我们总是在圣灵降临节期间去看望祖母。

e.en: The church organized a special service for {Whitsun}.
e.zh: 教堂为圣灵降临节安排了一场特别礼拜。

e.en: Many British schools used to close for the {Whitsuntide} week.
e.zh: 英国许多学校过去会在圣灵降临周放假。

e.en: The village holds an annual fair every {Whitsuntide}.
e.zh: 每年圣灵降临节期间村里都会举办集市。

e.en: He likes to {whittle} small wooden animals by the fire.
e.zh: 他喜欢坐在炉火旁削些小木头动物。

e.en: We need to {whittle} down the candidate list to five.
e.zh: 我们需要把候选名单缩减到五个人。

whiz.t:
n. 高手；能手
v. 呼啸而过

e.en: My nephew is a real math {whiz} for his age.
e.zh: 我侄子在他这个年纪算得上数学神童。

e.en: Cars {whiz} past on the highway all night long.
e.zh: 高速公路上汽车整夜呼啸而过。

whizz.t:
n. 高手；能手
v. 飞驰

e.en: She's a computer {whizz} who fixed my laptop in minutes.
e.zh: 她是个电脑高手，几分钟就修好了我的笔记本。

e.en: The arrows {whizz} through the air toward the target.
e.zh: 箭嗖嗖地射向靶子。

e.en: {Whoa}, that's the coolest trick I've seen all day!
e.zh: 哇，这是我今天看到最酷的把戏！

e.en: {Whoa}, slow down before you crash into the wall.
e.zh: 喂，慢点，别撞到墙上去了。

e.en: I love curling up with a classic Agatha Christie {whodunit}.
e.zh: 我喜欢蜷在沙发里读阿加莎·克里斯蒂的经典推理小说。

e.en: The new Netflix {whodunit} kept me guessing until the end.
e.zh: 这部新上线的悬疑剧让我猜到最后才揭晓。

e.en: The film is a stylish {whodunnit} set on a luxury train.
e.zh: 这部电影是一部以豪华列车为背景的精致悬疑片。

e.en: She writes a {whodunnit} novel every two years.
e.zh: 她每两年写一本侦探推理小说。

e.en: {Whoever} finishes first gets to choose the restaurant tonight.
e.zh: 谁先完成谁就能挑今晚去哪家餐厅。

e.en: {Whoever} left the lights on owes me a coffee.
e.zh: 谁忘关灯了就欠我一杯咖啡。

whole.t:
adj. 整个的；全部的
n. 整体

e.en: He ate the {whole} pizza by himself in ten minutes.
e.zh: 他十分钟内一个人吃完了整张披萨。

e.en: The {whole} team celebrated the championship win together.
e.zh: 整个团队一起庆祝了夺冠。

wholefood.t: n. 天然食品；未加工食品

e.en: The cafe specializes in {wholefood} salads and grain bowls.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆专做天然全食沙拉和谷物碗。

e.en: She switched to a {wholefood} diet to feel healthier.
e.zh: 她改吃天然食品饮食以求更健康。

e.en: I always buy {wholegrain} bread for breakfast toast.
e.zh: 我早餐烤面包总是买全谷物的。

e.en: {Wholegrain} cereals provide more fiber than refined ones.
e.zh: 全谷物麦片比精制麦片含有更多膳食纤维。

wholehearted.t: adj. 全心全意的；真诚的

e.en: She gave the project her {wholehearted} support from day one.
e.zh: 她从一开始就全心全意地支持这个项目。

e.en: The proposal received {wholehearted} approval from the board.
e.zh: 该提案获得了董事会的全力支持。

e.en: I {wholeheartedly} agree with everything you just said.
e.zh: 我完全赞同你刚才说的每一句话。

e.en: The community {wholeheartedly} embraced the new library project.
e.zh: 社区全心全意地支持这个新图书馆项目。

wide.t:
adj. 宽的；广泛的
adv. 广泛地

e.en: The river is too {wide} to swim across here.
e.zh: 这条河在这里太宽,游不过去。

e.en: The app supports a {wide} range of languages.
e.zh: 这款应用支持多种语言。

e.en: This framework is {widely} used by frontend developers today.
e.zh: 这个框架如今被前端开发者广泛使用。

e.en: Opinions on the new policy vary {widely} across the team.
e.zh: 团队对新政策的看法差异很大。

e.en: The city plans to {widen} the highway next year.
e.zh: 市政府计划明年拓宽这条高速公路。

e.en: Reading more books can {widen} your perspective on life.
e.zh: 多读书可以拓宽你的人生视野。

widened.t:
v. widen 的过去式
adj. 扩大了的

e.en: Her eyes {widened} when she saw the surprise gift.
e.zh: 看到那份惊喜礼物时,她的眼睛瞪得大大的。

e.en: The gap between rich and poor has {widened} in recent years.
e.zh: 近几年贫富差距有所扩大。

widening.t:
v. widen 的现在分词
n. 扩大；加宽

e.en: The {widening} income gap is a serious social issue.
e.zh: 日益扩大的收入差距是一个严重的社会问题。

e.en: Crews are {widening} the road to ease daily traffic.
e.zh: 工人正在拓宽道路以缓解日常交通。

widens.t: v. widen 的第三人称单数

e.en: The path {widens} just before it reaches the lake.
e.zh: 小路在快到湖边时变宽了。

e.en: This course {widens} your understanding of modern history.
e.zh: 这门课能拓宽你对近代史的理解。

wider.t: adj. wide 的比较级，更宽的；更广泛的

e.en: Could you make the sidebar a little {wider}?
e.zh: 侧边栏能稍微再宽一点吗?

e.en: The film reached a much {wider} audience after going on Netflix.
e.zh: 这部电影上线 Netflix 后受众面广了很多。

widespread.t: adj. 普遍的；广泛分布的

e.en: The outage caused {widespread} complaints on social media.
e.zh: 这次故障在社交媒体上引发了广泛投诉。

e.en: There is {widespread} support for the new climate bill.
e.zh: 新的气候法案获得了广泛支持。

widgeon.t: n. 赤颈鸭（野鸭的一种）

e.en: A flock of {widgeon} landed on the marsh at dusk.
e.zh: 傍晚时分,一群赤颈鸭降落在沼泽上。

e.en: The birdwatcher photographed a male {widgeon} near the pond.
e.zh: 那位观鸟者在池塘边拍到了一只雄性赤颈鸭。

widget.t: n. 小组件；小部件（界面元素）

e.en: You can drag the weather {widget} onto your home screen.
e.zh: 你可以把天气小组件拖到主屏幕上。

e.en: The dashboard {widget} shows real-time sales data.
e.zh: 仪表盘上的小组件显示实时销售数据。

widow.t:
n. 寡妇
v. 使成为寡妇

e.en: The {widow} donated her late husband's books to the library.
e.zh: 这位寡妇把已故丈夫的书捐给了图书馆。

e.en: After the accident, she became a young {widow} with two kids.
e.zh: 那场事故后,她成了带着两个孩子的年轻寡妇。

e.en: She was {widowed} at the age of thirty-five.
e.zh: 她三十五岁就守了寡。

e.en: The charity supports recently {widowed} parents and their children.
e.zh: 这个慈善机构帮助新近丧偶的父母和他们的孩子。

e.en: The elderly {widower} lives alone but stays in touch with neighbors.
e.zh: 这位年迈的鳏夫独自生活,但和邻居保持联系。

e.en: As a {widower}, he learned to cook for himself.
e.zh: 作为一名鳏夫,他学会了自己下厨。

e.en: She wrote a memoir about adjusting to {widowhood}.
e.zh: 她写了一本回忆录,讲述如何适应丧偶生活。

e.en: Support groups can ease the loneliness of {widowhood}.
e.zh: 互助小组可以缓解丧偶生活的孤独感。

widows.t: n. widow 的复数，寡妇们

e.en: The charity provides scholarships for the children of war {widows}.
e.zh: 这个慈善机构为战争遗孀的孩子提供奖学金。

e.en: Many {widows} in the village rely on each other for support.
e.zh: 村里很多寡妇互相扶持。

e.en: Please measure the {width} of the door before ordering.
e.zh: 下单前请先量一下门的宽度。

e.en: You can adjust the column {width} in the spreadsheet settings.
e.zh: 你可以在表格设置里调整列宽。

wield.t: v. 挥舞（武器）；行使（权力）

e.en: The CEO continues to {wield} enormous influence over the industry.
e.zh: 这位首席执行官在行业内仍然拥有巨大影响力。

e.en: The knight learned to {wield} a sword from a young age.
e.zh: 那位骑士从小就学会了挥舞长剑。

wielder.t: n. 挥舞者；权力行使者

e.en: In the legend, only the chosen {wielder} can lift the sacred hammer.
e.zh: 传说中,只有被选中的持有者才能举起那把圣锤。

e.en: The senator is a skilled {wielder} of political power.
e.zh: 这位参议员是个深谙政治权力运作的人。

e.en: Many tourists call the city {Wien}, while English speakers say Vienna.
e.zh: 许多游客称这座城市为 Wien,英语国家则称为维也纳。

e.en: The train from Munich to {Wien} takes about four hours.
e.zh: 从慕尼黑到维也纳的火车大约要四个小时。

wiener.t: n. 维也纳香肠；小香肠

e.en: He grilled a {wiener} and put it in a soft bun.
e.zh: 他烤了一根维也纳香肠,夹进松软的面包里。

e.en: The kids each ordered a {wiener} with mustard at the stand.
e.zh: 孩子们在小摊上各点了一根加芥末的香肠。

wiesbaden.t: n. 威斯巴登（德国城市）

e.en: {Wiesbaden} is famous for its hot springs and elegant spa hotels.
e.zh: 威斯巴登以温泉和优雅的水疗酒店闻名。

e.en: She took a weekend trip from Frankfurt to {Wiesbaden}.
e.zh: 她从法兰克福到威斯巴登度了个周末。

e.en: My {wife} and I are planning a trip to Japan.
e.zh: 我和我太太在计划去日本旅行。

e.en: His {wife} works as a software engineer in Berlin.
e.zh: 他的妻子在柏林做软件工程师。

e.en: The novel pokes fun at outdated ideas of {wifely} duty.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了过时的妻子本分观念。

e.en: She rejected the old-fashioned {wifely} role expected of her.
e.zh: 她拒绝接受人们对她的那种老式妻子角色。

e.en: {Wigan} is a town in northwestern England known for its football club.
e.zh: 威根是英格兰西北部的一个小镇,以其足球俱乐部闻名。

e.en: He grew up in {Wigan} before moving to Manchester for work.
e.zh: 他在威根长大,后来去曼彻斯特工作。

e.en: A pair of {wigeon} swam quietly along the reedy shore.
e.zh: 一对赤颈鸭沿着长满芦苇的岸边静静游过。

e.en: In winter, thousands of {wigeon} gather at this wetland reserve.
e.zh: 冬天,成千上万只赤颈鸭聚集在这片湿地保护区。

wiggle.t:
v. 扭动；摆动
n. 摆动

e.en: Try to {wiggle} the loose tooth gently with your tongue.
e.zh: 试着用舌头轻轻晃动那颗松动的牙齿。

e.en: The puppy started to {wiggle} as soon as I picked it up.
e.zh: 我一抱起小狗,它就开始扭来扭去。

wiggler.t: n. 扭动的人或物；孑孓

e.en: My toddler is a real {wiggler} during diaper changes.
e.zh: 我家小宝贝换尿布时总是扭来扭去。

e.en: Anglers often use a live {wiggler} as bait for trout.
e.zh: 垂钓者常用活蚯蚓做鳟鱼的钓饵。

wiggling.t: v. wiggle 的现在分词，扭动着

e.en: The puppy kept {wiggling} out of my arms at the vet.
e.zh: 在兽医诊所，小狗一直从我怀里扭着挣脱。

e.en: She sat at her desk {wiggling} her toes under the table.
e.zh: 她坐在桌前，脚趾在桌下不停地动来动去。

wiggly.t: adj. 扭动的；弯弯曲曲的

e.en: My daughter lost her first {wiggly} tooth this morning.
e.zh: 我女儿今天早上掉了第一颗松动的牙。

e.en: The toddler drew a {wiggly} line across the entire page.
e.zh: 小朋友在整张纸上画了一条歪歪扭扭的线。

e.en: His outfit looked a bit {wiggy} for a job interview.
e.zh: 他这身打扮去面试显得有点怪里怪气。

e.en: The whole situation felt {wiggy} and made me uneasy.
e.zh: 整件事感觉怪怪的，让我心里不踏实。

e.en: In the old tale, a fearsome {wight} guarded the tomb.
e.zh: 在古老的传说中，一个可怕的鬼怪守护着那座坟墓。

e.en: The fantasy game features an icy {wight} as the villain.
e.zh: 这款奇幻游戏以一只冰霜亡灵作为反派。

wigmore.t: n. 威格莫尔（姓氏/地名）

e.en: We attended a string quartet recital at {Wigmore} Hall.
e.zh: 我们在威格莫尔音乐厅听了一场弦乐四重奏音乐会。

e.en: {Wigmore} Street is famous for its medical specialists in London.
e.zh: 威格莫尔街因伦敦的专科医生云集而闻名。

wigwam.t: n. 棚屋（北美印第安人的圆顶帐篷）

e.en: The children built a tiny {wigwam} from blankets and chairs.
e.zh: 孩子们用毯子和椅子搭了一个小小的圆顶帐篷。

e.en: The museum displays a traditional {wigwam} from the Algonquin people.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一座阿尔冈昆人的传统棚屋。

wiki.t: n. 维基；可协作编辑的网站

e.en: I edited the project {wiki} to fix the install steps.
e.zh: 我编辑了项目维基,修正了安装步骤。

e.en: Check the company {wiki} for onboarding documents.
e.zh: 在公司维基上查看入职文档。

wilcoxon.t: n. 威尔科克森（统计检验名）

e.en: We ran a {Wilcoxon} signed-rank test on the paired samples.
e.zh: 我们对配对样本进行了威尔科克森符号秩检验。

e.en: The {Wilcoxon} test is useful when data is not normally distributed.
e.zh: 当数据不服从正态分布时,威尔科克森检验很有用。

wild.t:
adj. 野生的；疯狂的
n. 荒野

e.en: The kids went {wild} when the band came on stage.
e.zh: 乐队登台时孩子们都疯狂了。

e.en: We saw a {wild} fox near the campsite last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们在营地附近看到一只野生狐狸。

wildcat.t:
n. 野猫
adj. 未经批准的（罢工等）

e.en: A {wildcat} strike shut down the factory yesterday.
e.zh: 一场未经工会批准的罢工昨天使工厂停工。

e.en: Hikers spotted a {wildcat} prowling along the ridge.
e.zh: 徒步者看到一只野猫在山脊上潜行。

wildcatter.t: n. 石油勘探者；投机者

e.en: The {wildcatter} struck oil after months of drilling.
e.zh: 那个投机钻探者经过数月钻探终于发现石油。

e.en: Texas was once full of optimistic {wildcatter} prospectors.
e.zh: 得州曾经满是乐观的投机钻探者。

e.en: She prefers {wholemeal} flour when baking her sourdough.
e.zh: 她做酸面包时更喜欢用全麦面粉。

e.en: The sandwich comes on toasted {wholemeal} bread.
e.zh: 这份三明治是用烤过的全麦面包做的。

e.en: Meditation gives her a sense of inner {wholeness} and peace.
e.zh: 冥想让她感受到内心的完整与平和。

e.en: Therapy helped him rediscover a feeling of {wholeness}.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮助他重新找回完整自我的感觉。

e.en: The recipe calls for two {wholes} of garlic, finely chopped.
e.zh: 这道菜需要两整颗大蒜，切碎备用。

e.en: Fractions can be combined to form {wholes} in math class.
e.zh: 在数学课上分数可以合并成整数。

wholesale.t:
n./adj. 批发
adv. 大规模地

e.en: The shop buys flowers {wholesale} from a Dutch supplier.
e.zh: 这家店从一家荷兰供应商批发购进鲜花。

e.en: There has been {wholesale} change in company management.
e.zh: 公司管理层发生了大规模的变动。

e.en: Our local {wholesaler} delivers fresh produce every Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 我们本地的批发商每周二早上送新鲜农产品。

e.en: The {wholesaler} offers steep discounts for bulk orders.
e.zh: 该批发商为大宗订单提供大幅折扣。

wholesome.t: adj. 有益健康的；正派的

e.en: The video of puppies playing was so {wholesome} and heartwarming.
e.zh: 小狗玩耍的视频既治愈又暖心。

e.en: They serve {wholesome} home-cooked meals at the inn.
e.zh: 这家旅馆供应健康的家常饭菜。

e.en: The show's appeal lies in its old-fashioned {wholesomeness}.
e.zh: 这部剧的魅力在于它老派的纯真气息。

e.en: Critics praised the film's {wholesomeness} and family-friendly humor.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部电影健康向上且适合全家观看。

e.en: I ordered a turkey sandwich on toasted {wholewheat} bread.
e.zh: 我点了一份火鸡三明治，配烤过的全麦面包。

e.en: {Wholewheat} pasta has a slightly nuttier flavor than regular.
e.zh: 全麦意面比普通意面带有一丝坚果香。

e.en: The clinic takes a {wholistic} approach to mental health.
e.zh: 这家诊所对心理健康采取整体疗法。

e.en: She prefers a {wholistic} view of education over test scores.
e.zh: 比起考试分数，她更看重教育的整体视角。

e.en: The two situations are {wholly} different and shouldn't be compared.
e.zh: 这两种情况完全不同，不应该相提并论。

e.en: I am {wholly} convinced that honesty is the best policy.
e.zh: 我完全相信诚实是最好的策略。

e.en: To {whom} should I address this complaint letter?
e.zh: 这封投诉信我该写给谁？

e.en: The friend with {whom} I traveled lives in Berlin now.
e.zh: 和我一起旅行过的那位朋友现在住在柏林。

e.en: Give the package to {whomever} answers the door first.
e.zh: 把包裹交给最先开门的人。

e.en: Invite {whomever} you like to the housewarming party.
e.zh: 乔迁派对上你想请谁就请谁。

whomsoever.t: pron. 无论何人（whomever 的正式说法）

e.en: The prize will be awarded to {whomsoever} the judges select.
e.zh: 奖项将授予评委选中的任何人。

e.en: This letter may be shown to {whomsoever} it concerns.
e.zh: 此信可出示给任何相关人士。

e.en: The fans let out a {whoop} when the team scored.
e.zh: 球队进球时球迷们爆发出一阵欢呼。

e.en: Kids {whoop} with delight as the rollercoaster plunges down.
e.zh: 过山车俯冲时孩子们兴奋地大声尖叫。

whoopee.t: int. 耶！（表示兴奋的喊声）

e.en: {Whoopee}, school is finally out for the summer holidays!
e.zh: 哇哦，终于放暑假了！

e.en: The kids cried {whoopee} when the snow began falling.
e.zh: 雪开始落下时孩子们欢呼雀跃。

whooping.t: adj. 高声喊叫的；百日咳的

e.en: The doctor diagnosed the baby with {whooping} cough last week.
e.zh: 医生上周诊断出这名婴儿患了百日咳。

e.en: The crowd was {whooping} and cheering throughout the concert.
e.zh: 演唱会期间观众一直在欢呼喝彩。

whoops.t: int. 哎呀（犯错时的惊呼）

e.en: {Whoops}, I just spilled coffee all over my keyboard.
e.zh: 哎呀，我刚把咖啡洒了一键盘。

e.en: {Whoops}, I forgot to attach the file to my email.
e.zh: 哎呀，我忘了把文件添加到邮件里。

e.en: The train passed with a loud {whoosh} of warm air.
e.zh: 火车呼地一声驶过，带起一阵热风。

e.en: You can hear the {whoosh} of waves from the balcony.
e.zh: 在阳台上能听到海浪呼呼的声音。

whooshing.t: n./adj. 呼啸的；嗖嗖作响的

e.en: The wind kept {whooshing} through the trees all night.
e.zh: 风整夜在树林间呼呼地吹个不停。

e.en: Cars went {whooshing} past on the wet motorway.
e.zh: 汽车在湿漉漉的高速公路上呼啸而过。

e.en: He gave the mosquito a quick {whop} with the magazine.
e.zh: 他用杂志啪地一下打死了那只蚊子。

e.en: The boxer landed a solid {whop} on his opponent's jaw.
e.zh: 拳击手对着对手下巴重重地一击。

whopper.t: n. 庞然大物；弥天大谎

e.en: That fish you caught is an absolute {whopper}!
e.zh: 你钓到的那条鱼真是大得惊人！

e.en: He told a {whopper} about meeting a celebrity at the airport.
e.zh: 他编了个弥天大谎，说在机场遇见了名人。

e.en: The repair bill came to a {whopping} two thousand dollars.
e.zh: 这笔维修费高达两千美元，相当惊人。

e.en: She won a {whopping} prize in the lottery last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末她在彩票中赢得了一笔巨额奖金。

e.en: The old novel uses {whore} as a harsh insult.
e.zh: 那部老小说里用whore作为一句刻薄的辱骂。

e.en: He's a media {whore} who chases every camera in sight.
e.zh: 他是个爱出风头的家伙,见到镜头就凑上去。

e.en: The dusty Western film featured a saloon and a {whorehouse}.
e.zh: 那部尘土飞扬的西部片里有一家酒馆和一家妓院。

e.en: The old building had once been a notorious {whorehouse}.
e.zh: 那栋老建筑曾经是一家声名狼藉的妓院。

e.en: Each fingerprint contains a unique {whorl} pattern.
e.zh: 每个指纹都有独一无二的螺旋纹路。

e.en: The shell's delicate {whorl} caught the morning light beautifully.
e.zh: 贝壳精致的螺旋纹在晨光下显得十分美丽。

e.en: The plant has {whorled} leaves arranged around the stem.
e.zh: 这种植物的叶子围绕茎呈轮生排列。

e.en: He admired the {whorled} grain of the polished walnut table.
e.zh: 他欣赏着那张抛光胡桃木桌上漩涡状的纹理。

e.en: {Whose} laptop is sitting on the conference table?
e.zh: 会议桌上那台笔记本电脑是谁的?

e.en: She's the artist {whose} paintings sold out last week.
e.zh: 她就是那位上周画作全部售罄的艺术家。

e.en: {Whosoever} breaks this rule will be removed from the group.
e.zh: 无论是谁,违反此规定都将被移出群组。

e.en: The prize goes to {whosoever} solves the puzzle first.
e.zh: 奖品归任何最先解开这道谜题的人。

e.en: The heavy book hit the floor with a loud {whump}.
e.zh: 那本厚书砰的一声重重地砸在地板上。

e.en: We heard a distant {whump} as the helicopter landed.
e.zh: 我们听到远处直升机降落时发出沉闷的轰响。

e.en: Our team is going to {whup} them in the finals.
e.zh: 我们队会在决赛里把他们打得落花流水。

e.en: Grandpa joked he'd {whup} anyone who touched his pie.
e.zh: 爷爷开玩笑说谁敢碰他的派,他就揍谁。

why.t:
adv. 为什么
int. 咦（表惊讶）

e.en: We flew to {Wichita} for a small tech conference last week.
e.zh: 我们上周飞到威奇托参加一个小型科技会议。

e.en: {Wichita} is the largest city in the state of Kansas.
e.zh: 威奇托是堪萨斯州最大的城市。

e.en: Trim the candle {wick} before lighting it again.
e.zh: 再次点燃前先把蜡烛芯修剪一下。

e.en: The lamp's {wick} was soaked in oil and burned brightly.
e.zh: 灯芯浸满了油,燃烧得很明亮。

wicked.t:
adj. 邪恶的；淘气的
adj. 超棒的（俚语）

e.en: The villain in this game has a truly {wicked} sense of humor.
e.zh: 这游戏里的反派有一种相当邪恶的幽默感。

e.en: That guitar solo was absolutely {wicked}!
e.zh: 那段吉他独奏简直酷毙了!

wickedest.t: adj. 最邪恶的（wicked 最高级）

e.en: He plays the {wickedest} villain in the entire series.
