e.en: The child sat {wrapt} in the storyteller's voice.
e.zh: 孩子坐在那里，全神贯注地听讲故事人的声音。

e.en: The statue stood {wrapt} in a white cloth.
e.zh: 那座雕像被一块白布包裹着立在那里。

e.en: The boys used to {wrastle} behind the barn.
e.zh: 那些男孩过去常在谷仓后面摔跤。

e.en: She had to {wrastle} with the stubborn door for several minutes.
e.zh: 她不得不和那扇难开的门较劲好几分钟。

e.en: He answered {wrathily} when they questioned his honesty.
e.zh: 他们质疑他的诚实时，他愤怒地回答。

e.en: The queen looked {wrathily} at the careless servant.
e.zh: 女王盛怒地看着那个粗心的仆人。

wrathless.t: 无怒气的；温和不发火的

e.en: His {wrathless} reply surprised the angry crowd.
e.zh: 他毫无怒气的回答让愤怒的人群感到意外。

e.en: She met the insult with a calm, {wrathless} smile.
e.zh: 面对侮辱，她只是平静而不带怒气地一笑。

e.en: The {wrathy} king ordered the gates to be shut.
e.zh: 愤怒的国王下令关闭城门。

e.en: My grandfather grew {wrathy} when anyone wasted food.
e.zh: 只要有人浪费食物，我祖父就会发火。

e.en: The doorway was {wreathen} with ivy and winter berries.
e.zh: 门口缠绕着常春藤和冬季浆果。

e.en: A {wreathen} crown rested on the statue's head.
e.zh: 一顶花环状的冠饰放在雕像头上。

e.en: The grave was bare and {wreathless} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，坟墓光秃秃的，没有花环。

e.en: She chose a simple, {wreathless} veil for the ceremony.
e.zh: 她为仪式选了一条简单、没有花环装饰的面纱。

e.en: {Wreathy} smoke rose from the cottage chimney.
e.zh: 缭绕的烟从小屋烟囱里升起。

e.en: The dancer wore a {wreathy} garland of silver leaves.
e.zh: 舞者戴着一圈银叶编成的花环。

e.en: The chef grilled {wreckfish} with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 厨师用柠檬和香草烤了沉船鱼。

e.en: A large {wreckfish} often hides near deep ocean structures.
e.zh: 大型沉船鱼常藏在深海结构物附近。

wreckful.t: 造成破坏的；充满残骸的

e.en: The {wreckful} storm left boats scattered along the shore.
e.zh: 那场破坏性风暴把船只冲得沿岸到处都是。

e.en: They walked through a {wreckful} scene after the crash.
e.zh: 事故后，他们走过一片满是残骸的现场。

e.en: The old pier looked {wrecky} after years of storms.
e.zh: 多年风暴过后，那座旧码头像残骸一样破败。

e.en: His {wrecky} little car still managed the journey.
e.zh: 他那辆破破烂烂的小车还是撑完了旅程。

e.en: The crowd cheered during the {wrestling-match}.
e.zh: 摔跤比赛进行时，观众大声欢呼。

e.en: He injured his shoulder in a {wrestling-match} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚他在一场摔跤比赛中弄伤了肩膀。

e.en: I managed to {wrick} my neck while lifting the box.
e.zh: 我搬箱子时竟然把脖子扭伤了。

e.en: A sudden slip gave him a painful {wrick} in the back.
e.zh: 突然一滑让他的背部疼得像扭了一下。

e.en: She {wricked} her ankle on the uneven path.
e.zh: 她在不平的小路上扭伤了脚踝。

e.en: His {wricked} neck made driving difficult.
e.zh: 他扭伤的脖子让开车变得很吃力。

e.en: He avoided {wricking} his knee by stepping carefully.
e.zh: 他小心落脚，避免扭伤膝盖。

e.en: That sharp turn was {wricking} my back.
e.zh: 那个急转弯把我的背扭得发疼。

e.en: He often {wricks} his wrist during practice.
e.zh: 他训练时常常扭伤手腕。

e.en: Small {wricks} can become serious if ignored.
e.zh: 小扭伤如果不管，也可能变严重。

e.en: His mouth {wried} into a bitter smile.
e.zh: 他的嘴扭成一个苦涩的笑。

e.en: The old branch had {wried} under the constant wind.
e.zh: 那根老树枝在持续的风中已经扭弯了。

e.en: Her face {wries} when she tastes the medicine.
e.zh: 她尝到药味时脸就扭了起来。

e.en: The road {wries} around the hill before reaching the village.
e.zh: 那条路绕着山弯弯曲曲地通向村子。

e.en: The toddler was too {wriggly} to hold still.
e.zh: 那个小孩扭来扭去，根本抱不稳。

e.en: She found a {wriggly} worm under the wet stone.
e.zh: 她在湿石头下面发现了一条蠕动的虫子。

e.en: His shirt was {wringing-wet} after the run.
e.zh: 跑完步后，他的衬衫湿透了。

e.en: We arrived home {wringing-wet} from the sudden rain.
e.zh: 突如其来的雨把我们淋得湿透才到家。

e.en: He packed a {wrinkle-free} shirt for the meeting.
e.zh: 他为会议带了一件免熨衬衫。

e.en: This fabric stays {wrinkle-free} even after washing.
e.zh: 这种布料洗过之后也不容易起皱。

wrinkleless.t: 没有皱纹的；平整无皱的

e.en: Her {wrinkleless} face made her look younger.
e.zh: 她没有皱纹的脸让她显得更年轻。

e.en: The sheet looked almost {wrinkleless} after ironing.
e.zh: 熨过之后，床单看起来几乎平整无皱。

e.en: The apple looked {wrinklier} after a week on the table.
e.zh: 苹果在桌上放了一周后看起来更皱了。

e.en: His hands grew {wrinklier} as he aged.
e.zh: 随着年纪增长，他的手变得皱纹更多。

e.en: She picked the {wrinkliest} shirt from the laundry basket.
e.zh: 她从洗衣篮里挑出了最皱的那件衬衫。

e.en: The {wrinkliest} faces in the room often smiled the most.
e.zh: 屋里皱纹最多的那些脸往往笑得最多。

e.en: The young {wrist-spinner} troubled every batter today.
e.zh: 这位年轻的腕力旋转投球手今天让每个击球手都很难受。

e.en: A good {wrist-spinner} can change direction late in the air.
e.zh: 优秀的腕力旋转投球手能让球在空中后段变向。

e.en: He checked his {wrist-watch} before leaving.
e.zh: 他离开前看了一眼手表。

e.en: Her old {wrist-watch} still keeps perfect time.
e.zh: 她那块旧手表走时仍然很准。

e.en: The doctor noticed {wristdrop} after the nerve injury.
e.zh: 神经受伤后，医生注意到他出现了腕下垂。

e.en: Severe {wristdrop} can make it hard to grip objects.
e.zh: 严重的垂腕症会让抓握物品变得困难。

e.en: She attached the keys to a leather {wristlet}.
e.zh: 她把钥匙挂在一条皮质腕带上。

e.en: The black {wristlet} was just big enough for her phone.
e.zh: 那个黑色小手拿包刚好能装下她的手机。

e.en: The fighter used a {wristlock} to end the match.
e.zh: 那名选手用腕关节锁技结束了比赛。

e.en: A careless {wristlock} can injure the joint.
e.zh: 不慎使用腕关节锁技可能会伤到关节。

e.en: Good {wristwork} improved her tennis shots.
e.zh: 良好的手腕技巧提高了她的网球击球质量。

e.en: The drummer's fast {wristwork} impressed the audience.
e.zh: 鼓手快速的腕部动作让观众印象深刻。

wristy.t: 用手腕发力的；腕部灵活的

e.en: He played a {wristy} shot past the fielder.
e.zh: 他用手腕发力击出一球，越过了守场员。

e.en: Her {wristy} style gave the music a light touch.
e.zh: 她灵活用腕的风格让音乐显得轻盈。

e.en: His {writative} habits made him keep detailed journals.
e.zh: 他爱写东西的习惯让他坚持写详细日记。

e.en: The course encourages a more {writative} response to history.
e.zh: 这门课鼓励学生以更偏写作的方式回应历史。

e.en: The cache will {write back} changes later.
e.zh: 缓存稍后会把更改写回去。

e.en: This policy delays every {write-back} operation.
e.zh: 这项策略会延迟每次回写操作。

e.en: Please {write down} the address carefully.
e.zh: 请仔细把地址写下来。

e.en: The company had to {write down} its old inventory.
e.zh: 公司不得不减记旧库存的价值。

e.en: Several voters chose a {write-in} candidate.
e.zh: 几名选民选择了另填姓名的候选人。

e.en: The form leaves space to {write in} extra details.
e.zh: 表格留了空位，可以补写额外细节。

e.en: The {write-ins} changed the local election result.
e.zh: 这些另填候选人的选票改变了地方选举结果。

e.en: We counted the {write-ins} at the bottom of the form.
e.zh: 我们统计了表格底部的补写项目。

e.en: The crash made the car a complete {write-off}.
e.zh: 那次撞车让这辆车彻底报废了。

e.en: Do not {write off} her chances too soon.
e.zh: 不要太早断定她没有机会。

e.en: The audit found several questionable {write-offs}.
e.zh: 审计发现了几笔可疑的注销款项。

e.en: Two damaged vans became insurance {write-offs}.
e.zh: 两辆受损货车成了保险意义上的报废车。

e.en: You can {write-protect} the disk before sharing it.
e.zh: 共享磁盘前，你可以把它设为写保护。

e.en: The administrator {write-protects} critical system files.
e.zh: 管理员会对关键系统文件设置写保护。

e.en: She prepared a detailed {write-up} of the meeting.
e.zh: 她准备了一份详细的会议书面报告。

e.en: I need to {write up} my notes tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚需要把笔记整理成文。

e.en: The website published three product {write-ups}.
e.zh: 网站发布了三篇产品专题文章。

e.en: His performance reviews included two formal {write-ups}.
e.zh: 他的绩效评估里有两份正式书面记录。

e.en: Make sure the folder is {writeable} by the app.
e.zh: 要确保应用可以写入这个文件夹。

e.en: The disk is no longer {writeable} after the error.
e.zh: 出错后，这张磁盘已经无法写入了。

e.en: The bank announced a large {writedown} on loans.
e.zh: 银行宣布对贷款进行大额减记。

e.en: A sudden {writedown} hurt the company's profits.
e.zh: 突如其来的资产减记损害了公司的利润。

e.en: The damaged laptop was a total {writeoff}.
e.zh: 那台受损的笔记本电脑完全报废了。

e.en: Calling the project a {writeoff} seems unfair.
e.zh: 把这个项目说成完全没希望并不公平。

e.en: The program can {write to} a secure log file.
e.zh: 这个程序可以写入一个安全日志文件。

e.en: Please {write to} us if the problem returns.
e.zh: 如果问题再次出现，请写信联系我们。

e.en: Her {writeup} explained the experiment clearly.
e.zh: 她的书面报告清楚解释了实验。

e.en: The restaurant received a glowing {writeup} online.
e.zh: 那家餐厅在网上得到了一篇热情的评述文章。

e.en: His {writhen} hands rested on the blanket.
e.zh: 他扭曲的双手放在毯子上。

e.en: The old vine looked {writhen} and dry.
e.zh: 那株老藤看起来弯曲干枯。

e.en: The editor marked {writtings} as a spelling error.
e.zh: 编辑把writtings标为拼写错误。

e.en: His early {writtings} circulated among friends.
e.zh: 他的早期文字作品在朋友间流传。

e.en: The sudden question seemed to {wrong-foot} him.
e.zh: 这个突然的问题似乎让他措手不及。

e.en: Her clever pass can {wrong-foot} a defender.
e.zh: 她巧妙的传球能骗过防守队员。

e.en: The minister looked {wrong-footed} by the accusation.
e.zh: 面对这项指控，部长显得措手不及。

e.en: The goalkeeper was {wrong-footed} by the shot.
e.zh: 守门员被那脚射门骗过了重心。

e.en: The announcement is {wrong-footing} many investors.
e.zh: 这项公告正让许多投资者措手不及。

e.en: His change of pace was {wrong-footing} the defender.
e.zh: 他节奏一变，就把防守队员晃住了。

e.en: That question often {wrong-foots} new candidates.
e.zh: 那个问题常常让新候选人措手不及。

e.en: A low bounce {wrong-foots} the goalkeeper.
e.zh: 一次低弹球骗过了守门员的重心。

wrong-headed.t: 判断错误的；固执错误的

e.en: It was a {wrong-headed} attempt to cut costs.
e.zh: 那是一次判断错误的削减成本尝试。

e.en: She rejected his {wrong-headed} advice politely.
e.zh: 她礼貌地拒绝了他那种错误又固执的建议。

e.en: His shirt was {wrong-side-out} after practice.
e.zh: 训练后，他的衬衫里外穿反了。

e.en: She noticed the sweater was {wrong-side-out}.
e.zh: 她发现毛衣里外反着穿了。

e.en: That was the {wrongest} answer on the list.
e.zh: 那是清单里最错误的答案。

e.en: He chose the {wrongest} possible moment to laugh.
e.zh: 他偏偏选了最不合适的时刻笑出来。

wronghead.t: 固执错误的人；糊涂脑袋

e.en: Only a {wronghead} would ignore all the evidence.
e.zh: 只有固执犯错的人才会无视所有证据。

e.en: The columnist called him a political {wronghead}.
e.zh: 专栏作家称他是政治上的糊涂脑袋。

wrongheaded.t: 顽固错误的；执迷不悟的主张或做法

e.en: The committee rejected his {wrongheaded} plan to cut safety checks.
e.zh: 委员会否决了他削减安全检查的错误计划。

e.en: It was {wrongheaded} to blame the nurses for a shortage of beds.
e.zh: 把床位不足归咎于护士是执迷不悟的错误做法。

wrongheadedly.t: 顽固错误地；执迷不悟地

e.en: They {wrongheadedly} assumed that silence meant consent.
e.zh: 他们错误地认定沉默就表示同意。

e.en: The policy {wrongheadedly} punishes small shops instead of polluters.
e.zh: 这项政策执迷不悟地惩罚小店，而不是污染者。

e.en: Her report exposed the {wrongheadedness} of the old policy.
e.zh: 她的报告揭露了旧政策的顽固错误。

e.en: The {wrongheadedness} of blaming victims became clear later.
e.zh: 后来人们才看清责怪受害者是多么执迷不悟。

e.en: The old text calls the verdict {wrongous} and cruel.
e.zh: 这篇旧文称那项判决不公且残酷。

e.en: He protested the {wrongous} taking of his land.
e.zh: 他抗议别人不公正地夺走他的土地。

e.en: The king grew {wroth} when the messenger laughed.
e.zh: 信使发笑时，国王勃然大怒。

e.en: She was {wroth} at the insult but kept her voice steady.
e.zh: 她对那句侮辱非常恼火，但声音仍保持平稳。

e.en: His {wrothy} reply silenced the whole room.
e.zh: 他怒气冲冲的回答让整个房间安静下来。

e.en: The poem describes a {wrothy} lord seeking revenge.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了一位盛怒的领主寻求复仇。

e.en: A {wrought-iron} gate stood at the garden entrance.
e.zh: 花园入口处立着一扇熟铁大门。

e.en: They bought a {wrought-iron} bed frame from an antique shop.
e.zh: 他们从古董店买了一个熟铁床架。

wrought-up.t: 激动不安的；神经紧张的

e.en: The children were too {wrought-up} to sleep after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，孩子们太紧张激动，睡不着觉。

e.en: Don't get so {wrought-up} over one rude email.
e.zh: 别为一封无礼的邮件这么心烦意乱。

e.en: The {wry-mouthed} old man watched them argue.
e.zh: 那个嘴角歪斜的老人看着他们争吵。

e.en: She gave him a {wry-mouthed} smile and said nothing.
e.zh: 她冲他露出一个带讽刺意味的歪嘴笑，什么也没说。

e.en: The {wry-necked} patient needed gentle physical therapy.
e.zh: 这名斜颈患者需要温和的物理治疗。

e.en: A {wry-necked} figure appears in the medieval drawing.
e.zh: 那幅中世纪图画里出现了一个脖子扭歪的人物。

wrybill.t: 歪嘴鸻；喙向一侧弯的水鸟

e.en: The {wrybill} feeds along shallow braided rivers.
e.zh: 歪嘴鸻在浅浅的辫状河道边觅食。

e.en: We saw a rare {wrybill} during the bird survey.
e.zh: 我们在鸟类调查中看见了一只罕见的歪嘴鸻。

e.en: Her second joke was even {wryer} than the first.
e.zh: 她讲的第二个笑话比第一个还要冷讽。

e.en: His smile grew {wryer} as the excuses continued.
e.zh: 借口一个接一个，他的笑容变得更加讽刺。

e.en: That was the {wryest} comment in the whole debate.
e.zh: 那是整场辩论中最讽刺的一句话。

e.en: She saved her {wryest} smile for the final apology.
e.zh: 她把最带讽刺意味的笑留给了最后那句道歉。

e.en: Pain was {wrying} his mouth into a grimace.
e.zh: 疼痛使他的嘴扭成了怪相。

e.en: The actor kept {wrying} his face for comic effect.
e.zh: 那位演员不停把脸扭歪，以制造喜剧效果。

e.en: The child was treated for {wryneck} after the injury.
e.zh: 受伤后，这个孩子接受了斜颈治疗。

e.en: A {wryneck} can twist its neck in a startling way.
e.zh: 蚁鴷能以令人吃惊的方式扭转脖子。

e.en: The {wrynecked} dancer turned slowly toward the audience.
e.zh: 那位脖子扭歪的舞者慢慢转向观众。

e.en: The novel mentions a {wrynecked} clerk with sharp eyes.
e.zh: 小说提到一个斜颈但眼神锐利的 clerk。

e.en: The {wryness} of her tone made everyone smile.
e.zh: 她语气里的讽刺意味让大家都笑了。

e.en: The sculptor exaggerated the {wryness} of the face.
e.zh: 雕塑家夸大了那张脸的歪斜感。

e.en: In the dialect story, he said he {wud} return before dark.
e.zh: 在那篇方言故事里，他说自己天黑前会回来。

e.en: The old glossary lists {wud} as a form of wood.
e.zh: 那本旧词汇表把 wud 列为 wood 的一种写法。

e.en: The old {wynd} led down to the harbor.
e.zh: 那条古老窄巷通向港口。

e.en: They slipped through a dark {wynd} behind the market.
e.zh: 他们从市场后面一条昏暗小巷穿了过去。

e.en: The villagers did not {wyte} him for the storm.
e.zh: 村民们没有把那场风暴归咎于他。

e.en: Old poems sometimes {wyte} fate for human sorrow.
e.zh: 古诗有时把人的悲伤归咎于命运。

e.en: A bronze {wyvern} guarded the castle gate.
e.zh: 一只青铜双足飞龙守在城门前。

e.en: The shield showed a red {wyvern} with spread wings.
e.zh: 盾牌上画着一只展翼的红色纹章翼龙。

e.en: Two {wyverns} circled above the ruined tower.
e.zh: 两只双足飞龙在废塔上空盘旋。

e.en: Medieval banners often displayed fierce {wyverns}.
e.zh: 中世纪旗帜上常画着凶猛的纹章翼龙。

e.en: The collector found bright orange {wulfenite} crystals in the mine.
e.zh: 收藏者在矿井里发现了鲜橙色的钼铅矿晶体。

e.en: A small piece of {wulfenite} sat in the museum case.
e.zh: 一小块钼铅矿陈列在博物馆展柜里。

e.en: The old waiter smiled and said the soup was {wunderbar}.
e.zh: 老侍者笑着说这汤妙极了。

e.en: She used {wunderbar} with a playful German accent.
e.zh: 她带着玩笑的德语腔说“太棒了”。

e.en: The family sheltered in a {wurley} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中，这家人躲在一间原住民小屋里。

e.en: An old {wurley} stood near the dry riverbed.
e.zh: 干涸河床旁立着一座旧的原住民小屋。

e.en: They built a {wurlie} from branches and bark.
e.zh: 他们用树枝和树皮搭了一间原住民小屋。

e.en: The guide pointed to a restored {wurlie} beside the path.
e.zh: 向导指着小路旁一间修复过的原住民小屋。

e.en: We ate hot {wurst} with mustard at the market.
e.zh: 我们在市场上吃了配芥末的热德式香肠。

e.en: The menu listed several kinds of {wurst}.
e.zh: 菜单上列着好几种德式香肠。

e.en: The geologist identified the black mineral as {wurtzilite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种黑色矿物鉴定为乌尔齐石。

e.en: Samples of {wurtzilite} were stored for later chemical tests.
e.zh: 乌尔齐石样本被保存起来，以便之后做化学检测。

e.en: She practices {wushu} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 她每个星期六早上练习武术。

e.en: The film made {wushu} look graceful and powerful.
e.zh: 这部电影把武术拍得既优美又有力量。

e.en: The furnace produced traces of {wustite} in the slag.
e.zh: 炉渣中产生了少量方铁矿。

e.en: Researchers measured how quickly {wustite} reacted with gas.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了方铁矿与气体反应的速度。

e.en: The child called the strange plush toy a {wuzzle}.
e.zh: 孩子把那个奇怪的毛绒玩具叫作混合动物玩具。

e.en: His proposal was a {wuzzle} of three different plans.
e.zh: 他的提案是三种不同方案拼成的混合物。

e.en: The old blanket felt soft and {wuzzy}.
e.zh: 那条旧毯子摸起来柔软又毛茸茸的。

e.en: After the medicine, my thoughts became {wuzzy}.
e.zh: 吃药之后，我的思绪变得有些模糊。

e.en: A tall {wych-elm} shaded the churchyard gate.
e.zh: 一棵高大的山榆给教堂墓园门口投下阴影。

e.en: The carpenter chose {wych-elm} for its strong grain.
e.zh: 木匠选用山榆木，因为它的纹理结实。

e.en: The historian described him as a {Wycliffite} reformer.
e.zh: 历史学家把他描述为一名威克利夫派改革者。

e.en: A {Wycliffite} text circulated secretly among readers.
e.zh: 一篇威克利夫派文本在读者之间秘密流传。

e.en: The preacher was accused of being a {Wyclifite}.
e.zh: 那名传教士被指控为威克利夫派信徒。

e.en: Several {Wyclifite} ideas influenced later reform movements.
e.zh: 若干威克利夫派思想影响了后来的改革运动。

e.en: The diagram shows two {wyes} in the circuit.
e.zh: 图中显示电路里有两个Y形连接。

e.en: Engineers used {wyes} to split the airflow evenly.
e.zh: 工程师用Y形接头把气流均匀分开。

e.en: The cat {wauls} outside the window every night.
e.zh: 那只猫每晚都在窗外哀叫。

e.en: He {wauls} dramatically whenever he loses a game.
e.zh: 他每次输掉比赛都会夸张地嚎叫。

e.en: Things could grow {waur} before the storm passes.
e.zh: 暴风雨过去前，情况可能会变得更糟。

e.en: He spoke {waur} of himself than anyone else did.
e.zh: 他说自己坏话比别人说得还狠。

e.en: The engineer studied the {wave-form} on the screen.
e.zh: 工程师研究屏幕上的波形。

e.en: A clean {wave-form} helps musicians adjust the sound.
e.zh: 清晰的波形能帮助音乐人调整声音。

e.en: The {wave-function} describes a particle's possible states.
e.zh: 波函数描述粒子的可能状态。

e.en: Solving the {wave-function} required advanced mathematics.
e.zh: 求解这个波函数需要高等数学。

e.en: The radar signal travels through a metal {wave-guide}.
e.zh: 雷达信号通过金属波导传输。

e.en: Engineers designed a smaller {wave-guide} for the antenna.
e.zh: 工程师为天线设计了更小的波导。

wave-off.t: 挥手示意取消；复飞指令

e.en: The officer gave a {wave-off} to stop the landing.
e.zh: 军官发出复飞指令，阻止飞机降落。

e.en: Her quick {wave-off} told us not to wait.
e.zh: 她迅速挥手示意我们不要等。

e.en: The lab bought a new {waveform-analyzer} for testing circuits.
e.zh: 实验室买了一台新的波形分析仪来测试电路。

e.en: A {waveform-analyzer} can reveal hidden distortion in audio.
e.zh: 波形分析仪能显示音频中隐藏的失真。

e.en: The lake looked almost {waveless} at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时湖面几乎无波，十分平静。

e.en: A {waveless} sea made the crossing unusually smooth.
e.zh: 无波的海面让这次横渡异常平稳。

e.en: The dancer moved with a {wavelike} motion.
e.zh: 舞者以波浪般的动作移动。

e.en: Light sometimes shows {wavelike} behavior in experiments.
e.zh: 光在实验中有时表现出波动特性。

e.en: The collector found green {wavellite} in the old quarry.
e.zh: 收藏者在旧采石场发现了绿色磷铝石。

e.en: Tiny crystals of {wavellite} covered the rock surface.
e.zh: 细小的磷铝石晶体覆盖了岩石表面。

e.en: The technician checked the transmitter with a {wavemeter}.
e.zh: 技术员用波长计检查发射机。

e.en: A precise {wavemeter} is useful in laser experiments.
e.zh: 精密波长计在激光实验中很有用。

e.en: The pilot received a {waveoff} from the tower.
e.zh: 飞行员收到了塔台发出的复飞指令。

e.en: His casual {waveoff} ended the discussion.
e.zh: 他随意一挥手，就结束了讨论。

e.en: The oscillator produced a strange {waveshape}.
e.zh: 振荡器产生了一种奇怪的波形形状。

e.en: Changing the filter altered the signal's {waveshape}.
e.zh: 改变滤波器后，信号的波形形状也变了。

e.en: The synthesizer uses a {waveshaper} to create harsher tones.
e.zh: 这台合成器用波形整形器制造更刺耳的音色。

e.en: A diode can act as a simple {waveshaper} in the circuit.
e.zh: 二极管在电路中可以充当简单的波形整形器。

e.en: She drew a {wavey} line across the page.
e.zh: 她在纸上画了一条波浪线。

e.en: His {wavey} hair was still wet from the rain.
e.zh: 他的鬈曲头发还被雨淋得湿湿的。

e.en: The professor used {wavicle} to explain quantum behavior.
e.zh: 教授用“波粒”这个概念解释量子行为。

e.en: A {wavicle} is neither simply a wave nor a particle.
e.zh: 所谓波粒既不单纯是波，也不单纯是粒子。

e.en: This is the {waviest} pattern in the whole fabric.
e.zh: 这是整块布料中最波浪形的图案。

e.en: She has the {waviest} hair in our family.
e.zh: 她是我们家头发最鬈曲的人。

e.en: The artist emphasized the {wavilness} of the line.
e.zh: 画家强调了线条的波状感。

e.en: The fabric's slight {wavilness} showed after washing.
e.zh: 布料洗后显出轻微的起伏。

e.en: The ribbon fell {wavily} over her shoulder.
e.zh: 丝带呈波浪状垂落在她肩上。

e.en: Heat rose {wavily} from the road.
e.zh: 热气从路面上起伏地升起。

e.en: The stylist added more {waviness} to her hair.
e.zh: 发型师让她的头发更有波浪感。

e.en: Engineers measured the surface {waviness} of the metal sheet.
e.zh: 工程师测量了金属板表面的起伏度。

well-set-up.t: 条件优越的；安排妥当的

e.en: The lab is {well-set-up} for genetic research.
e.zh: 这间实验室设备完善，很适合做基因研究。

e.en: She arrived at a {well-set-up} meeting with clear roles.
e.zh: 她参加的是一场安排妥当、分工明确的会议。

e.en: The children seem {well-settled} in their new school.
e.zh: 孩子们在新学校似乎已经适应得很好。

e.en: This is a {well-settled} principle of contract law.
e.zh: 这是合同法中一个早已确立的原则。

well-spent.t: 花得值得的；用得有意义的

e.en: The afternoon was {well-spent} helping my grandmother.
e.zh: 那个下午用来帮祖母做事，过得很有意义。

e.en: That money was {well-spent} on better safety equipment.
e.zh: 那笔钱花在更好的安全设备上很值得。

well-spoken.t: 谈吐得体的；说话文雅的

e.en: The candidate was calm and {well-spoken} during the interview.
e.zh: 那位候选人在面试中沉着冷静，谈吐得体。

e.en: He gave a {well-spoken} apology to the whole team.
e.zh: 他向整个团队作了措辞得体的道歉。

e.en: Her childhood memories became a {well-spring} of stories.
e.zh: 她的童年记忆成了许多故事的源泉。

e.en: The valley's {well-spring} fed a clear mountain stream.
e.zh: 山谷里的泉源汇成了一条清澈的山溪。

e.en: She is {well-suited} to a career in medicine.
e.zh: 她很适合从事医学方面的职业。

e.en: The software is {well-suited} for small design teams.
e.zh: 这款软件很适合小型设计团队使用。

well-taken.t: 有道理的；被欣然接受的

e.en: Your criticism is {well-taken}, and we will revise the plan.
e.zh: 你的批评很有道理，我们会修改这个计划。

e.en: The warning was {well-taken} by the safety committee.
e.zh: 安全委员会认真接受了这项警告。

well-tempered.t: 性情平和的；调律均匀的

e.en: A {well-tempered} manager can calm a tense room.
e.zh: 性情平和的经理能让紧张的会议室冷静下来。

e.en: Bach's music explored the possibilities of a {well-tempered} keyboard.
e.zh: 巴赫的音乐探索了平均律键盘的各种可能。

e.en: She is {well-thought-of} by colleagues across the company.
e.zh: 她在公司各部门同事中都很受尊敬。

e.en: The school remains {well-thought-of} in the local community.
e.zh: 这所学校在当地社区仍然口碑很好。

e.en: The proposal was {well-thought-out} and easy to defend.
e.zh: 这份提案考虑周密，也很容易论证。

e.en: A {well-thought-out} schedule can prevent last-minute panic.
e.zh: 一份周密的日程安排可以避免最后一刻的慌乱。

well-thumbed.t: 翻旧了的；被频繁翻阅的

e.en: A {well-thumbed} cookbook lay open on the counter.
e.zh: 一本翻旧了的食谱摊开放在操作台上。

e.en: He kept a {well-thumbed} copy of the poems in his bag.
e.zh: 他包里一直放着一本翻阅多次的诗集。

well-timbered.t: 树木茂密的；木材充足的

e.en: The estate includes a {well-timbered} hillside above the river.
e.zh: 这片庄园包括河上方一处树木茂密的山坡。

e.en: They bought a {well-timbered} farm with valuable old oaks.
e.zh: 他们买下了一座林木丰厚、长有珍贵老橡树的农场。

well-timed.t: 时机恰好的；安排适时的

e.en: Her {well-timed} joke broke the awkward silence.
e.zh: 她那句时机恰好的玩笑打破了尴尬的沉默。

e.en: A {well-timed} investment saved the company from collapse.
e.zh: 一次时机恰当的投资使公司免于倒闭。

e.en: They moved to a {well-to-do} neighborhood near the park.
e.zh: 他们搬到了公园附近一个富裕社区。

e.en: His parents were {well-to-do}, but they lived simply.
e.zh: 他的父母家境富裕，但生活很朴素。

well-trained.t: 训练有素的；受过良好培训的

e.en: The rescue team was {well-trained} for mountain emergencies.
e.zh: 这支救援队受过良好训练，能处理山区紧急情况。

e.en: A {well-trained} dog should respond to basic commands.
e.zh: 训练有素的狗应该会回应基本口令。

well-travelled.t: 见多识广的；常有人走的

e.en: My aunt is {well-travelled} and speaks four languages.
e.zh: 我姑妈去过很多地方，会说四种语言。

e.en: The {well-travelled} road leads directly to the coast.
e.zh: 这条常有人走的路直接通向海岸。

well-tried.t: 经过充分检验的；可靠的

e.en: We used a {well-tried} method to repair the engine.
e.zh: 我们用了一个经过充分检验的方法来修理发动机。

e.en: Her argument followed a {well-tried} legal strategy.
e.zh: 她的论证采用了一种可靠的法律策略。

well-trod.t: 常有人走的；陈旧熟悉的

e.en: We followed a {well-trod} path through the woods.
e.zh: 我们沿着林中一条常有人走的小路前进。

e.en: The novel returns to the {well-trod} theme of lost youth.
e.zh: 这部小说又回到了失去青春这一陈旧而熟悉的主题。

e.en: The hikers stayed on the {well-trodden} trail.
e.zh: 徒步者们一直走在那条常有人走的小径上。

e.en: The film follows a {well-trodden} story of revenge.
e.zh: 这部电影沿用了一个老套的复仇故事。

well-turned.t: 措辞优美的；造型匀称的

e.en: She ended the speech with a {well-turned} phrase.
e.zh: 她用一句措辞优美的话结束了演讲。

e.en: The antique chair had {well-turned} wooden legs.
e.zh: 那把古董椅有着线条匀称的木制椅腿。

well-turned-out.t: 衣着考究的；打扮得体的

e.en: The guests were {well-turned-out} for the evening reception.
e.zh: 宾客们参加晚宴时都衣着考究。

e.en: He looked {well-turned-out} in a dark suit and polished shoes.
e.zh: 他穿着深色西装和擦亮的皮鞋，看起来打扮得体。

e.en: Store the paint in a {well-ventilated} room.
e.zh: 请把油漆存放在通风良好的房间里。

e.en: The classroom felt cooler because it was {well-ventilated}.
e.zh: 教室因为通风良好，感觉更凉爽。

e.en: She is {well-versed} in European history.
e.zh: 她精通欧洲历史。

e.en: A good lawyer must be {well-versed} in local regulations.
e.zh: 一名好律师必须熟悉当地法规。

e.en: The judge gave a {well-weighed} decision after reviewing the evidence.
e.zh: 法官审查证据后作出了慎重权衡的裁决。

e.en: His advice was calm, {well-weighed}, and practical.
e.zh: 他的建议冷静、经过深思熟虑，而且很实用。

e.en: A sudden {wilderment} crossed his face.
e.zh: 他脸上忽然掠过一阵困惑。

e.en: The old map left us in {wilderment}.
e.zh: 那张旧地图让我们一头雾水。

e.en: The garden had a {wildish} charm.
e.zh: 这座花园有种略显荒野的魅力。

e.en: He wore a {wildish} grin after the race.
e.zh: 赛后他露出有点狂放的笑容。

e.en: The apple tree was a {wildling} from the old orchard.
e.zh: 那棵苹果树是旧果园里长出的野生苗。

e.en: Villagers called the lonely child a {wildling}.
e.zh: 村民把那个孤僻的孩子叫作野孩子。

e.en: The {wildwind} rattled the shutters all night.
e.zh: 狂风整夜把百叶窗吹得哐当作响。

e.en: She loved the {wildwind} on the open hill.
e.zh: 她喜欢空旷山坡上那股野性的风。

e.en: She {wilily} avoided answering the question.
e.zh: 她狡猾地避开了这个问题。

e.en: The thief {wilily} left no obvious trace.
e.zh: 小偷很狡猾，没有留下明显痕迹。

e.en: His {wiliness} made him hard to trust.
e.zh: 他的狡猾让人很难信任他。

e.en: The plan required patience and {wiliness}.
e.zh: 这个计划需要耐心和机敏的计谋。

will-call.t: 预订票取票处；预留取货

e.en: Pick up your tickets at {will-call} before the show.
e.zh: 演出前请到预订票取票处领取门票。

e.en: The package was held for {will-call} at the counter.
e.zh: 包裹被留在柜台等顾客自取。

will-less.t: 无意志的；缺乏决断力的

e.en: He felt {will-less} after weeks of failure.
e.zh: 连续几周失败后，他感到毫无意志。

e.en: The novel portrays a {will-less} clerk trapped by routine.
e.zh: 小说刻画了一个被日常困住、缺乏主见的职员。

e.en: A {will-o'-the-wisp} flickered above the marsh.
e.zh: 沼泽上方闪着一团鬼火。

e.en: Perfect certainty remained a {will-o'-the-wisp}.
e.zh: 绝对的确定性仍是个虚幻难追的目标。

e.en: The travelers saw {will-o'-the-wisps} over the bog.
e.zh: 旅人们看见沼泽上方有几团鬼火。

e.en: His promises were {will-o'-the-wisps}, bright but unreachable.
e.zh: 他的承诺像虚幻的诱惑，明亮却不可触及。

e.en: Quitting smoking takes real {will-power}.
e.zh: 戒烟需要真正的意志力。

e.en: She used {will-power} to ignore the dessert.
e.zh: 她靠自制力忍住没有吃甜点。

willable.t: 可凭意志做到的；可遗赠的

e.en: The response is partly {willable} with practice.
e.zh: 经过练习，这种反应在一定程度上可以凭意志控制。

e.en: The lawyer checked whether the property was {willable}.
e.zh: 律师核查这项财产是否可以通过遗嘱处分。
